title: A generalizable deep learning model for predicting opioid use disorder using language modeling for cross-EHR data harmonization
zh_title: 跨EHR语言建模预测阿片使用障碍的深度学习模型
summary: 基于All of Us纵向电子病历的语言模型OUD-REY预测一年内阿片使用障碍风险，并在时间外部队列与约600万VA患者数据上完成外部验证。

abstract: The opioid use disorder (OUD) epidemic in the United States has been a major public health crisis. We developed OUD-REY ( OUD R isk E valuator at 1 Y ear) - a deep learning model that uses longitudinal electronic health record (EHR) data from the All of Us research program to predict risk of OUD at one year for patients with an opioid prescription. On internal validation, OUD-REY achieved an AUROC of 91.2% and AUPRC of 77.0%. We leveraged a pretrained language model to accommodate thousands of unseen, out-of-vocabulary clinical features in a patient’s longitudinal EHR history. We externally validated our model on a new dataset released by All of Us that was temporally separated from our development set and on a dataset containing ~6 million patients from medical centers of the Veterans Affairs (VA) nationwide over a span of 20 years. On external validation, our model had an AUROC and AUPRC of 86.4% and 23.1% (OUD prevalence of 2.9%), respectively, on our temporally separated All of Us validation set. It had an AUROC and AUPRC of 85.5% and 19.5% (OUD prevalence of 3.5%), respectively, on the VA dataset. Our fairness auditing showed that the model was generally fair for patients with different genders, race, and ethnic backgrounds. This model may potentially improve prevention and care of OUD.
zh_abstract: 美国的阿片类药物使用障碍（OUD）流行一直是一场重大公共卫生危机。我们开发了OUD-REY（OUD 1年风险评估器）——一个深度学习模型，利用All of Us研究计划中的纵向电子健康记录（EHR）数据，预测接受阿片类药物处方的患者一年时发生OUD的风险。在内部验证中，OUD-REY达到91.2%的AUROC和77.0%的AUPRC。我们利用一个预训练语言模型来处理患者纵向EHR历史中数千个未见过的、词汇表外的临床特征。我们在All of Us发布的一个新数据集上外部验证了我们的模型，该数据集在时间上与我们的开发集分离；并在一个包含约600万名患者、来自美国退伍军人事务部（VA）全国医疗中心、跨度20年的数据集上进行了外部验证。外部验证中，在时间分离的All of Us验证集上，我们的模型AUROC和AUPRC分别为86.4%和23.1%（OUD患病率2.9%）。在VA数据集上，AUROC和AUPRC分别为85.5%和19.5%（OUD患病率3.5%）。我们的公平性审计显示，该模型对不同性别、种族和族裔背景的患者总体公平。该模型可能改善OUD的预防和护理。

title: GUARD-LGG: a glioma upfront AI-driven radiotherapy response decipher for lower-grade glioma
zh_title: GUARD-LGG：低级别胶质瘤放疗反应AI预测
summary: 机器学习模型在治疗前预测低级别胶质瘤早期放疗反应，经七家外部机构与前瞻性试验队列验证。
key_points: 训练963例，外部7家机构187例，前瞻性队列328例
外部测试AUC 0.882，前瞻性测试AUC 0.913
模型关键特征含残留肿瘤、年龄与MRI纹理/对比度
reason: 同行评审且具备多中心外部验证与前瞻性试验队列，符合重要档。
abstract: Radiotherapy (RT) remains a cornerstone in managing lower-grade glioma (LGG), but its response varies widely. Reliable pre-treatment prediction of RT response could facilitate patient management but remains unavailable. Here we present GUARD-LGG, a machine learning model designed to predict early RT response in LGG before treatment. GUARD-LGG was trained on 963 patients from a major center, tested on 187 patients from seven independent institutions, and 328 patients prospectively enrolled in a registered clinical trial. GUARD-LGG achieved AUCs of 0.946 (95% CI: 0.938–0.962), 0.929 (95% CI: 0.894–0.965), 0.882 (95% CI: 0.830–0.934), and 0.913 (95% CI: 0.878–0.949) in the training, internal validation, external, and prospective test sets, respectively. Model interpretation highlighted residual tumor, age, T2-weighted texture roughness and T1-weighted contrast intensity changes as major predictors. Radiogenomic analyses suggested potential associations between predicted unfavorable RT response and enrichment of RT resistance-related pathways. Consistently, patients with predicted unfavorable RT response exhibited shorter overall survival. In conclusion, GUARD-LGG enables individualized prediction of early RT response before therapy, offering a tool for pre-treatment response stratification in LGG.
zh_abstract: 放疗（RT）仍是管理较低级别胶质瘤（LGG）的基石，但其反应差异很大。可靠的治疗前 RT 反应预测可促进患者管理，但仍不可获得。在此，我们提出 GUARD-LGG，这是一种设计用于在治疗前预测 LGG 早期 RT 反应的机器学习模型。GUARD-LGG 在一个主要中心的963名患者上训练，并在来自七家独立机构的187名患者以及一项注册临床试验中前瞻性入组的328名患者上测试。GUARD-LGG 在训练集、内部验证集、外部测试集和前瞻性测试集中的 AUC 分别为0.946（95% CI：0.938–0.962）、0.929（95% CI：0.894–0.965）、0.882（95% CI：0.830–0.934）和0.913（95% CI：0.878–0.949）。模型解释强调残留肿瘤、年龄、T2加权纹理粗糙度和T1加权对比强度变化为主要预测因素。放射基因组分析提示，预测的不利 RT 反应与 RT 耐药相关通路的富集之间存在潜在关联。一致地，预测为不利 RT 反应的患者表现出更短的总生存期。总之，GUARD-LGG 能够在治疗前对早期 RT 反应进行个体化预测，为 LGG 的治疗前反应分层提供工具。

title: Reinforcement learning for repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation protocol selection in treatment-resistant depression

summary: 基于1609例常规EHR数据训练强化学习，在留出诊所中推荐方案与PHQ-9更大改善相关。
key_points: 19个诊所组1609名成人rTMS电子病历数据
370名留出诊所患者为外部验证集
匹配推荐方案者下次PHQ-9多改善0.788分
reason: 同行评审且多诊所留出外部验证，样本量较大并报告症状改善结局。
abstract: Repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS), including intermittent theta-burst stimulation (iTBS), is an established treatment for treatment-resistant depression, but clinicians lack evidence-based guidance for session-level choices among stimulation type, intensity, and laterality. In this study, we investigated whether a reinforcement learning (RL) algorithm trained on routine clinical data could recommend session-level rTMS protocols associated with greater symptom improvement using electronic health record data from 1609 adults treated with rTMS between January 2023 and June 2025 across 19 clinic groups. Among 370 patients from held-out clinics, treatment decisions matching algorithm recommendations were associated with 0.788 points greater next-session Patient Health Questionnaire-9 improvement than treatments that differed (95% CI: 0.634–0.940). Following every recommendation was projected to produce 3.22 points of additional improvement (95% CI: 2.72–3.75). These findings suggest RL can find treatment patterns associated with greater next-session improvement and potentially meaningful improvement accumulated across a treatment episode.
zh_abstract: 重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS），包括间歇性θ爆发刺激（iTBS），是难治性抑郁的既定治疗方法，但临床医生缺乏基于证据的指导，以在刺激类型、强度和偏侧性方面进行每次治疗层面的选择。在本研究中，我们使用电子健康记录数据，调查在常规临床数据上训练的强化学习（RL）算法能否推荐与更大症状改善相关的每次治疗层面 rTMS 方案；这些数据来自 2023 年 1 月至 2025 年 6 月期间在 19 个诊所组接受 rTMS 治疗的 1609 名成人。在来自留出诊所的 370 名患者中，与算法推荐一致的治疗决策，相较于不一致的治疗，与下一次治疗时患者健康问卷-9（PHQ-9）改善多 0.788 分相关（95% CI：0.634–0.940）。若遵循每一条推荐，预计可产生 3.22 分的额外改善（95% CI：2.72–3.75）。这些发现表明，RL 能够找到与更大的下一次治疗改善以及在一个治疗疗程中累积的潜在有意义改善相关的治疗模式。

title: Expertise modulates automation bias and sentinel behavior in human–AI collaborative diagnosis of neonatal pneumoperitoneum
zh_title: 人机协同诊断中专业水平对自动化偏差的影响
summary: 1750次阅片交叉试验显示，高可靠AI反而使受训者产生自动化偏差，专家对错误建议表现出更高纠错率。

受训者接受了52.0%的错误AI建议

reason: 前瞻性人机协作实验设计有新意，但专家样本极小，属值得一看档
abstract: Medical AI is often validated under an additive assumption that algorithmic sensitivity and clinician oversight will combine to improve care. We tested this assumption in the high-stakes diagnosis of neonatal pneumoperitoneum, a time-critical surgical emergency. In a multi-reader crossover study analyzing 1750 interpretation events, clinicians reviewed radiographs aided by either a high-reliability model or a systematically error-injected model. We found that high AI reliability paradoxically induces automation bias in trainees, who accepted 52.0% of incorrect suggestions, while offering limited gains to experts. Conversely, when challenged by flawed AI, the three participating neonatologists exhibited a “sentinel behavior” phenotype, correctly overriding 91.7% of errors (Wilson 95% CI: 83.0–96.0%) consistent with increased deliberation; given the small specialist cohort, this finding is hypothesis-generating and warrants prospective replication. We operationalize systemic resilience as the capacity to maintain diagnostic integrity under algorithmic failure and demonstrate that clinical validity depends on the human–AI team’s adversarial resilience rather than standalone accuracy. To mitigate the risk of deskilling and never-skilling, we release an open-source educational sandbox designed to inoculate clinicians against automated errors.
zh_abstract: 医学AI常在一种加法假设下被验证，即算法敏感性与临床医生监督将结合起来改善医疗。我们在新生儿气腹这一时间关键的外科急症的高风险诊断中检验了这一假设。在一项分析1750次解读事件的多阅片者交叉研究中，临床医生在一种高可靠性模型或一种系统性注入错误的模型辅助下审阅X线片。我们发现，高AI可靠性悖论性地在受训者中诱发自动化偏见，他们接受了52.0%的错误建议，而对专家带来的获益有限。相反，当面对有缺陷的AI挑战时，三位参与的新生儿科医生表现出一种“哨兵行为”表型，正确推翻了91.7%的错误（Wilson 95% CI：83.0–96.0%），与审慎思考增加相一致；鉴于专科医生队列较小，这一发现具有假设生成性质，值得前瞻性重复验证。我们将系统性韧性操作化为在算法失败下维持诊断完整性的能力，并证明临床有效性取决于人-AI团队的对抗性韧性，而非独立准确性。为减轻技能退化和从未习得技能的风险，我们发布了一个开源教育沙盒，旨在让临床医生对自动化错误产生免疫力。

We conducted a PRISMA-guided systematic review of PubMed and Web of Science (publication years 2016-2024). title: Overuse and False Restraint in Large Language Model Recommendations for Choosing Wisely Scenarios.
zh_title: 大模型在“明智选择”场景中的过度使用与不当克制
summary: 基于15条Choosing Wisely建议构建225个场景，测试6个商用大模型共4050条回答的该停手与该处理判断。
key_points: 每条建议设10个应克制、5个应处理场景
6个商用模型3次运行共生成4050条回答

abstract: [Annals of internal medicine] The Choosing Wisely initiative made recommendations where screening, testing, or treatment may be overused, with caveats around appropriate use. Clinicians are increasingly using large language models (LLMs). To evaluate whether commercial LLMs appropriately call for restraint or action from scenarios based on Choosing Wisely recommendations. Benchmark evaluation. Fifteen Choosing Wisely recommendations were used to develop 225 scenarios (per recommendation, 10 in which restraint was appropriate and 5 in which action was appropriate). Six commercial LLMs (3 runs each) generated 4050 responses to the 225 scenarios, using a prompt from the clinician perspective. Production application programming interfaces of OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google from February to March 2026. No human participants were involved. Co-primary outcomes were the overuse rate (endorsing action when restraint was appropriate) and the false restraint rate (withholding an appropriate action). The rate of LLM-recommended overuse was 5.4% (95% CI, 0.6% to 12.2%); LLMs did not recommend overuse in 8 of 15 recommendations. Two recommendations accounted for most LLM-recommended overuse: thyroid ultrasound for an incidental subcentimeter nodule (overuse recommended in 42.8% of LLM responses) and routine electrocardiography in low-risk adults (overuse recommended in 28.3% of LLM responses). The LLMs recommended overuse in 0.6% to 3.3% of responses for the remaining 5 recommendations. False restraint was rare (0.6% [CI, 0.1% to 1.2%]), was absent for 11 of 15 recommendations, and was highest for prostate-specific antigen screening (3.3%). Single prompts without follow-up; a benchmark rather than real-world use; responses classified by LLM judge with physician adjudication. Findings may not extend to consumer-facing use. The LLMs rarely withheld recommendations for treatment when it was appropriate. Overuse was concentrated in 2 recommendations. None.
zh_abstract: [Annals of internal medicine] Choosing Wisely 倡议提出了关于筛查、检测或治疗可能被过度使用的建议，并附有围绕适当使用的注意事项。临床医生正越来越多地使用大型语言模型（LLMs）。评估商业 LLMs 在基于 Choosing Wisely 建议的场景中是否适当地要求克制或采取行动。基准评估。使用 15 条 Choosing Wisely 建议开发了 225 个场景（每条建议中，10 个场景适合克制，5 个场景适合采取行动）。6 个商业 LLMs（各运行 3 次）对 225 个场景生成了 4050 条回答，使用从临床医生视角的提示词。OpenAI、Anthropic 和 Google 的生产应用程序编程接口，时间为 2026 年 2 月至 3 月。未涉及人类参与者。共同主要结局为过度使用率（在适合克制时仍支持采取行动）和错误克制率（扣留适当的行动）。LLM 推荐过度使用的比率为 5.4%（95% CI，0.6% 至 12.2%）；在 15 条建议中有 8 条 LLMs 未推荐过度使用。两条建议占 LLM 推荐过度使用的大多数：对偶然发现的亚厘米结节进行甲状腺超声（42.8% 的 LLM 回答推荐过度使用）和低风险成人常规心电图检查（28.3% 的 LLM 回答推荐过度使用）。对于其余 5 条建议，LLMs 在 0.6% 至 3.3% 的回答中推荐过度使用。错误克制少见（0.6% [CI，0.1% 至 1.2%]），在 15 条建议中有 11 条不存在，且在前列腺特异性抗原筛查中最高（3.3%）。单一提示词且无后续追问；采用基准而非真实世界使用；回答由 LLM 评判员分类并由医生裁定。研究结果可能不适用于面向消费者的使用。LLMs 很少在治疗适当时扣留推荐。过度使用集中在 2 条建议。无。

abstract: [American heart journal] Steatotic liver disease (SLD) is highly prevalent among individuals with cardiovascular disease, but often remains undiagnosed until advanced sequelae such as fibrotic liver disease and hepatocellular carcinoma develop. ​​Transthoracic echocardiography routinely captures incidental subcostal views of the liver that are not used clinically. The EchoNet-Liver algorithm uses artificial intelligence (AI) to predict the presence of liver disease based on routine clinical echocardiograms. Prospective evaluation in real-world practice is needed to understand the clinical utility and impact of AI-enabled opportunistic liver disease screening. The SCOUT-Echo-AI study is a single-arm, prospective, multicenter, open-label pragmatic interventional trial that will be conducted across six diverse U.S. healthcare systems (Kaiser Permanente Northern California, Stanford Healthcare, Cedars-Sinai Medical Center, University of California Los Angeles, Northwestern Medicine, and Massachusetts General Brigham). Routine echocardiograms will be analyzed by the EchoNet-Liver AI algorithm with an estimated enrollment of ∼3,000 patients. Treating clinicians or participants themselves will be notified of potential undiagnosed liver disease with site-specific workflows in place to ensure routine clinical care for definitive case confirmation. Primary outcomes will be SLD and fibrotic liver disease detection rates and positive predictive values within 12 months of AI identification. Pre-specified secondary outcomes will assess diagnostic accuracy against other gold-standard modalities, treatment initiation, time to diagnosis, and impact on other clinical events. Outcomes will be compared against historical usual-care and contemporary below-threshold cohorts. SCOUT-Echo-AI is a prospective multicenter study evaluating the real-world impact of AI-enabled opportunistic liver disease screening using routine echocardiography.

abstract: Objective Structured Clinical Examinations (OSCEs) are central to competency-based medical education, yet high-quality case development is resource-intensive. Large language models (LLMs) offer a scalable solution, but comprehensive OSCE case generation, including components such as candidate instructions, standardized patient scripts, and examiner marking schemes, is underexplored. We developed an LLM-based tool to generate complete OSCE stations. Three board-certified internists evaluated 24 generated cases across eight internal medicine diagnoses and three learner levels using a 12-item Likert instrument. Ratings were high across all domains; communication behaviors (4.64/5), EPA alignment (4.62/5), and overall value (4.61/5) performed best; guideline concordance scored lowest (4.24/5) with the greatest rater disagreement. As a feasibility study, these findings establish that whole, schema-validated OSCE stations can be generated from a single structured call at a quality experts rate as acceptable, while also identifying guideline concordance and difficult calibration as the domains most requiring faculty oversight -- providing reproducible infrastructure for, but not yet evidence of, effective EPA-aligned OSCE development.

title: LeakBench: Auditing Reward Hacking through Prediction-Time Leakage in Clinical Modeling Agents
zh_title: LeakBench：审计临床建模智能体的预测时泄漏
summary: 提出可执行审计套件LeakBench，检查临床建模智能体在预测时数据泄漏、校准、站点级评估与决策净获益方面的行为。

abstract: Autonomous clinical-modeling agents can optimize predictive performance while violating conditions that make a model usable. We introduce LeakBench, an executable, guideline-derived audit suite that tests agent decisions for prediction-time leakage, calibration, site-level evaluation, support awareness, and decision-curve net benefit. LeakBench combines a synthetic task with known failure structure and two real-data settings: MIMIC-IV (430k admissions) and governed multi-hospital inpatient record front-page (MHFP) data. Our primary analysis uses reward hacking descriptively, without attributing intent: an agent selects prediction-time-invalid inputs because they improve its validation reward. A deterministic optimizer and every evaluated unconstrained local-model configuration select a fatal leaking feature. In fully logged September 2026 A/B runs, DeepSeek Flash and GPT-6-astra each leak in 10/10 unconstrained runs and 0/10 runs with an explicit admission-time constraint. This contrast is version-sensitive: a blinded Claude/Fable-5.1 chat run does not leak in either condition, while explicit-constraint violations appear only in a historical August 2026 slice lacking raw trajectories. Replacing AUROC with AUPRC does not remove leakage selection. Renaming or disguising the leaking inputs changes neither selection nor provenance-based detection; a name-based filter fails. A deterministic provenance verifier-in-loop removes the leak, making the LLM repair loop defense-in-depth. Specific verifier feedback clears fatal leakage in a hosted agent, and a three-seed ablation finds principle-only feedback clears decision-level defects, though these mitigation results are limited. LeakBench treats trustworthy clinical prediction as a property of an agent's modeling process, not merely its score; it is an audit testbed with known-failure controls, not yet an expert-validated benchmark.
zh_abstract: 自主临床建模智能体可以优化预测性能，同时违反使模型可用的条件。我们引入 LeakBench，一个可执行的、源自指南的审计套件，用于测试智能体在预测时泄漏、校准、站点级评估、支持度感知和决策曲线净获益方面的决策。LeakBench 将一个具有已知失败结构的合成任务与两个真实数据设置相结合：MIMIC-IV（43 万次入院）和受治理的多医院住院记录首页（MHFP）数据。我们的主要分析以描述性方式使用奖励黑客（reward hacking），不归因意图：智能体选择预测时无效的输入，因为这些输入提高了其验证奖励。一个确定性优化器和每个被评估的无约束局部模型配置都选择了一个致命的泄漏特征。在完整记录的 2026 年 9 月 A/B 运行中，DeepSeek Flash 和 GPT-6-astra 各自在 10/10 次无约束运行中泄漏，而在有明确入院时间约束的运行中为 0/10 次。这种对比对版本敏感：一次盲法 Claude/Fable-5.1 聊天运行在两种条件下均不泄漏，而明确约束违规仅出现在缺乏原始轨迹的历史 2026 年 8 月切片中。将 AUROC 替换为 AUPRC 并不能消除泄漏选择。重命名或伪装泄漏输入既不会改变选择，也不会改变基于来源的检测；基于名称的过滤器失效。一个确定性来源验证器在环中消除了泄漏，使 LLM 修复循环成为纵深防御。特定的验证器反馈在托管智能体中清除了致命泄漏，而三种子消融发现仅原则性反馈可清除决策级缺陷，尽管这些缓解结果有限。LeakBench 将可信临床预测视为智能体建模过程的一种属性，而不仅仅是其分数；它是一个具有已知失败对照的审计测试平台，尚不是经专家验证的基准。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: University Medical Centre Maribor; conditions: Acute Coronary Syndromes, Chest Pain, Myocardial Infarction (MI), NSTEMI - Non-ST Segment Elevation MI, ST Elevation Myocardial Infarction; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 1000; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] Chest pain is among the most common reasons people attend an emergency department, and the electrocardiogram (ECG) recorded at triage is the first test used to decide who needs urgent treatment for a blocked coronary artery. Recognising the ECG patterns that indicate an acutely blocked artery is difficult. Many such patterns do not produce the classic ST-segment elevation, and identifying them reliably requires a level of ECG expertise that is not always available at the point of triage - particularly at night and among clinicians who are not cardiologists. Artificial intelligence (AI) models that read the 12-lead ECG have been shown in several retrospective studies, mainly from Western Europe and the United States, to identify acute coronary occlusion more sensitively than conventional interpretation. These models are now in clinical use in a number of health systems. Their performance has not been assessed in a prospectively enrolled, unselected Slovenian emergency department population, and diagnostic accuracy commonly declines when a model is applied outside the setting in which it was developed. TRIACS is a prospective, single-centre, observational external validation study in the Emergency Department of University Medical Centre Maribor. All consecutive adults presenting with symptoms suggestive of acute coronary syndrome who have a 12-lead ECG recorded at triage as part of routine care will be enrolled. Each triage ECG is analysed by the AI model. The model's output is withheld from all treating clinicians and plays no part in patient care; every patient receives standard guideline-directed management. The main aim is to measure how accurately the AI model identifies angiographically confirmed occlusion myocardial infarction in this population, and to compare its accuracy with the triage decision actually made by the clinical team. The study is therefore designed to inform an adoption decision in either direction, rather than to demonstrate a predetermined conclusion.

abstract: [Oncology] Background The rapid growth of biomedical publishing in radiation oncology has created a need for automated methods to extract structured information from unstructured text. Large language models (LLMs) show promise in biomedical natural language processing, but their use for clinical trial data curation remains to be systematically evaluated. Methods We evaluated an LLM-based extraction system for radiation oncology trials on ClinicalTrials.gov. Forty-five classification questions spanning variables such as trial design, tumor type, stage, radiotherapy modality, systemic therapy, and outcomes were implemented using the data-element-extractor Python library with three open-source LLMs (GPT-OSS-20B, GPT-OSS-120B, and Qwen-3.6-27B). A manually curated ground-truth of 94 trials was used for performance evaluation based on accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. Results Qwen-3.6-27B achieved the highest overall accuracy of 92.0% across all questions. For the 39 Boolean questions, it demonstrated 93.0% accuracy, 81.6% precision, 83.7% recall, and an F1-score of 82.6%, with 23 Boolean questions achieving an F1-score ≥80.0%. Three numerical questions reached accuracy ≥80.0%. Applied to the full dataset, the system characterized the clinical landscape of radiotherapy trials, detailing the prevalence of advanced techniques (e.g., 13.7% SBRT) and the integration of systemic agents, including chemotherapy (57.3%) and immunotherapy (26.1%). Conclusion LLM-based extraction can enable accurate, scalable curation of radiotherapy trial data. While challenges remain with complex categorical or numerical variables, open-source LLMs can serve as effective components of transparent, auditable clinical research pipelines.
zh_abstract: [Oncology]【背景】放射肿瘤学生物医学出版的快速增长，产生了从非结构化文本中提取结构化信息的自动化方法需求。大语言模型（large language models, LLMs）在生物医学自然语言处理中展现出前景，但其用于临床试验数据策管仍需系统评估。【方法】我们在ClinicalTrials.gov上评估了一个基于LLM的放射肿瘤学试验提取系统。使用data-element-extractor Python库和三个开源LLM（GPT-OSS-20B、GPT-OSS-120B和Qwen-3.6-27B），实现了涵盖试验设计、肿瘤类型、分期、放疗模式、全身治疗和结局等变量的45个分类问题。使用人工策管的94项试验真实标注，基于准确率、精确率、召回率和F1分数进行性能评估。【结果】Qwen-3.6-27B在所有问题上取得最高的总体准确率92.0%。对于39个布尔型问题，它表现出93.0%的准确率、81.6%的精确率、83.7%的召回率和82.6%的F1分数，其中23个布尔型问题达到F1分数≥80.0%。三个数值型问题达到准确率≥80.0%。应用于完整数据集时，该系统刻画了放疗试验的临床图景，详细说明了先进技术的普及情况（例如，SBRT占13.7%）以及全身性药物的整合，包括化疗（57.3%）和免疫治疗（26.1%）。【结论】基于LLM的提取能够实现放疗试验数据的准确、可扩展策管。尽管复杂分类或数值变量仍存在挑战，开源LLM可作为透明、可审计的临床研究流程中的有效组成部分。

abstract: [Environmental science & technology] Chemical exposure causes adverse neurological outcomes, highlighting the need for high-throughput screening of chemical neurotoxicity. However, existing computational methods rely on single-modality inputs and lack complementary molecular information to sufficiently enhance the accuracy and efficiency of neurotoxicity risk assessment. Here, we present NeuroToxPredictor, a scalable and interpretable multimodal framework built on a curated chemical neurotoxicity dataset for accurate and efficient chemical neurotoxicity prediction. It integrates graph attention networks and molecular fingerprints with ChemBERTa, a pretrained chemical language model that provides contextual encoding of SMILES. A gated fusion module adaptively weights these complementary representations according to their predictive relevance to enhance modality-specific weight allocation through a gating fusion mechanism. NeuroToxPredictor achieved competitive performance across five independent training seeds (AUC = 0.919 ± 0.004; accuracy = 0.845 ± 0.014; F1-score = 0.861 ± 0.011; recall = 0.884 ± 0.013; precision = 0.839 ± 0.024; MCC = 0.688 ± 0.028), outperforming both single-modality and reduced-modality baselines. It demonstrates strong generalizability with an AUC of 0.861, as externally validated on an independent set of 279 compounds. NeuroToxPredictor is deployed on a publicly platform (https://www.ai4environ.cn/NeuroToxPredictor), enabling an end-to-end intelligent workflow from chemical retrieval, neurotoxicity prediction, applicability-domain assessment, and large language model-assisted result interpretation.
zh_abstract: [Environmental science & technology] 化学暴露会导致不良神经学结局，这凸显了对化学神经毒性进行高通量筛选的需求。然而，现有计算方法依赖单模态输入，缺乏互补的分子信息，无法充分提高神经毒性风险评估的准确性和效率。在此，我们提出 NeuroToxPredictor，这是一个基于精心整理的化学神经毒性数据集构建的可扩展且可解释的多模态框架，用于准确高效的化学神经毒性预测。它将图注意力网络（graph attention networks）和分子指纹与 ChemBERTa 相结合；ChemBERTa 是一个预训练化学语言模型，可提供 SMILES 的上下文编码。门控融合模块（gated fusion module）根据各互补表示与预测的相关性自适应地为其加权，通过门控融合机制增强模态特定的权重分配。NeuroToxPredictor 在五个独立训练随机种子上取得了有竞争力的性能（AUC = 0.919 ± 0.004；准确率 = 0.845 ± 0.014；F1 分数 = 0.861 ± 0.011；召回率 = 0.884 ± 0.013；精确率 = 0.839 ± 0.024；MCC = 0.688 ± 0.028），优于单模态和减少模态的基线。在包含 279 个化合物的独立集上进行外部验证时，其 AUC 为 0.861，表现出强泛化能力。NeuroToxPredictor 已部署在公共平台（https://www.ai4environ.cn/NeuroToxPredictor）上，支持从化学检索、神经毒性预测、适用域评估到大语言模型辅助结果解释的端到端智能工作流。

abstract: Many potentially recoverable donor livers are discarded because current paradigms prioritize preservation and viability assessment over prolonged stabilization and rehabilitation. Multi-day normothermic ex vivo perfusion creates a therapeutic window but shifts the challenge from sustaining circulation to interpreting evolving physiologic trajectories without native homeostatic regulation. We propose physiologic digital twins that integrate mechanistic and statistical models to estimate organ state and support decision-making during ex vivo perfusion.

title: The Ambulatory Patient Experience with Ambient Artificial Intelligence Scribes: A Qualitative Study.
source: PubMed · Journal of general internal medicine
zh_title: 环境AI病历记录助手与门诊患者体验的定性研究
summary: 在学术医学中心多专科门诊开展定性访谈，探讨环境AI记录助手如何影响患者体验及提升患者舒适度的因素。
key_points: 对多专科门诊患者进行半结构化访谈
患者取自环境AI记录员实施的RCT
归纳影响患者体验与舒适度的因素
reason: 同行评审定性研究，设计规范但样本与结论有限，属5-6档
abstract: [Journal of general internal medicine] The effect of ambient artificial intelligence (AI) scribes on patient experience remains understudied and has been largely limited to closed-ended surveys. Qualitative studies are needed to more fully explore how ambient AI scribes influence patient experience. The aim of this study was to explore how ambient AI scribes influence the patient experience and to identify factors that improve patients' comfort with these tools. We conducted a qualitative study using a semi-structured interview guide that captured key patient experience domains from a literature review. We recruited patients from numerous ambulatory specialties (e.g., dermatology, primary care) whose clinicians were participating in a pragmatic randomized clinical trial of an ambient AI scribe implementation at an academic medical center. We deductively and inductively drew patterns in patients' reported experiences and the factors that contributed to patients' comfort with these tools. Twenty patients were included in our sample before thematic saturation occurred. Patients reported improvements in patient experience through increased respect for patients' preferences (e.g., fewer distractions), improved thoroughness of visit notes, and increased time spent answering patients' questions. Factors influencing comfort included demographic factors (e.g., exposure to similar technologies), lack of saliency of the device, lack of privacy-related concerns, positive pre-existing patient-clinician relationships, and anticipated benefits to care. Ambient AI scribes may improve the patient experience through improved patient-clinician verbal, non-verbal, and written communication. These findings contribute to our understanding how these tools shape the patient experience. Not applicable.
zh_abstract: [《Journal of General Internal Medicine》] 环境式人工智能（AI）记录助手对患者体验的影响仍未得到充分研究，且在很大程度上局限于封闭式调查。需要定性研究来更全面地探讨环境式AI记录助手如何影响患者体验。本研究旨在探讨环境式AI记录助手如何影响患者体验，并识别提高患者对这些工具舒适度的因素。我们开展了一项定性研究，使用半结构化访谈指南，该指南涵盖了文献综述中确定的关键患者体验领域。我们从众多门诊专科（例如皮肤科、初级保健）招募患者，其临床医生正在参与某学术医疗中心实施环境式AI记录助手的实用性随机临床试验。我们以演绎和归纳方式提取了患者报告体验中的模式以及促成患者对这些工具舒适度的因素。在主题饱和出现前，我们的样本纳入了20名患者。患者报告，通过增加对患者偏好的尊重（例如更少干扰）、提高就诊记录的全面性以及增加回答患者问题的时间，患者体验得到改善。影响舒适度的因素包括人口学因素（例如接触过类似技术）、设备不显眼、缺乏隐私相关担忧、既往良好的患者-临床医生关系以及对照护的预期获益。环境式AI记录助手可能通过改善患者-临床医生之间的言语、非言语和书面沟通来改善患者体验。这些发现有助于我们理解这些工具如何塑造患者体验。不适用。

title: [Clinical reasoning in the age of artificial intelligence: the urgent need for formal education].
zh_title: 人工智能时代的临床推理：亟需正式教育
summary: 综述指出医学课程鲜有显式教授临床推理，而大模型进入临床加剧自动化偏差等风险，呼吁将其设为正式核心课程。
key_points: 诊断错误占医疗不良事件至多15%
双加工理论、疾病脚本、元认知构成推理教育基础
大模型诊断能力亮眼，但自动化偏差与虚构内容威胁决策安全
reason: 同行评审观点综述，无新数据，按综述档位取5分
abstract: [Harefuah] Clinical reasoning remains the cornerstone of medical practice, yet unlike anatomy or physiology, medical curricula rarely teach it explicitly. This omission has significant consequences, as diagnostic errors account for up to 15% of adverse events in healthcare. Theoretical models such as Dual Process Theory (System 1 intuitive vs. System 2 analytical reasoning), illness scripts, and metacognition highlight both the strengths and vulnerabilities of clinical cognition. The rapid integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into clinical practice intensifies the need for structured reasoning education. While large language models demonstrate impressive diagnostic capabilities, risks such as automation bias and AI confabulations threaten safe decision-making. Consequently, this review calls for a paradigm shift: clinical reasoning must become a formal, longitudinal core subject across all stages of medical education. In the AI era, clinical reasoning is not diminished; it is indispensable.
zh_abstract: [Harefuah] 临床推理仍然是医学实践的基石，但与解剖学或生理学不同，医学课程很少明确教授临床推理。这一遗漏具有重大后果，因为诊断错误占医疗保健不良事件的比例高达15%。诸如双过程理论（Dual Process Theory；系统1直觉式推理 vs. 系统2分析式推理）、疾病脚本（illness scripts）和元认知（metacognition）等理论模型，既突出了临床认知的优势，也揭示了其脆弱性。人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI）快速融入临床实践，加剧了对结构化推理教育的需求。虽然大语言模型（large language models）展现出令人印象深刻的诊断能力，但自动化偏倚（automation bias）和AI虚构（AI confabulations）等风险威胁安全决策。因此，本综述呼吁范式转变：临床推理必须成为贯穿医学教育所有阶段的正式、纵向核心科目。在AI时代，临床推理并未被削弱；它是不可或缺的。

title: Development of a Natural Language Processing Algorithm to Aid Creation of a Surgical Spine Database.
source: PubMed · The spine journal : official journal of the North American Spine Society
zh_title: 规则型NLP辅助构建脊柱手术数据库的验证研究
summary: 基于22,951份脊柱手术记录开发规则型NLP算法，在100份随机抽样记录上与不同临床经验的人工复核者对照验证。

共纳入22,951份脊柱手术记录
以100份随机抽样对照人工复核者

abstract: [The spine journal : official journal of the North American Spine Society] Manual effort required for feature extraction from operative reports can be time-intensive, inaccurate, and costly. Develop a natural language processing (NLP) algorithm for surgical spine database creation and validate performance against human reviewers with varying clinical experience. Retrospective study at a tertiary academic institution from 2008-2024. Operative spinal cases on adult patients from 22,951 spinal operative reports. Primary outcome was accuracy in operated spinal level classification. Secondary outcomes include clinical diagnoses, operative procedures, and additional surgical detail classification. A rule-based NLP algorithm was developed and validated on a random sample of 100 operative reports. Performance of the NLP algorithm and human reviewers was assessed against a reference standard. An a priori acceptability threshold was set at 0.90 for agreement, kappa, and F1. Time required for chart review/processing were also assessed for the NLP algorithm and human reviewers. The NLP algorithm matched the reference standard on operated spinal levels (Percent Agreement=93%; Kappa=0.98; F1=0.98), which outperformed human reviewers in clinical training. Performance on procedural and diagnostic feature extraction did not meet the accepted threshold but largely outperformed human validators in clinical training. NLP algorithm computation time averaged speed of 1,039 reports per minute, compared to the fastest median time of 1 minute per operative report for human chart reviewers. The NLP algorithm can accurately and reliably extract operated spinal levels from high volumes of operative reports. However, classification of diagnosis, operative procedures, and additional surgical procedures were not sufficient for practical implementation.
zh_abstract: [The spine journal : official journal of the North American Spine Society] 从手术报告中提取特征所需的人工工作可能耗时、不准确且成本高昂。开发一种用于创建脊柱手术数据库的自然语言处理（NLP）算法，并对照具有不同临床经验的人类审查者验证其性能。2008-2024 年在三级学术机构进行的回顾性研究。来自 22,951 份脊柱手术报告的成人患者脊柱手术病例。主要结局是手术脊柱节段分类的准确性。次要结局包括临床诊断、手术操作和额外手术细节的分类。开发了一种基于规则的 NLP 算法，并在 100 份手术报告的随机样本上进行验证。NLP 算法和人类审查者的性能对照参考标准进行评估。事先设定的可接受阈值在一致性、kappa 和 F1 上为 0.90。还评估了 NLP 算法和人类审查者进行病历审查/处理所需的时间。NLP 算法在手术脊柱节段上与参考标准一致（Percent Agreement=93%；Kappa=0.98；F1=0.98），其表现优于处于临床培训中的人类审查者。在手术操作和诊断特征提取上的性能未达到可接受阈值，但在很大程度上优于处于临床培训中的人类验证者。NLP 算法的计算时间平均速度为每分钟 1,039 份报告，而人类病历审查者最快的中位时间为每份手术报告 1 分钟。该 NLP 算法能够从大量手术报告中准确、可靠地提取手术脊柱节段。然而，诊断、手术操作和额外手术操作的分类尚不足以用于实际实施。

title: A general-purpose System One decision model for clinical records
zh_title: CS1：面向临床记录的40亿参数决策模型
summary: 预印本发布40亿参数模型CS1，基于多医院3.6万患者1240万问答训练，单次前向回答多类型临床问题并给出概率。

单次前向回答多类型问题，无需任务微调

reason: 多医院大规模训练与统一决策模型，属高质量预印本，但未见外部验证
abstract: Clinical care, health-system operations and biomedical discovery depend on extracting reliable answers from patient records, yet applying diverse clinical questions across entire populations remains computationally expensive. Here we present Clinical System One (CS1), a 4-billion-parameter decision model for fast, typed judgments from clinical records, along with two agentic harnesses in which CS1 works together with a generalist language model. CS1-4B is trained on 12.4 million questions and answers from 3.6 million patients across a multi-hospital health system, combining structured-data keys, observed outcomes and language-model supervision across clinical notes, diagnostic reports and patient timelines. It answers multiple typed questions in a single forward pass without task-specific retraining, and each answer carries a probability that can route uncertain cases to human review. On 963,408 held-out patients, CS1-4B outperformed open decision models up to 27 billion parameters on 13 of 14 tasks scored independently of its training teacher. Across 21 external data sets, its aggregate performance approached that of the strongest tested 27-billion-parameter model, with 6.4-fold faster inference in a matched workload. Integrating CS1-4B with a language model agent produced cited answers over complete multi-year patient histories and screened a patient population against the eligibility criteria of 17 registered clinical trials, placing four times as many judged-eligible patients among its top 20 candidates as keyword search while using 690-fold fewer language-model tokens than a language model reading every record. These findings support a division of labour in clinical AI, with small decision models performing repeated record reading and generative models formulating questions and synthesizing evidence.
zh_abstract: 临床护理、卫生系统运营和生物医学发现依赖于从患者记录中提取可靠答案，然而在整个人群中应用多样化的临床问题仍然计算成本高昂。在此我们提出Clinical System One（CS1），一个40亿参数的决定模型，用于从临床记录中进行快速、带类型的判断，以及两个智能体框架，在其中CS1与一个通用语言模型协同工作。CS1-4B基于来自一个多医院卫生系统360万名患者的1240万个问题与答案进行训练，结合了结构化数据键、观察到的结局以及跨临床笔记、诊断报告和患者时间线的语言模型监督。它无需针对特定任务重新训练，即可在单次前向传播中回答多个带类型的问题，并且每个答案都附带一个概率，可将不确定病例转交人工审查。在963,408名留出患者上，CS1-4B在14项任务中的13项上优于参数最多达270亿的开放决策模型，这些任务独立于其训练教师评分。在21个外部数据集上，其总体性能接近测试中最强的270亿参数模型，在匹配工作负载下推理速度快6.4倍。将CS1-4B与语言模型智能体集成后，可在完整的多年患者病史基础上生成带引用的答案，并按照17项注册临床试验的资格标准筛选患者人群，在其前20名候选者中纳入的被判定符合资格患者数量是关键词搜索的4倍，同时使用的语言模型token比让语言模型阅读每条记录少690倍。这些发现支持临床AI中的分工，即小型决策模型执行重复的记录阅读，生成模型提出问题并综合证据。

title: Long COVID undercoding and prediction from releasable electronic health record summaries in All of Us
zh_title: All of Us 中长新冠编码不足与预测
summary: 基于 All of Us 电子病历摘要估计长新冠编码不足，并构建可复现的后续编码预测模型。
key_points: 23,790 名 COVID-19 成人中约 1/9 有长新冠编码
仅用公开计数重建模型，预测后续 U09.9 编码
在 18 个留出站点做外部验证
reason: 大样本多站点留出验证，但方法较简、无临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: Objective: To estimate Long COVID undercoding in electronic health records (EHRs) against federal survey prevalence, and to evaluate a predictor of later coding that anyone can rebuild from counts a research enclave releases. Materials and Methods: Among 23,790 All of Us adults with COVID-19, we compared coded shares with Household Pulse Survey prevalence. Among 23,300 adults uncoded at day 90, we predicted a first U09.9 code by day 455. We fitted naive Bayes and linear discriminant models outside the enclave from released counts and compared them with an elastic net fitted inside to the same patients and features. Tests were a random 20% of patients (4,680, 50 coded) and 18 held-out EHR sites (5,760, 60 coded). Results: Under survey-comparability assumptions, about 1 in 9 adults who ever had Long COVID carried its code, and the women-to-men coding ratio was 0.79 (95% sensitivity interval, 0.65-0.95). The released models' areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROCs) were 0.68 (95% CI, 0.60-0.75) on the patient test and 0.64 (0.55-0.72) at held-out sites, 0.049 (0.001-0.104) above the elastic net. On the patient test, the elastic net had a higher area under the precision-recall curve (difference 0.062, 0.003-0.122). Released probabilities overestimated coding risk at held-out sites. Discussion: Fitting from released counts did not consistently lower discrimination. Coded outcomes inform disease discrimination only under stated coding assumptions. Conclusion: Long COVID is substantially and unevenly undercoded, and a model rebuilt from public counts predicts its later coding with moderate discrimination.
zh_abstract: 【目的】估计电子健康记录（EHR）中对 Long COVID 的编码不足情况，并与联邦调查患病率进行比较，同时评估一种可后编码预测因素，任何人均可从研究封闭环境（enclave）发布的计数中重建该预测因素。【材料与方法】在23,790名患有 COVID-19 的 All of Us 成人中，我们将已编码比例与 Household Pulse Survey 患病率进行比较。在23,300名第90天时未编码的成人中，我们预测第455天前首次出现 U09.9 编码。我们根据已发布计数在研究封闭环境外拟合 naive Bayes 和线性判别模型，并将其与在同一批患者和相同特征上于封闭环境内拟合的 elastic net 进行比较。测试集为随机20%患者（4,680人，50人已编码）和18个留出 EHR 站点（5,760人，60人已编码）。【结果】在调查可比性假设下，约每9名曾经患有 Long COVID 的成人中就有1人带有其编码，女性与男性编码比为0.79（95% sensitivity interval，0.65-0.95）。已发布模型在受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）方面，在患者测试集上为0.68（95% CI，0.60-0.75），在留出站点为0.64（0.55-0.72），比 elastic net 高0.049（0.001-0.104）。在患者测试集上，elastic net 的精确率-召回率曲线下面积更高（差异0.062，0.003-0.122）。已发布概率在留出站点高估了编码风险。【讨论】根据已发布计数进行拟合并未持续降低区分度。已编码结局只有在所述编码假设下才能为疾病区分提供信息。【结论】Long COVID 存在显著且不均衡的编码不足，而从公开计数重建的模型以中等区分度预测其后续编码。

title: DART: Scaling a Shape Representation Across Anatomical Classes and Imaging Modalities
zh_title: DART：跨解剖类别与模态的通用形状表征
summary: 提出基于扩散与文本解剖描述的共享形状表征，用于修正分割结果，在13个公开基准上评估。
key_points: 从分割概率学习共享形状表征，无需新体素标注
以解剖文本描述修正分割，不使用医学图像
13个公开基准测试，个案Dice提升最高31%
reason: 跨13个公开基准评估、方法有新意，但为预印本且无临床结局
abstract: Current state-of-the-art segmentation models still produce anatomically implausible shapes, such as broken vessels and fragmented glands, on the structures that are hardest to segment. Learned shape representations capture what structures look like and can help correct these errors, but most cover a fixed set of anatomical classes. Extending this coverage across classes and imaging modalities is costly because it often requires new voxel-level annotations. We propose Diffusion for Anatomical Reshaping with Text (DART), which learns a shared shape representation from segmentation probabilities. It uses anatomical descriptions to correct these probabilities without receiving medical images. Across 13 public benchmarks, absolute Dice gains reach 31% for individual gallbladder cases in CT and 10% for individual prostate cases in MRI. Using existing segmentation predictions, we scale a single shape representation from 50 to 377 anatomical classes without new voxel-level annotations for correction training. The shared representation also corrects four lesion classes absent from training and transfers from CT to MRI without retraining. Corrected labels also improve segmentation models, raising one model's Dice from 57.1% to 67.5%. The same pipeline supports annotations for 45,000 CT scans. These results suggest that sharing shape information within and across classes can reduce the need for new voxel-level annotations when extending segmentation to more anatomical classes and imaging modalities. The model is available at https://huggingface.co/Koushik45/DART-Seg
zh_abstract: 当前最先进的分割模型在最难分割的结构上仍会产生解剖学上不合理的形状，例如血管断裂和腺体碎片化。学习到的形状表示能够捕捉结构的外观，并有助于纠正这些错误，但大多数仅覆盖固定的解剖类别集合。将这种覆盖扩展到跨类别和跨成像模态成本高昂，因为这通常需要新的体素级标注。我们提出 Diffusion for Anatomical Reshaping with Text（DART），它从分割概率中学习共享形状表示。该方法使用解剖描述来纠正这些概率，而无需接收医学图像。在 13 个公开基准上，CT 中单个胆囊病例的绝对 Dice 增益达到 31%，MRI 中单个前列腺病例的绝对 Dice 增益达到 10%。利用现有分割预测，我们将单一形状表示从 50 个解剖类别扩展到 377 个解剖类别，而无需用于校正训练的新体素级标注。该共享表示还能纠正训练中未出现的四个病变类别，并在无需重新训练的情况下从 CT 迁移到 MRI。校正后的标签还能改进分割模型，将某一模型的 Dice 从 57.1% 提高到 67.5%。同一流程支持 45,000 张 CT 扫描的标注。这些结果表明，在将分割扩展到更多解剖类别和成像模态时，在类别内和类别间共享形状信息可以减少对新体素级标注的需求。模型可在 https://huggingface.co/Koushik45/DART-Seg 获取。

title: MMedAgent-Plus: Scaling Multimodal Medical Agents across Modalities, Tasks and Workflows
zh_title: MMedAgent-Plus：跨模态任务的多模态医疗智能体
summary: 构建整合18个专科模型、覆盖12项任务8种模态的多模态医疗工具调用智能体，并在公开基准评测。
key_points: 视觉语言规划器调度18个专科模型、8种模态
用32个公开医学基准的20.9万样本做指令微调
分别评测工具编排、回答合成与端到端执行
reason: 大规模公开基准评测与工具编排设计有参考价值，但为预印本且无临床落地验证
abstract: Medical workflows often require multiple interdependent analyses, but existing specialist and generalist AI models are not designed to coordinate them. We introduce MMedAgent-Plus, a multimodal medical tool-use agent that combines a vision-language planner with 18 leading specialist models spanning 12 tasks and 8 modalities. Through a unified tool interface, the planner selects specialists, executes them in sequence, and synthesizes responses grounded in their outputs. The planner is instruction-tuned on 208,928 samples from 32 public medical benchmarks, covering single- and multi-tool interactions across single and multiple rounds. We separately evaluate tool orchestration, response synthesis, and end-to-end execution on held-out samples. MMedAgent-Plus achieves tool-call accuracies of 91.0%, 98.1%, and 80.7% in single-tool multi-round, multi-tool multi-round, and multi-tool single-round settings, respectively. Given correct tool outputs, MMedAgent-Plus achieves scores of 14.4-14.8 out of 15 for faithfulness, completeness, and conciseness across 600 evaluation samples. In end-to-end execution without pre-supplied tool outputs, MMedAgent-Plus correctly invokes the required specialist in 90.6% of 350 evaluation cases spanning seven tasks. Its final-answer accuracy reaches 0.98, matching the dedicated leading specialist and exceeding the strongest baseline (0.28).
zh_abstract: 医疗工作流程通常需要多项相互依赖的分析，但现有的专科和通用 AI 模型并非为协调这些分析而设计。我们提出 MMedAgent-Plus，一种多模态医疗工具使用智能体，它将视觉-语言规划器与 18 个领先的专科模型相结合，覆盖 12 项任务和 8 种模态。通过统一的工具接口，规划器选择专科模型，按顺序执行它们，并基于其输出合成回答。规划器在来自 32 个公开医疗基准的 208,928 个样本上进行指令微调，涵盖单轮和多轮中的单工具和多工具交互。我们在留出样本上分别评估工具编排、回答合成和端到端执行。MMedAgent-Plus 在单工具多轮、多工具多轮和多工具单轮设置中分别达到 91.0%、98.1% 和 80.7% 的工具调用准确率。给定正确的工具输出，MMedAgent-Plus 在 600 个评估样本上在忠实性、完整性和简洁性方面获得 15 分中的 14.4–14.8 分。在未预先提供工具输出的端到端执行中，MMedAgent-Plus 在跨越七项任务的 350 个评估案例中，有 90.6% 正确调用了所需的专科模型。其最终答案准确率达到 0.98，与专门的领先专科模型相当，并超过最强基线（0.28）。

title: Discrete Neural Interlingua for Ontology-Agnostic EHR Modeling
zh_title: MEDIATOR：跨本体EHR离散神经中间语建模
summary: 提出本体无关的离散分词器，将临床概念文本映射到共享向量量化码本，缓解EHR跨系统不兼容。
key_points: 把临床概念文本编码为共享向量量化码本
无需人工映射与固定词表，实现开放词表分词
以MIMIC-III训练的封闭词表仅覆盖eICU 13%事件为问题切入
reason: 针对EHR基础模型分词瓶颈的新方法、跨数据集验证，但为预印本
abstract: EHR foundation models promise scalable clinical prediction across health systems, yet their deployment is constrained by a tokenization bottleneck. The same clinical concept can appear as different ontology codes, local identifiers, synonyms, or free-text descriptions, which standard EHR tokenizers treat as unrelated symbols. A model trained on MIMIC-III with a closed-vocabulary tokenizer can use only 13% of eICU events. We introduce MEDIATOR, a discrete ontology-agnostic tokenizer that maps any clinical concept expressed as text into a shared vector-quantized codebook, turning EHR harmonization into open-vocabulary tokenization without manual mappings or a fixed vocabulary. Trained with synonym supervision and guided by enriched concept descriptions, code co-occurrence, and relation graphs, MEDIATOR collapses equivalent expressions while organizing distinct concepts in a medically meaningful discrete space. Used as the token interface of an EHR Transformer, MEDIATOR improves mean AUPRC over the strongest prior tokenizer by 4.0 points (8% relative) on 20 MIMIC-III tasks and by 8.6 points (29% relative) in zero-shot transfer to 14 eICU tasks, where it uses all events. The transfer gain combines coverage and representation, as MEDIATOR remains the best tokenizer under identical inputs (+1.0 and +1.9 points on operational and subcohort-mortality tasks). Same-encoder controls show that the text encoder drives in-domain accuracy, while the learned objectives of MEDIATOR drive transfer robustness and entity-linking quality. MEDIATOR also enables transferable attribution across hospitals.
zh_abstract: EHR 基础模型有望实现跨卫生系统的可扩展临床预测，但其部署受到分词瓶颈的制约。同一临床概念可能表现为不同的本体代码、本地标识符、同义词或自由文本描述，而标准 EHR 分词器将其视为不相关的符号。在 MIMIC-III 上使用封闭词表分词器训练的模型只能使用 eICU 事件的 13%。我们提出 MEDIATOR，一种离散的、与本体无关的分词器，它将任何以文本表达的临床概念映射到一个共享的向量量化码本中，将 EHR 协调转化为开放词表分词，而无需手动映射或固定词表。在同义词监督下训练，并在增强的概念描述、代码共现和关系图的引导下，MEDIATOR 将等价表达合并，同时在具有医学意义的离散空间中组织不同概念。作为 EHR Transformer 的分词接口使用，MEDIATOR 在 20 项 MIMIC-III 任务上将平均 AUPRC 较最强的先前分词器提高 4.0 个点（相对 8%），在零样本迁移到 14 项 eICU 任务时提高 8.6 个点（相对 29%），其中它使用了所有事件。迁移增益结合了覆盖率和表征，因为 MEDIATOR 在相同输入下仍是最佳分词器（在 operational 和 subcohort-mortality 任务上分别提高 +1.0 和 +1.9 个点）。相同编码器对照表明，文本编码器驱动域内准确率，而 MEDIATOR 的学习目标驱动迁移鲁棒性和实体链接质量。MEDIATOR 还支持跨医院的可迁移归因。

title: What Language Adds, and at What Cost: Four Controlled Probes of Pathology Vision-Language Models
zh_title: 病理视觉语言模型：语言带来什么、代价几何
summary: 用受控探针在公开数据与已发布权重上检验病理视觉语言模型中语言模态的增益，指出现有评测各自为政。
key_points: 报告文本嵌入提升预后C-index约0.02
1633例TCGA患者、多癌种汇总分析
推理阶段提示词未带来可测精度提升
reason: 预印本、公开数据与权重、对照严谨但无前瞻或临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: Vision--language models (VLMs) promise to make computational pathology queryable and able to draft reports, but how much language adds beyond the vision backbone is unclear, because almost every system is evaluated by its developers on test sets of their own choosing. We grade published evidence by how it was produced and test four claims with controlled probes that reuse released checkpoints and public data, varying one input at a time. Report text adds prognostic signal: adding a frozen embedding of the stage-redacted report to a slide embedding raises the pooled C-index by 0.019 for progression-free interval and by 0.016 for overall survival across 1{,}633 TCGA patients, and restoring the stage statement adds nothing. Prompts add no measurable accuracy at inference: with features and pooling fixed, zero-shot classification is statistically indistinguishable from a supervised linear probe for lung and renal cancer subtyping. Slide-level question answering is barely grounded: SlideChat answers 74.82\% of SlideBench-VQA(TCGA) items correctly with the slide and 74.41\% without it, whereas its language backbone alone reaches 43.52\%. Paraphrasing leaves accuracy unchanged but flips 8--23\% of answers. Self-reported gains from agentic navigation and few-shot language priors cannot yet be attributed to language. Language thus adds real but narrow value, and we propose minimum controls that would expose these failure modes in future evaluations.
zh_abstract: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）有望使计算病理学可查询并能够起草报告，但语言在视觉骨干之外增加了多少仍不清楚，因为几乎每个系统都由其开发者在自行选择的测试集上评估。我们根据已发表证据的产生方式对其进行分级，并用受控探针检验四项主张，这些探针复用已发布的检查点和公开数据，每次改变一个输入。报告文本增加了预后信号：在 1,633 名 TCGA 患者中，将分期信息被遮蔽的报告的冻结嵌入加入切片嵌入，使无进展间期的汇总 C-index 提高 0.019，使总生存期的汇总 C-index 提高 0.016，而恢复分期陈述没有增加任何内容。提示词在推理时没有增加可测量的准确率：在特征和池化固定的情况下，对于肺癌和肾癌亚型分类，零样本分类与监督线性探针在统计上不可区分。切片级问答几乎没有基础：SlideChat 在有切片时正确回答 74.82% 的 SlideBench-VQA(TCGA) 条目，在没有切片时正确回答 74.41%，而其单独的语言骨干达到 43.52%。复述使准确率保持不变，但会翻转 8–23% 的答案。来自智能体导航和少样本语言先验的自我报告增益目前尚不能归因于语言。因此，语言增加了真实但狭窄的价值，我们提出最低限度的对照，以在未来评估中暴露这些失效模式。

title: Critical assessment in the age of AI: challenges and opportunities for computational biology.
zh_title: AI时代计算生物学的评测批判
summary: 评述计算生物学基准评测体系在AI方法兴起后面临的数据纠缠、泄漏、可复现性等挑战。
key_points: 现有基准设施难以适配AI方法
数据泄漏与数据来源不稳定成主要问题
封闭模型削弱结果可复现性
reason: 同行评审观点/评述文章，具方法学讨论价值，按规则上限档内取5
abstract: [Bioinformatics advances] Effective computational tool development depends on our ability to measure progress with rigorous benchmarking, allowing developers to showcase advances and users to select the best of the available options. Computational biology has developed a robust infrastructure of benchmarking standards, tools/resources, and best practices to allow for rigorous and unbiased assessment. This infrastructure, however, faces growing challenges as modern artificial intelligence (AI) methods move to the forefront of computational analysis. The field has imperfectly adapted to issues problematic for benchmarking AI methods, including data entanglement, data leakage, problem-specific performance, limited theoretical guarantees, elusive ground-truth, opaque and often closed models that make reproducibility of results difficult, and dependence on impermanent data sources. In this paper, we consider how the field should tackle benchmarking in the AI era. We revisit why benchmarking matters and its history in computational biology, examine emerging AI-specific challenges, and outline practical paths forward. We argue that benchmarks should be treated as long-lived community infrastructure rather than one-off artifacts bundled with individual papers. We envision a future of critical assessment i.e. dynamic and responsive to evolving use cases, sustaining progress for advancing science in the age of AI. N/A.
zh_abstract: [Bioinformatics advances] 有效的计算工具开发取决于我们通过严格基准测试衡量进展的能力，这使开发者能够展示进展，用户能够从可用选项中选出最佳方案。计算生物学已建立起由基准测试标准、工具/资源和最佳实践构成的稳健基础设施，以支持严格且无偏的评估。然而，随着现代人工智能（AI）方法走向计算分析前沿，该基础设施面临日益增长的挑战。该领域对基准测试AI方法时存在问题的适应并不完善，这些问题包括数据纠缠、数据泄漏、特定问题的性能、有限的理论保证、难以捉摸的真实基准、不透明且往往闭源的模型（使结果可重复性困难）以及对非永久数据源的依赖。本文中，我们思考该领域在AI时代应如何应对基准测试。我们重新审视基准测试为何重要及其在计算生物学中的历史，考察新出现的AI特有挑战，并概述切实可行的前进路径。我们认为，基准测试应被视为长期存续的社区基础设施，而非与单篇论文捆绑的一次性制品。我们设想一种批判性评估的未来，即动态且响应不断演变的使用场景，在AI时代持续推动科学进步。不适用。

title: LongVerse: verified AI agents for Nanopore and PacBio DNA methylation analysis
zh_title: LongVerse：长读长甲基化分析智能体
summary: 预印本发布智能体系统，将一句英文指令转为Nanopore/PacBio读段单倍型分辨的DNA甲基化分析。
key_points: 智能体调用固定流程而不自行写代码
HG002上与人类专家结果完全一致
与亚硫酸盐测序相关性0.943/0.884
共识智能体较最佳已发表调用器误差降低10.7%
reason: 有专家与正交方法对照，但为预印本、验证限于单一参考样本
abstract: AI agents now run sequencing pipelines, but their outputs are checked by proxy, with rubrics or language-model judges. LongVerse turns one English sentence into haplotype-resolved DNA methylation from Nanopore or PacBio reads, through agents that read the data, supply arguments to a pinned pipeline and never write code. On HG002, a healthy reference genome, agent and human expert produced byte-identical calls (r = 1.000) that agreed with bisulfite sequencing (r = 0.943, 0.884), at $0.12 to $0.54 of conversation per run. A consensus agent that admits any per-site caller reduced error 10.7 percent against the best published caller.
zh_abstract: AI 智能体现已可运行测序流程，但其输出通过代理方式（用评分细则或语言模型裁判）进行检查。LongVerse 将一句英文转换为来自 Nanopore 或 PacBio 读段（reads）的单倍型解析 DNA 甲基化（haplotype-resolved DNA methylation），其过程由读取数据、为固定流程（pinned pipeline）提供参数且从不编写代码的智能体完成。在 HG002（一个健康参考基因组）上，智能体与人类专家产生了字节完全一致的检出结果（calls）（r = 1.000），且与亚硫酸氢盐测序（bisulfite sequencing）一致（r = 0.943、0.884），每次运行的对话成本为 0.12 至 0.54 美元。一个接受任一单位点检出器（per-site caller）的共识智能体（consensus agent）相较于已发表的最佳检出器将误差降低了 10.7%。

title: Does Multi-Agent Collaboration Reduce Hallucination in Clinical Tasks?
zh_title: 多智能体协作能否降低临床任务中的幻觉
summary: 在4个模型、3项临床任务上评估单模型基线与3种多智能体拓扑的推理幻觉，发现协作提升任务表现但不必然降低幻觉。
key_points: 覆盖4个模型与3项临床任务
按事实性与忠实性分类评分推理过程
未发现稳定更优的多智能体拓扑
reason: 多模型多任务系统评测预印本，角度有新意但无临床外部验证
abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems improve performance on clinical tasks, and that improvement is often read as evidence of a more trustworthy system. However, the two are not the same claim. A clinician acts on the stated reasoning and not only on the conclusion, so whether collaboration reduces hallucination, and what decides when it does, has to be measured in the reasoning too. Yet most evaluations score only the final answer. We evaluate four systems (a single-LLM baseline and three multi-agent topologies) across four models and three clinical tasks, scoring hallucination, under a factuality and faithfulness taxonomy, inside the rationale each system generates and reporting it alongside the task metric. We report that collaboration buys task performance but not lower hallucination as a rule, and no topology is reliably better than another. The effect differs by model: of the $36$ model--system--task comparisons, $12$ are large enough to resolve --- four decreases and eight increases, with no model on both sides. What sets the level, and the direction of any change, is the model rather than the topology or the number of agents. A self-correction experiment is consistent with this: shown its own flagged errors, every model except Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct reduces hallucination; the one model for which collaboration lowers hallucination gains the most, and Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, the model whose hallucination it amplifies most, does not reduce its hallucination at all. We find that collaboration redistributes what its models can already do; it does not supply what they cannot.
zh_abstract: 多智能体大语言模型（LLM）系统可改善临床任务表现，而这种改善常被解读为系统更可信的证据。然而，二者并非同一主张。临床医生依据所陈述的推理而不仅是结论采取行动，因此协作是否减少幻觉，以及何时减少由什么决定，也必须在推理中进行测量。然而，大多数评估只对最终答案评分。我们在四种模型和三项临床任务中评估了四个系统（一个单 LLM 基线 and 三种多智能体拓扑结构），在事实性与忠实性分类体系下，对每个系统生成的推理依据内部的幻觉进行评分，并将其与任务指标一起报告。我们报告，协作通常能换来任务性能提升，但并不能作为规律降低幻觉，且没有一种拓扑结构可靠地优于另一种。该效应因模型而异：在 36 个模型—系统—任务比较中，有 12 个差异大到足以分辨——4 个下降、8 个上升，且没有任何模型同时出现在两侧。决定水平以及任何变化方向的是模型，而不是拓扑结构或智能体数量。一项自我纠正实验与这一结论一致：在向其展示其自身被标记的错误后，除 Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct 外，每个模型都减少了幻觉；协作能降低其幻觉的那一个模型获益最大，而 Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct 是协作将其幻觉放大得最多的模型，其幻觉完全没有降低。我们发现，协作重新分配其模型已经能做到的事情；它并不提供模型做不到的事情。

title: Scaling Vision Foundation Models for Toxicologic Pathology
zh_title: 毒理病理视觉基础模型TOX-FM
summary: 在超百万张全切片、14万余项毒理研究上训练非临床病理基础模型，并构建18项下游任务基准。
key_points: 覆盖60个器官、6个物种、60年研究
设18项非临床与9项临床下游任务
与临床病理基础模型跨域对比评估
reason: 数据规模大且含跨域对比，但为预印本、未说明公开与外部验证
abstract: Here, we present TOX-FM, a family of non-clinical PFMs trained on large-scale diverse histopathology datasets of over one million whole slide images consisting of over 60 organs across six animal species from over 14,000 toxicology studies across six decades. We introduce a comprehensive benchmark of 18 non-clinical downstream tasks, incorporate an established benchmark of 9 clinical downstream tasks, and evaluate TOX-FM against state-of-the-art clinical PFMs across both non-clinical and clinical domains. Notably, we explore open questions surrounding domain-specific training and cross-domain generalization, offering insights into the opportunities and challenges of applying PFMs in the non-clinical domain.

title: Large-Scale Biomedical RAG: Corpus Scaling, Document Representation, and Efficiency Trade-offs

abstract: We present a controlled, large-scale evaluation of how corpus scale, document representation, and reranking affect the effectiveness and efficiency of biomedical Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems. Retrieval collections were progressively expanded while retaining the relevant source documents, enabling consistent comparisons across corpus sizes. We compared abstract, flat full-text, and hierarchical full-text representations across first-stage retrieval, reranking, and end-to-end multiple-choice question answering. Configurations selected on development data were evaluated on five external biomedical benchmarks and a held-out test set, while retrieval latency and index storage were measured to quantify operational cost. Performance patterns observed with small or controlled collections did not consistently persist as collections grew, and the usefulness of reranking depended on the corpus and retrieval setting. RAG improved three of four model configurations across the external benchmarks, with mean gains of up to 9.6 percentage points, and improved all four configurations on the held-out test set by 10.2-30.3 points. Abstract retrieval performed best when reference evidence was abstract-aligned, whereas full-text representations were generally more effective when richer evidence was needed. Hierarchical representation matched or outperformed flat full-text retrieval in most end-to-end comparisons while requiring 67% fewer indexed units and 44-56% less storage. These findings show that corpus scale should be treated as an explicit evaluation variable in biomedical RAG, and that the most appropriate design depends on evidence format, model behavior, and operational constraints.

title: Function-based Deep Learning Autoencoder for Passive Shimming in a Portable MRI Magnet with Enhanced Field Homogeneity.

abstract: [IEEE transactions on bio-medical engineering] High-field magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) offers excellent sensitivity and spatial resolution, yet its substantial cost and limited mobility restrict deployment in decentralized or resource-constrained environments. Portable MRI systems offer a complementary imaging modality to high-field MRI, but their performance depends critically on the uniformity of the main magnetic field (B0). Passive shimming, achieved by placing ferromagnetic materials within the magnet bore, is widely used to correct spatial field variations. Existing optimization strategies- including linear programming and evolutionary algorithms-can improve B homogeneity, but often struggle to achieve an effective trade-off among field strength, uniformity, and shim mass. To address this challenge, a function-based deep learning autoencoder (FDLAE) is proposed to optimize the spatial distribution of passive shims. The framework operates without a precompiled dataset and performs online self-supervised learning to iteratively refine the shim configuration. This approach improves B0 homogeneity from 4873 ppm to 547 ppm (parts per million) and increases the average field strength from 80.402 mT to 80.948 mT. Compared with linear programming (LP), it achieved lower inhomogeneity, reduced the shim mass by 0.29 kg, and shortened the optimization time from approximately 1.2 to 0.5 h. MRiLab simulations also showed a reduction in image NRMSE from 0.889 to 0.543. Relative to genetic-algorithm-based shimming, the resulting field uniformity is improved by nearly a factor of five. These results demonstrate that FDLAE may provide an efficient and comparatively robust passive-shimming approach for portable MRI magnets.
zh_abstract: [IEEE transactions on bio-medical engineering] 高场磁共振成像（MRI）具有出色的灵敏度和空间分辨率，但其高昂成本和有限移动性限制了在分散或资源受限环境中的部署。便携式 MRI 系统提供了高场 MRI 的补充成像模式，但其性能关键取决于主磁场（B0）的均匀性。无源匀场通过将铁磁材料放置在磁体孔内实现，被广泛用于校正空间场变化。现有优化策略——包括线性规划和进化算法——可以改善 B 均匀性，但往往难以在场强、均匀性和匀场质量之间实现有效权衡。为应对这一挑战，提出一种基于函数的深度学习自编码器（function-based deep learning autoencoder, FDLAE）来优化无源匀场器的空间分布。该框架无需预编译数据集即可运行，并执行在线自监督学习以迭代细化匀场配置。该方法将 B0 均匀性从 4873 ppm 提高到 547 ppm（parts per million，百万分之一），并将平均场强从 80.402 mT 提高到 80.948 mT。与线性规划（linear programming, LP）相比，它实现了更低的不均匀性，将匀场质量减少 0.29 kg，并将优化时间从约 1.2 h 缩短至 0.5 h。MRiLab 仿真还显示图像 NRMSE 从 0.889 降至 0.543。相对于基于遗传算法的匀场，所得场均匀性提高了近五倍。这些结果表明，FDLAE 可为便携式 MRI 磁体提供一种高效且相对稳健的无源匀场方法。

abstract: [Journal of neural engineering] Objective. Speech Brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) have emerged as a pivotal technology in facilitating communication for individuals with speech impairments. Utilizing electroencephalography (EEG) for noninvasive speech BCIs offers an accessible and affordable solution, potentially benefiting a broader audience. However, EEG-based speech decoding remains controversial especially for overt speech, due to difficulties in separating speech-related neural activities from myoelectric potential artifacts generated during articulation. Moreover, because paradigms for collecting covert speech data are inherently less scalable than those for overt speech, whether the neural dynamics underlying EEG-based decoding of overt speech are also present during covert speech remains an open and practically important question. Approach. Here we aim to delineate the extent of the neural contributions to EEG-based speech decoding, and the degree to which the underlying neural dynamics are shared across overt and covert speech, by employing Explainable AI techniques to a convolutional neural network predicting spoken words based on signals obtained by ultra-high-density (uhd)-EEG. Main results. We found that electrode-wise contributions to the decoding cannot be explained by their mutual information with electromyography (EMG). Furthermore, contributing periods of speech to EEG-based decoding are distinct from those to decoding solely relying on EMG. In contrast, there are significant overlaps in signal timings contributing to EEG-based decoding, regardless of vocal conditions such as overt or covert speech. Notably, the denoising process successfully enhanced the decoding contribution from electrodes within speech-related brain areas for all speech conditions. Significance. Altogether, our findings support the idea that, with appropriate preprocessing, EEG becomes a valuable tool for decoding spoken words based on underlying neural activities. .
zh_abstract: [Journal of neural engineering]【目的】言语脑机接口（BCIs）已成为促进言语障碍个体交流的关键技术。利用脑电图（EEG）实现无创言语 BCI 提供了一种易获取且可负担的解决方案，可能惠及更广泛的人群。然而，基于 EEG 的言语解码仍存在争议，尤其是对于外显言语（overt speech），因为难以将言语相关神经活动与发音过程中产生的肌电电位伪迹分开。此外，由于收集内隐言语（covert speech）数据的范式本质上不如外显言语的范式可扩展，基于 EEG 解码外显言语的潜在神经动力学是否也存在于内隐言语期间，仍是一个开放且具有实际重要性的问题。【方法】在此，我们通过将可解释 AI 技术应用于一个卷积神经网络，旨在刻画神经活动对基于 EEG 的言语解码的贡献程度，以及潜在神经动力学在外显和内隐言语之间的共享程度；该网络基于超高密度（uhd）-EEG 获得的信号预测说出的词语。【主要结果】我们发现，各电极对解码的贡献不能由其与肌电图（EMG）的互信息来解释。此外，言语中对基于 EEG 的解码有贡献的时段不同于仅依赖 EMG 解码时有贡献的时段。相比之下，无论发声条件如外显或内隐言语如何，对基于 EEG 的解码有贡献的信号时间点存在显著重叠。值得注意的是，去噪过程成功增强了所有言语条件下言语相关脑区内电极的解码贡献。【意义】总之，我们的发现支持这一观点：通过适当的预处理，EEG 成为基于潜在神经活动解码说出的词语的有价值工具。

abstract: [Journal of imaging informatics in medicine] Current light-based devices, such as laser hair removal, intense pulsed light (IPL), vascular laser therapy, and dermatologic phototherapy, are widely used in clinical dermatology but rely heavily on subjective manual parameterization or uncalibrated point-based colorimeters. To overcome these limitations, this work presents a unified system for hair segmentation and skin characterization in macroscopic dermatological images. Unlike most existing literature that relies on dermoscopic datasets captured under highly controlled conditions, our approach is specifically designed for macroscopic images that replicate real clinical laser treatments. The proposed pipeline integrates a custom-trained variant of the YOLOv9 deep learning architecture for instance segmentation and classical image processing within a single workflow to extract objective skin and hair parameters such as phototype, hair density, color, and thickness. A color calibration stage using spectrophotometric measurements ensures accurate feature estimation regardless of illumination conditions. Experimental results show competitive segmentation metrics (mAP@50 ≈ 0.80) on a custom dataset featuring short, shaved hairs, typical of pre-treatment scenarios. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed pipeline in providing the objective, foundational skin and hair features required for future automated laser parameterization, paving the way for its extension to broader light-based medical therapies.
zh_abstract: [Journal of imaging informatics in medicine] 当前基于光的设备，如激光脱毛、强脉冲光（IPL）、血管激光治疗和皮肤科光疗，在临床皮肤科中广泛使用，但严重依赖主观的人工参数设置或未校准的基于点的色度计。为克服这些局限性，本工作提出了一种用于宏观皮肤科图像中毛发分割和皮肤表征的统一系统。与大多数依赖在高度受控条件下采集的皮肤镜数据集的现有文献不同，我们的方法专门针对可复现真实临床激光治疗的宏观图像而设计。所提出的流程将用于实例分割的定制训练 YOLOv9 深度学习架构变体与经典图像处理整合到单一工作流中，以提取客观的皮肤和毛发参数，如光型、毛发密度、颜色和厚度。使用分光光度测量进行的颜色校准阶段可确保无论照明条件如何都能准确估计特征。实验结果表明，在包含短小、剃过毛发的自定义数据集（典型于治疗前场景）上，分割指标具有竞争力（mAP@50 ≈ 0.80）。这些发现证明，所提出的流程在提供未来自动化激光参数化所需的客观、基础皮肤和毛发特征方面具有可行性，为其扩展到更广泛的光学医疗疗法铺平了道路。

abstract: [Translational psychiatry] Psychopharmaceutical therapy has seen a lack of improvement in efficacy, highlighting the need for a more individualized treatment approach that optimally leverages pharmaceutical effects. To achieve this, it is necessary to identify factors that can predict psychological attributes and treatment outcomes. We hypothesize that brain morphology may serve as a predictor of performance in psychological tests. A 7-Tesla-MRI system was used to measure 74 transdiagnostic patients and 41 healthy controls. Values for grey matter volume (GMV), cortical thickness and gyrification based on the Schaefer 100 Atlas for parcellation were determined. Using this morphological data, performance in a Trail-Making Test (TMT) - A and B was predicted with the help of a deep learning model. A SHAP analysis was conducted to identify the key variables important for the model. The accuracy in predicting TMT performance was very good at 0.795. The most decisive feature influencing predictions was gyrification. Areas indicating inter-group differences were focused in the frontal cortex, as well as in temporal and parietal regions. Morphological characteristics can predict test performance with high accuracy. These results support the implementation of a transdiagnostic approach in clinical practice to better address the underlying pathophysiology. Symptom prediction based on neuroimaging data appears to be an achievable goal.
zh_abstract: [Translational psychiatry] 精神药物治疗在疗效方面缺乏改善，这突出表明需要一种更个体化的治疗方法，以最佳利用药物效应。为实现这一目标，有必要确定能够预测心理属性和治疗结局的因素。我们假设大脑形态可以作为心理测试表现的预测因子。使用 7 特斯拉 MRI 系统测量了 74 名跨诊断患者和 41 名健康对照。确定了基于 Schaefer 100 图谱分区计算的灰质体积（GMV）、皮质厚度和脑回化（gyrification）值。利用这些形态学数据，借助深度学习模型预测了连线测验（TMT）-A 和 B 的表现。进行了 SHAP 分析，以识别对模型重要的关键变量。预测 TMT 表现的准确率非常好，为 0.795。影响预测的最决定性特征是脑回化。表明组间差异的区域集中在额叶皮质，以及颞叶和顶叶区域。形态学特征可以高准确率地预测测试表现。这些结果支持在临床实践中实施跨诊断方法，以更好地处理潜在的病理生理学。基于神经影像数据的症状预测似乎是一个可实现的目标。

abstract: [Prehospital and disaster medicine] Triage and data transfer are critical to the medical management of mass-casualty incidents (MCIs). However, the chaotic nature of such events makes it difficult to classify casualties according to structured triage protocols. Furthermore, even when triage is implemented effectively, communication disruptions between the incident scene and dispatch centers can hinder response operations. The aim of this study was to present a drone-integrated system that enables non-contact vital sign measurement, remote triage, and real-time data transmission during MCIs. The system development process involved three steps: (1) developing the Vital-Sign Measurement Module; (2) developing the Triage Decision Support Module; and (3) developing the User Interfaces and Data Transmission Module to enable information transmission between dispatch centers and response teams. Within the Vital-Sign Measurement Module, heart rate (HR), respiratory rate (RR), oxygen saturation (SpO2), and body temperature (BT) measurement algorithms were developed using the following techniques, respectively: video-based photoplethysmography (vPPG), analysis of thermal temperature fluctuations around the nose, a regression-based neural network approach, and heat maps and thermal thresholding. A pilot study was conducted under controlled indoor conditions to evaluate the accuracy of these algorithms. The system can measure vital signs by processing drone-captured images, can provide triage decision support, and can transmit victims' locations, vital signs, and triage categories to response teams and dispatch centers via dedicated user interfaces. A pilot evaluation of the Vital-Sign Measurement Module showed that the relative accuracy rate of the non-contact vital-sign measurement algorithms ranged from 86% to 99%. The system provides an innovative approach to improving medical response management in MCIs by enabling remote triage and monitoring. Its non-contact vital sign measurement, triage decision support, and near real-time data transmission capabilities provide an infrastructure that can contribute to faster response and improved operational coordination. However, further field trials and development are required to improve the robustness of the vital-sign measurement algorithms to motion, to improve their adaptability to changing environmental conditions, and to maintain high accuracy despite individual differences.
zh_abstract: [《院前与灾难医学》]检伤分类和数据传输对于大规模伤亡事件（mass-casualty incidents, MCIs）的医疗管理至关重要。然而，此类事件的混乱性质使得按照结构化检伤分类方案对伤员进行分类变得困难。此外，即使检伤分类得到有效实施，事件现场与调度中心之间的通信中断也可能阻碍响应行动。本研究旨在提出一种无人机集成系统，可在MCIs期间实现非接触式生命体征测量、远程检伤分类和实时数据传输。系统开发过程包括三个步骤：（1）开发生命体征测量模块；（2）开发检伤分类决策支持模块；（3）开发用户界面与数据传输模块，以实现调度中心与响应团队之间的信息传输。在生命体征测量模块中，心率（HR）、呼吸频率（RR）、血氧饱和度（SpO2）和体温（BT）测量算法分别使用以下技术开发：基于视频的光电容积脉搏波描记法（vPPG）、鼻周热温度波动分析、基于回归的神经网络方法，以及热图和热阈值处理。在受控室内条件下开展了一项初步研究，以评估这些算法的准确性。该系统可通过处理无人机拍摄的图像来测量生命体征，可提供检伤分类决策支持，并可通过专用用户界面将伤员位置、生命体征和检伤分类类别传输给响应团队和调度中心。对生命体征测量模块的初步评估显示，非接触式生命体征测量算法的相对准确率范围为86%至99%。该系统通过实现远程检伤分类和监测，为改善MCIs中的医疗响应管理提供了一种创新方法。其非接触式生命体征测量、检伤分类决策支持和近实时数据传输能力提供了一种基础设施，可有助于加快响应并改善行动协调。然而，仍需进一步的现场试验和开发，以提高生命体征测量算法对运动的鲁棒性、改善其对变化环境条件的适应性，并在存在个体差异的情况下保持高准确性。

title: Reinforcement Learning in Healthcare Analytics: Transforming Personalised Medicine and Clinical Decision-Making.
source: PubMed · Journal of evaluation in clinical practice
zh_title: 医疗分析中的强化学习综述
summary: 综述梳理强化学习在个性化治疗、临床决策支持与资源优化中的应用、挑战与方向。
key_points: 涵盖无模型、基于模型、深度与多智能体强化学习
涉及联邦强化学习与可解释强化学习
应用面含慢病管理与机器人辅助医疗
