abstract: [Journal of evaluation in clinical practice] Reinforcement Learning (RL) has emerged as a promising artificial intelligence paradigm for adaptive and sequential decision-making in healthcare, enabling personalised treatment optimisation and intelligent clinical resource management beyond the capabilities of conventional static models. This review aims to examine recent advances in RL for healthcare analytics, focusing on its applications, emerging techniques, challenges, and future research directions. The review studies model-free, model-based, deep reinforcement learning, and multi-agent reinforcement learning techniques applied to personalised treatment planning, chronic disease management, clinical decision support, healthcare resource optimisation, and robotic-assisted healthcare. It also explores Federated Reinforcement Learning (FRL), Explainable Reinforcement Learning (XRL), and longitudinal outcome prediction. The reviewed studies utilise healthcare datasets, including the Osteoporosis Dataset, UCI Heart Disease Dataset, Pima Indians Diabetes Dataset, SEER Cancer Dataset, and MIMIC-IV Dataset. The reviewed studies demonstrate that RL-based approaches support adaptive clinical decision-making, personalised treatment recommendations, improved operational efficiency, and patient outcome prediction. FRL offers opportunities for privacy-preserving collaborative learning, while XRL enhances the transparency and interpretability of clinical decisions. However, challenges remain concerning data quality, reward function design, model interpretability, computational scalability, ethical considerations, and regulatory compliance. R.L has significant potential to advance intelligent healthcare analytics through personalised, adaptive, and efficient clinical solutions. Future research should prioritise privacy preservation, interpretability, scalability, ethical AI, and regulatory compliance to develop safe, reliable, and trustworthy RL-based healthcare systems.
zh_abstract: 在医疗保健中，强化学习（Reinforcement Learning, RL）已成为一种有前景的人工智能范式，用于自适应和序贯决策，能够实现个性化治疗优化和智能临床资源管理，超越传统静态模型的能力。本综述旨在考察RL在医疗保健分析中的最新进展，重点关注其应用、新兴技术、挑战和未来研究方向。本综述研究应用于个性化治疗规划、慢性病管理、临床决策支持、医疗保健资源优化和机器人辅助医疗保健的无模型、基于模型、深度强化学习和多智能体强化学习技术。它还探讨联邦强化学习（Federated Reinforcement Learning, FRL）、可解释强化学习（Explainable Reinforcement Learning, XRL）和纵向结局预测。所综述的研究使用医疗保健数据集，包括 Osteoporosis Dataset、UCI Heart Disease Dataset、Pima Indians Diabetes Dataset、SEER Cancer Dataset 和 MIMIC-IV Dataset。所综述的研究表明，基于RL的方法支持自适应临床决策、个性化治疗建议、提高运营效率和患者结局预测。FRL为隐私保护协作学习提供了机会，而XRL增强了临床决策的透明度和可解释性。然而，在数据质量、奖励函数设计、模型可解释性、计算可扩展性、伦理考量和监管合规方面仍存在挑战。RL具有通过个性化、自适应和高效的临床解决方案推进智能医疗保健分析的巨大潜力。未来研究应优先考虑隐私保护、可解释性、可扩展性、伦理AI和监管合规，以开发安全、可靠和可信的基于RL的医疗保健系统。

title: Self-reported diagnoses as training labels for finding uncoded chronic fatigue, fibromyalgia, and endometriosis in the All of Us Research Program
zh_title: 以自报诊断作训练标签发现未编码病例
summary: 预印本在All of Us中比较以自报诊断与后续诊断编码训练的朴素贝叶斯/弹性网模型，用于识别未编码的慢性疲劳、纤维肌痛与子宫内膜异位症。
key_points: 关注诊断编码缺失患者的病例发现
对比自报标签与后续编码训练模型
另比较仅用公开汇总计数的评分与个体级模型
reason: 方法设计清晰、利用大型队列，但为预印本且证据限于内部比较
abstract: Objective: Case-finding models for underdiagnosed conditions are usually trained on diagnosis codes, which are missing from the records of many patients with a clinical diagnosis. We asked whether models trained on self-reported diagnoses rank uncoded self-reporters higher than models trained on later codes, and how a score fit only from released summary counts compares with a participant-level model. Methods: In the All of Us Research Program, we followed survey respondents with no qualifying diagnosis code by the survey date for later codes. For chronic fatigue, fibromyalgia, and endometriosis (participants recorded as female at birth), we fit a naive Bayes score with empirical-Bayes shrinkage, from released feature-by-label counts for the self-reported diagnosis and from exact counts inside the data enclave for a later code, and an elastic net on participant-level data for each label. In a random 20% validation split, we measured discrimination of self-report, of uncoded self-reporters (no qualifying code observed), and of later codes. Results: For chronic fatigue (149,860 respondents, including 7,770 self-reporters, 95% with no code observed), the summary-count score trained on self-report ranked uncoded self-reporters with an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.74 (95% CI, 0.72-0.75), against 0.67 (95% CI, 0.65-0.69) when trained on later codes. For later codes, the two scores were similar (0.69 vs 0.70). Fibromyalgia showed the same pattern (0.73 vs 0.64 and 0.74 vs 0.72). Elastic nets trained on self-report ranked uncoded self-reporters higher than the summary-count scores (0.80 vs 0.74 and 0.78 vs 0.73) but discriminated later codes less well than code-trained elastic nets. For endometriosis, the self-report score also ranked uncoded self-reporters above the code-trained score (0.61 vs 0.53), but discrimination was low and it did not discriminate later codes (0.50 vs 0.70). Conclusion: The choice of training label changes which patients a case-finding model ranks highly. For all 3 conditions, self-reported diagnoses were the more useful label for finding uncoded self-reporters. For chronic fatigue and fibromyalgia, the self-report score also discriminated later codes as well as the code-trained score. Independent clinical validation is needed before these models guide case finding.
zh_abstract: 【目的】针对诊断不足疾病的病例发现模型通常基于诊断代码训练，而许多有临床诊断的患者的记录中缺失这些代码。我们询问，基于自我报告诊断训练的模型是否比基于后续代码训练的模型对未编码的自我报告者给予更高排名，以及仅基于已发布汇总计数拟合的评分与参与者水平模型相比如何。【方法】在 All of Us Research Program 中，我们对截至调查日期没有合格诊断代码的调查受访者进行随访，以获取后续代码。针对慢性疲劳、纤维肌痛和子宫内膜异位症（出生时记录为女性的参与者），我们拟合了采用经验贝叶斯收缩的朴素贝叶斯评分——分别基于已发布的按特征-标签计数的自我报告诊断和基于数据安全区（data enclave）内针对后续代码的精确计数——以及针对每个标签在参与者水平数据上拟合的弹性网络。在随机20%验证集中，我们测量了对自我报告、未编码的自我报告者（未观察到合格代码）以及后续代码的区分度。【结果】对于慢性疲劳（149,860名受访者，包括7,770名自我报告者，其中95%未观察到代码），基于自我报告训练的汇总计数评分对未编码自我报告者进行排名，受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）为0.74（95% CI，0.72-0.75），而基于后续代码训练时为0.67（95% CI，0.65-0.69）。对于后续代码，两个评分相似（0.69 vs 0.70）。纤维肌痛显示出相同模式（0.73 vs 0.64 和 0.74 vs 0.72）。基于自我报告训练的弹性网络对未编码自我报告者的排名高于汇总计数评分（0.80 vs 0.74 和 0.78 vs 0.73），但对后续代码的区分度低于基于代码训练的弹性网络。对于子宫内膜异位症，自我报告评分对未编码自我报告者的排名也高于基于代码训练的评分（0.61 vs 0.53），但区分度较低，且未能区分后续代码（0.50 vs 0.70）。【结论】训练标签的选择会改变病例发现模型对哪些患者给予高排名。对于所有3种疾病，自我报告诊断是发现未编码自我报告者更有用的标签。对于慢性疲劳和纤维肌痛，自我报告评分对后续代码的区分度也与基于代码训练的评分相当。在这些模型指导病例发现之前，需要进行独立的临床验证。

title: Interpretable Phenotype Discovery Using Temporal Risk-Aware Clustering
zh_title: TRACE：可解释的纵向临床轨迹表型发现
summary: medRxiv预印本提出TRACE，用对比学习与预测表型层从纵向轨迹发现可解释进展表型，在ADNI评估。
key_points: 轨迹与结局感知对比目标
概率预测表型层
双注意力识别关键就诊与变量
reason: 新方法预印本，证据有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Longitudinal clinical cohorts contain heterogeneous progression patterns that are obscured by coarse diagnostic labels. Discovering these latent progression phenotypes requires models that distinguish patients not only by their outcomes, but also by how their clinical trajectories evolve. This paper proposes TRACE, an interpretable temporal phenotyping method that enables the learning of outcome-informed progression phenotypes from longitudinal trajectories. TRACE combines a trajectory- and outcome-aware contrastive objective with a probabilistic predictive phenotype layer, encouraging phenotypes to capture progression structure while remaining predictive of diagnostic state. A dual-attention mechanism further supports interpretation by identifying the visits and clinical variables most associated with each phenotype assignment. TRACE is evaluated on the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) cohort for cognitive disease modeling, showing improved performance in both diagnostic prediction and phenotype discovery compared with other temporal phenotyping baselines. Finally, by allowing the number of phenotypes to exceed the diagnostic labels, TRACE enables discovering additional progression patterns that are not captured by labels defined a priori.
zh_abstract: 纵向临床队列包含异质性进展模式，这些模式被粗粒度诊断标签所掩盖。发现这些潜在进展表型需要模型不仅根据结局区分患者，还要根据其临床轨迹如何演变来区分。本文提出TRACE，一种可解释的时间表型分析方法，能够从纵向轨迹中学习结局信息驱动的进展表型。TRACE将轨迹和结局感知的对比目标与概率预测表型层相结合，促使表型捕获进展结构，同时保持对诊断状态的预测能力。双注意力机制进一步通过识别与每个表型分配最相关的访视和临床变量来支持解释。TRACE在阿尔茨海默病神经影像学倡议（ADNI）队列上针对认知疾病建模进行评估，显示与其他时间表型分析基线相比，在诊断预测和表型发现方面均性能提升。最后，通过允许表型数量超过诊断标签，TRACE能够发现先验定义的标签未捕获的额外进展模式。

title: HypTI: Hyperbolic Geometry-Aware Multimodal Feature Fusion Framework for Dementia Detection Based on Tabular-Image Data
zh_title: HypTI：双曲几何多模态痴呆检测框架
summary: 预印本提出双曲空间融合临床表格与MRI特征进行痴呆检测，联合建模跨模态交互。
key_points: 指出欧氏空间融合忽视层级与多尺度结构
将双曲表示学习扩展至表格-MRI场景
联合建模临床表格、MRI与跨模态交互
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，仅见摘要，未述外部验证
abstract: AI-assisted dementia detection usually requires multimodal fusion of diverse data, such as clinical tabular assessments and neuroimaging data. However, most existing approaches perform feature fusion in Euclidean space. This overlooks the geometric structure of representation, including hierarchical organization in clinical assessments and multi-scale anatomical patterns in neuroimaging data. Recent studies have proved hyperbolic space provides a natural geometry for modelling hierarchical and multi-scale structures due to its exponentially expanding space. Motivated by these, we propose HypTI, a hyperbolic geometry-aware multimodal fusion framework for dementia detection based on clinical tabular assessments and MRI scans. HypTI extends hyperbolic representation learning to an underexplored tabular-MRI setting, jointly modelling clinical tabular, MRI scans, and cross-modal interactions in hyperbolic space. Specifically, clinical tabular variables are represented through learnable Lorentz prototypes to capture hierarchical relationships among assessments, while MRI scans are encoded using ROI-guided multi-scale representation learning to capture anatomical patterns across brain regions and spatial scales in Lorentz space. The multimodal representations are integrated through an adaptive fusion module generates subject-specific scale and shift coefficients to dynamically modulate and integrate the multimodal embeddings, enabling effective patient-level tabular-image representation learning for dementia detection. Experiments on OASIS-3 dataset show that the proposed framework achieves strong performance compared with representative approaches.
zh_abstract: AI辅助痴呆检测通常需要融合多种数据，如临床表格评估和神经影像数据。然而，大多数现有方法在欧几里得空间中进行特征融合。这忽略了表示的几何结构，包括临床评估中的层次组织和神经影像数据中的多尺度解剖模式。近期研究已证明，双曲空间因其指数级扩展的空间，为建模层次和多尺度结构提供了自然的几何结构。受此启发，我们提出HypTI，一种基于临床表格评估和MRI扫描的、几何感知双曲空间的多模态融合框架，用于痴呆检测。HypTI将双曲表示学习扩展到尚未充分探索的表格-MRI场景，在双曲空间中联合建模临床表格、MRI扫描和跨模态交互。具体而言，临床表格变量通过可学习的Lorentz原型表示，以捕捉评估之间的层次关系；MRI扫描则采用ROI引导的多尺度表示学习进行编码，以在Lorentz空间中捕捉跨脑区和空间尺度的解剖模式。多模态表示通过自适应融合模块进行整合，该模块生成受试者特异性的尺度和偏移系数，以动态调制和整合多模态嵌入，从而实现有效的患者级表格-图像表示学习以用于痴呆检测。在OASIS-3数据集上的实验表明，所提出的框架与代表性方法相比取得了强劲性能。

title: Privacy-Preserving Personalized Federated Learning (PPP-FL) for Medical Imaging
zh_title: 面向医学影像的隐私保护个性化联邦学习
summary: 预印本先提出基于DCGAN的联邦学习模型反演攻击，再探讨相应防御，聚焦大规模医学影像。
key_points: 联邦学习仅传更新仍面临隐私攻击
提出贴近真实攻击者能力的模型反演方法
指出集中式攻防策略难以直接迁移至联邦场景
reason: 预印本攻防方法研究，有现实意义但缺少外部验证描述
abstract: Federated learning (FL) is a distributed machine learning paradigm that reduces transmission costs, mitigates cross-border data sharing restrictions, and enhances privacy by keeping raw data on local devices. Clients in FL systems train local models and share only updates, which are aggregated by a central server. While this setup limits direct data exposure, FL remains vulnerable to privacy attacks. Existing attack and defense strategies have largely been developed for centralized systems, and adapting them to FL introduces new challenges due to its unique architecture and training workflow. In this work, we first propose a model inversion attack on FL systems using Deep Convolutional Generative Adversarial Networks (DCGANs) in the context of large-scale medical imaging. Our method operates under realistic assumptions about the attacker's knowledge and capabilities. We then examine the effect of client-side differential privacy (DP) in mitigating privacy leakage and incorporate personalized FL to improve model performance under DP settings. Experiments on the Brain MRI ND-5 dataset show that DCGAN-based attacks can reconstruct semantically meaningful synthetic images, revealing significant risks to the privacy of training data. Applying DP reduces attack success but introduces an accuracy trade-off, which is further overcome by personalized FL at each client side. We also evaluate how different aggregation algorithms affect both attack vulnerability and defense effectiveness, underscoring the critical role of aggregation strategies. The proposed attack-and-defense framework is model-agnostic and applicable to a wide range of FL-based systems.
zh_abstract: 联邦学习（FL）是一种分布式机器学习范式，通过将原始数据保留在本地设备上，降低传输成本、缓解跨境数据共享限制并增强隐私。FL系统中的客户端训练本地模型并仅共享更新，这些更新由中心服务器聚合。尽管这种设置限制了数据直接暴露，FL仍易受隐私攻击。现有攻击与防御策略主要针对集中式系统开发，而由于其独特架构和训练流程，将其适配到FL会带来新挑战。在本工作中，我们首先提出一种在大规模医学影像背景下使用深度卷积生成对抗网络（DCGANs）对FL系统进行模型反演攻击的方法。我们的方法在关于攻击者知识和能力的现实假设下运行。随后，我们考察客户端差分隐私（DP）在减轻隐私泄漏方面的效果，并引入个性化FL以改善DP设置下的模型性能。在Brain MRI ND-5数据集上的实验表明，基于DCGAN的攻击可以重建具有语义意义的合成图像，揭示训练数据隐私的重大风险。应用DP降低攻击成功率，但引入准确性权衡，而每个客户端侧的个性化FL进一步克服了该权衡。我们还评估不同聚合算法如何影响攻击脆弱性和防御有效性，强调聚合策略的关键作用。所提出的攻防框架与模型无关，适用于广泛的基于FL的系统。

title: MoSAIK: Motion Search with Artificial Intelligence in K-space
zh_title: MoSAIK：k空间内AI运动搜索与重建
summary: 预印本提出从常规多线圈T2 TSE k空间自洽性估计刚性运动参数，用于运动感知重建，无需额外导航或重复采集。
key_points: 无需无运动参考或外部导航即可推断运动
卷积嵌入加Transformer估计旋转与二维平移
参数用于模型化运动感知重建而非合成图像
reason: 预印本回顾性方法研究，摘要未体现外部验证或前瞻设计
abstract: Object: Motion artefacts remain a major limitation of routine two-dimensional T2-weighted turbo spin-echo (TSE) brain MRI, reducing diagnostic confidence and often necessitating repeated acquisitions. MoSAIK (Motion Search with AI in K-space) retrospectively estimates in-plane rigid-body motion directly from standard multi-coil TSE k-space. Without a motion-free reference, external navigators, or additional acquisitions, MoSAIK infers motion from k-space self-consistency violations and incorporates predicted parameters into model-based, motion-aware reconstruction rather than synthesizing corrected images. Materials and Methods: Selected complex coil data were represented as log-magnitude and phase channels. A decoupled convolutional embedding and Transformer encoder estimated phase-encoding-line-indexed rotation and two-dimensional translations. Training used motion-free clinical acquisitions with simulated motion; four held-out subjects were evaluated. Component-wise errors assessed estimation; SSIM and PSNR in silico and entropy focus criterion (EFC) in vivo assessed reconstruction. Results: Motion estimation errors were low for both rotation (MSE $<$ 0.2 deg$^2$) and translation (MSE $<$ 0.2 pixels$^2$), with Pearson correlations of approximately 0.96 and 0.94, respectively. In every in-vivo acquisition, more than 75% of slices showed information gain relative to uncorrected reconstructions. MoSAIK reduced visible artefacts while preserving anatomical detail. Discussion: Transformer-based k-space motion-trajectory estimation enables fast retrospective correction of standard clinical TSE brain MRI.
zh_abstract: 【目的】运动伪影仍然是常规二维 T2 加权 turbo spin-echo（TSE）脑 MRI 的主要限制，会降低诊断信心并常导致需要重复采集。MoSAIK（Motion Search with AI in K-space）从标准多线圈 TSE k 空间直接回顾性估计平面内刚体运动。无需无运动参考、外部导航器或额外采集，MoSAIK 根据 k 空间自洽性违反推断运动，并将预测参数纳入基于模型的、运动感知的重建，而不是合成校正后的图像。【材料与方法】选定的复数线圈数据被表示为对数幅值和相位通道。解耦的卷积嵌入和 Transformer 编码器估计按相位编码线索引的旋转和二维平移。训练使用无运动临床采集并模拟运动；评估了四名留出受试者。分量误差评估估计；计算机模拟中的 SSIM 和 PSNR 以及体内熵聚焦准则（EFC）评估重建。【结果】旋转（MSE $<$ 0.2 deg$^2$）和平移（MSE $<$ 0.2 pixels$^2$）的运动估计误差均较低，Pearson 相关系数分别约为 0.96 和 0.94。在每次体内采集中，超过 75% 的切片相对于未校正重建显示出信息增益。MoSAIK 减少了可见伪影，同时保留了解剖细节。【讨论】基于 Transformer 的 k 空间运动轨迹估计能够对标准临床 TSE 脑 MRI 进行快速回顾性校正。

title: Cross-disorder Learning of Imaging-derived Joint Mophometric Markers in Alzheimer's and Parkinson's Diseases
zh_title: 阿尔茨海默与帕金森影像形态学标记的跨疾病迁移学习
summary: 在ADNI与PPMI公开影像数据上构建可解释、空间自适应的迁移学习框架，解析AD与PD相关的形态学标记。
key_points: 基于ADNI与PPMI两个公开数据集
采用可解释空间自适应迁移学习框架
跨疾病分类模式与既往影像发现一致
reason: 预印本方法研究，使用公开数据集且具可解释性，但证据限于内部分析
abstract: As two most prevalent neurodegenerative diseases (NDDs), Alzheimer's disease (AD) and Parkinson's disease (PD) shared commonalities both in symptomology and pathophysiology. However, to what extent and in what way these two distinct disorders overlap remain underexplored. In this study, we propose an explicit, interpretable and spatially adaptive transfer learning framework to elucidate the morphometric biomarkers linked to AD and PD. We applied such high-dimensional machine learning model to two most popular open-source neuroimaging datasets, i.e., Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) and Parkinson's Progression Markers Initiative (PPMI). On the one hand, our cross-disorder classifier revealed neuro-anatomical alteration patterns well aligning with previous neuroimaging research findings and underscoring patients' clinical presentations. On the other hand, the spatially adaptive trained classifier using shared prior achieved statistically superior diagnostic performance compared to respective individual models, which further highlights the cross-disorder framework's efficacy on modeling limited-size datasets across disease domains.
zh_abstract: 作为两种最常见的神经退行性疾病（NDDs），阿尔茨海默病（AD）和帕金森病（PD）在症状学和病理生理学上具有共性。然而，这两种不同疾病在多大程度上以及以何种方式重叠，仍研究不足。在本研究中，我们提出一个显式、可解释且空间自适应的迁移学习框架，以阐明与 AD 和 PD 相关的形态计量生物标志物。我们将这种高维机器学习模型应用于两个最常用的开源神经影像数据集，即阿尔茨海默病神经影像倡议（ADNI）和帕金森病进展标志物倡议（PPMI）。一方面，我们的跨疾病分类器揭示了与既往神经影像研究结果高度一致的神经解剖改变模式，并突显了患者的临床表现。另一方面，使用共享先验进行空间自适应训练的该分类器，与各自单独的模型相比，取得了在统计学上更优的诊断性能，这进一步突出了跨疾病框架在跨疾病领域对有限规模数据集建模方面的有效性。

title: PACE-MoE: Adaptive Domain Sampling and Domain-Specific LoRA for Medical Visual Grounding
zh_title: PACE-MoE：医学视觉定位的自适应域采样
summary: 提出PACE-MoE框架，通过自适应域采样与域特定LoRA联合优化医学视觉定位，在多影像域间动态调整训练覆盖与参数更新。
key_points: 根据当前策略反馈评估各影像域训练价值
通过域准入、回放与最终平衡调整域覆盖
域特定LoRA路由更新，保留预训练主干
reason: 预印本方法，针对多域医学视觉定位，创新明确但证据有限
abstract: Medical visual grounding requires models to align clinical descriptions with spatial evidence across heterogeneous imaging domains. However, existing multi-domain post-training strategies typically rely on fixed domain sampling and shared parameter updates, overlooking the need to adapt both which domains receive training and where their updates are applied. To address this issue, we propose PACE-MoE, a policy-guided framework that jointly performs adaptive domain sampling and domain-specific adaptation for medical visual grounding. PACE dynamically assesses the training value of each imaging domain from current-policy feedback and progressively adjusts domain coverage through domain admission, replay, and final all-domain balancing. Meanwhile, domain-specific LoRA adapters route updates to the corresponding imaging domains while preserving the pretrained backbone and visual encoder. This coordinated design aligns training-data allocation with parameter adaptation without modifying the original reward formulation or Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) objective. Experiments across seven medical imaging domains show that PACE-MoE consistently improves grounding performance over fixed-domain training, achieving a 3.64% relative improvement in mean box IoU over the Vanilla baseline. Under matched domain-specific adapter architectures, adaptive sampling alone further improves mean box IoU by 2.07%, demonstrating the benefit of policy-guided domain allocation. These results establish coordinated data-parameter routing as an effective strategy for multi-domain medical visual grounding.
zh_abstract: 医学视觉定位要求模型在异构影像域中将临床描述与空间证据对齐。然而，现有多域后训练策略通常依赖固定域采样和共享参数更新，忽视了既需要自适应决定哪些域接受训练，也需要自适应决定更新应用于何处。为解决此问题，我们提出 PACE-MoE，一个策略引导框架，针对医学视觉定位联合执行自适应域采样和域特定适应。PACE 根据当前策略反馈动态评估每个影像域的训练价值，并通过域准入（domain admission）、回放（replay）和最终全域网平衡逐步调整域覆盖。同时，域特定 LoRA 适配器将更新路由到相应影像域，同时保留预训练主干和视觉编码器。这种协同设计在不修改原始奖励公式或组相对策略优化（Group Relative Policy Optimization, GRPO）目标的情况下，使训练数据分配与参数适应相匹配。跨七个医学影像域的实验表明，PACE-MoE 在定位性能上持续优于固定域训练，相较于 Vanilla 基线在平均框 IoU 上取得 3.64% 的相对提升。在匹配的域特定适配器架构下，仅自适应采样就进一步将平均框 IoU 提升 2.07%，证明了策略引导域分配的优势。这些结果确立了协同数据-参数路由作为多域医学视觉定位的一种有效策略。

title: Corpus Quality Improves, Retrieval Utility Does Not: An Ablation of Preprocessing and Refinement in a Speech-to-QA Pipeline
zh_title: 语音转问答流水线预处理消融研究
summary: 对韩语医学与金融会议语音构建问答语料的流水线做消融，发现语料质量提升未带来检索收益。
key_points: 同一40场会议数据生成四个版本语料
四位LLM评审与六位专家排序一致
开启转录改写反而降低检索准确率
reason: 小规模但有反直觉发现与人工评估，属值得一看档
abstract: Practitioners building training corpora with a pipeline of language models keep a preprocessing or refinement (post-process) stage when switching it on raises the corpus quality. We ablate a production pipeline that turns conference speech into question-answer pairs. The preprocessing stage rewrites the transcript, and the refinement stage filters the generated pairs. Switching each on and off gives four corpora from the same 40 Korean medical and finance sessions. On the corpus itself, quality rises as the stages switch on. Four LLM judges and six human domain experts rank the four corpora the same way, and the fully refined corpus leads by +0.18 and +0.22 on a 1-5 scale. We then ask whether that gain carries downstream. We supply each corpus to six models at inference and measure retrieval accuracy. The ranking does not hold. Enabling the transcript rewrite lowers retrieval accuracy by 0.061, the only stage effect that survives correction for multiple comparisons. That stage also reads the whole session, so it almost doubles the cost of one. With both stages on, accuracy does not change. An equivalence test we declared in advance confirms this. The corpus itself is clearly valuable. It lifts retrieval accuracy from 0.231 to 0.748 in every model and domain we test. More than a third of its pairs carry knowledge that neither of two frontier models produces on its own. On our data, the null does not come from weak corpora. A rising score on a rubric of this kind did not predict what the corpus holds for a model.
zh_abstract: 使用语言模型流水线构建训练语料的从业者，会在开启预处理或精炼（后处理，post-process）阶段能提升语料库质量时保留该阶段。我们消融了一个将会议语音转化为问答对的生产流水线。预处理阶段重写转写文本，精炼阶段过滤生成的问答对。分别开启和关闭每个阶段，可从同样的 40 场韩语医学和金融会议中得到四个语料库。就语料库本身而言，随着阶段开启，质量上升。四名 LLM 评委和六名人类领域专家以相同方式对四个语料库排序，完全精炼的语料库在 1-5 分尺度上分别领先 +0.18 和 +0.22。随后我们考察这种增益是否会传递到下游。我们将每个语料库在推理时提供给六个模型，并测量检索准确率。这种排序并不成立。启用转写重写使检索准确率降低 0.061，这是唯一经多重比较校正后仍然成立的阶段效应。该阶段还会读取整个会话，因此几乎使单场会话的成本翻倍。两个阶段都开启时，准确率不变。我们事先声明的等价性检验证实了这一点。语料库本身显然是有价值的。在我们测试的每个模型和领域中，它都将检索准确率从 0.231 提升到 0.748。其超过三分之一的问答对携带的知识，是两个前沿模型各自单独都无法产生的。在我们的数据中，零结果并非源于弱语料库。此类评分细则上不断上升的分数，并不能预测该语料库能为模型提供什么。

title: EviDial: When Correct Depression Predictions Lack Evidence
zh_title: EviDial：抑郁预测标签与证据不匹配基准
summary: 发布382段抑郁对话、2744个症状单元的基准，区分标签一致与有证据支撑的评估。
key_points: 证据充分性分为缺失/部分/冲突/充分
用概化理论与Rasch模型推导校准参考
审计显示82.8%单元文本证据不足
reason: 新基准且揭示重要问题，但规模有限、预印本，属值得一看档
abstract: Depression dialogue benchmarks commonly assess models by comparing predicted symptom labels with clinical scale scores. However, a prediction may agree with a benchmark label even when the dialogue lacks enough evidence to justify it. We introduce EviDial, a benchmark that distinguishes label agreement from evidence-grounded assessment. EviDial comprises 382 depression dialogues from three sources and 2,744 participant-symptom cells, each classified as having absent, partial, conflicting, or sufficient evidence. Because evidence sufficiency lacks a directly observable gold standard, we derive calibrated evidence references from multiple judgments using generalizability theory, many-facet Rasch measurement, and random-effects latent class analysis. Our audit reveals that 82.8% of participant-symptom cells lack sufficient textual evidence for the corresponding symptom assessment, with substantial variation across sources. Across model families and prompting strategies, 69.2%-96.9% of predictions judged correct by benchmark labels are nonetheless unsupported by sufficient dialogue evidence. Further analyses show that strong agreement among LLM evaluators need not reflect independent evidence judgments, underscoring the need to calibrate automated reference panels. These findings demonstrate that label-based evaluation can overestimate evidence-grounded performance by conflating agreement with clinical labels and support in the observed dialogue. EviDial provides a measurement layer for separating these constructs and auditing LLM-based depression assessment more faithfully.
zh_abstract: 抑郁症对话基准通常通过将预测的症状标签与临床量表评分进行比较来评估模型。然而，即使对话缺乏足以支持该预测的证据，预测也可能与基准标签一致。我们引入 EviDial，一个区分标签一致性与基于证据的评估的基准。EviDial 包含来自三个来源的 382 段抑郁症对话和 2,744 个参与者-症状单元，每个单元被分类为具有缺失、部分、冲突或充分证据。由于证据充分性缺乏可直接观察的金标准，我们使用泛化理论（generalizability theory）、多面 Rasch 测量（many-facet Rasch measurement）和随机效应潜在类别分析（random-effects latent class analysis），从多个判断中推导校准后的证据参考。我们的审计显示，82.8% 的参与者-症状单元缺乏足以支持相应症状评估的文本证据，且不同来源之间差异很大。在不同模型家族和提示策略中，69.2%-96.9% 被基准标签判定为正确的预测，仍缺乏充分的对话证据支持。进一步分析表明，LLM 评估者之间高度一致并不一定反映独立的证据判断，这凸显了校准自动化参考小组的必要性。这些发现表明，基于标签的评估可能将临床标签一致性与所观察对话中的支持混为一谈，从而高估基于证据的性能。EviDial 提供了一个测量层，用于分离这些构念，并更忠实地审计基于 LLM 的抑郁症评估。

title: Exploring Recurrent-Depth Language Models for Multitask Clinical Text Processing
zh_title: 循环深度语言模型用于多任务临床文本处理
summary: 在13个临床NLP数据集上微调5个模型，Ouro小模型在11个数据集上优于Qwen3-1.7B。
key_points: 联合微调5个模型，覆盖13个临床NLP数据集
Ouro-1.4B在11个数据集上优于Qwen3-1.7B
4个未参与训练数据集用于评测
reason: 多数据集外部评测，预印本且无临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: Clinical natural language processing includes diverse tasks such as information extraction, classification, and question answering. Developing one model for all tasks could simplify deployment and improve knowledge transfer. We evaluated whether small recurrent-depth language models can meet this need through joint fine-tuning and compared their performance with standard transformers. We fine-tuned Ouro1.4B-Thinking, Ouro-2.6B-Thinking, HRM-Text-1B, Qwen3-1.7B, and Qwen3-8B on 9 datasets covering information extraction, classification, inference, and question answering, and evaluated them on four additional datasets excluded from training. Across these 13 datasets, Ouro-1.4B-Thinking achieved higher performances than Qwen3-1.7B on 11 datasets; Ouro-2.6BThinking was competitive with Qwen3-8B on most tasks. Ouro models showed the largest gains on inference and question answering, whereas HRM-Text-1B showed mixed results. These findings support further study of recurrent-depth models for clinical tasks through controlled experiments to isolate architectural effects and investigate how recurrent computation influences reasoning, knowledge acquisition, and generalization.
zh_abstract: 临床自然语言处理包括信息抽取、分类和问答等多种任务。开发一个适用于所有任务的模型可以简化部署并促进知识迁移。我们评估了小型循环深度语言模型能否通过联合微调满足这一需求，并将其性能与标准 Transformer 进行比较。我们在覆盖信息抽取、分类、推理和问答的 9 个数据集上微调了 Ouro1.4B-Thinking、Ouro-2.6B-Thinking、HRM-Text-1B、Qwen3-1.7B 和 Qwen3-8B，并在未纳入训练的另外四个数据集上评估它们。在这 13 个数据集上，Ouro-1.4B-Thinking 在 11 个数据集上取得了高于 Qwen3-1.7B 的性能；Ouro-2.6BThinking 在大多数任务上与 Qwen3-8B 具有竞争力。Ouro 模型在推理和问答上表现出最大增益，而 HRM-Text-1B 的结果不一。这些发现支持通过受控实验进一步研究用于临床任务的循环深度模型，以分离架构效应，并探究循环计算如何影响推理、知识获取和泛化。

title: A Deep Learning Framework for Accurate lncRNA-Protein Interaction Prediction via Multi-Kernel Graph Embeddings and Self-Attention.
source: PubMed · Interdisciplinary sciences, computational life sciences
zh_title: 多核图嵌入与自注意力的lncRNA-蛋白互作预测
summary: 提出MAKGLPIN框架，融合序列、结构与理化特征预测lncRNA-蛋白相互作用。
key_points: 融合序列、结构信息与理化性质特征
多层图卷积加自注意力，结合图注意力网络
面向疾病机制与细胞功能研究的基础计算工具
reason: 常规计算生物学预测模型，缺少独立验证与实验支持
abstract: [Interdisciplinary sciences, computational life sciences] Long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs) play a pivotal role in regulating biological processes, primarily through lncRNA-Protein Interactions (LPI), which are crucial for understanding disease mechanisms and cellular functions. While computational methods exist for predicting LPI, they suffer from suboptimal feature integration, limited generalizability, and inadequate network modeling. To address these challenges, we propose MAKGLPIN (Multi-Architecture, Multi-Kernel Graph-based LPI Network), a novel deep learning framework that integrates sequence features, structural information, and physicochemical properties of lncRNAs and proteins. MAKGLPIN employs a multi-layer Graph Convolutional Network (GCN) enhanced with a self-attention mechanism to capture complex interaction patterns, alongside a Graph Attention Network (GAT) to prioritize critical interactions while preserving long-range dependencies. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that MAKGLPIN outperforms existing methods in robustness, generalizability, and predictive precision across benchmark datasets. Our model provides a computationally efficient and biologically interpretable solution, advancing the study of LPI and their applications in disease research.
zh_abstract: [Interdisciplinary sciences, computational life sciences] 长非编码 RNA（long non-coding RNAs, lncRNAs）在调控生物过程中发挥关键作用，主要通过 lncRNA-蛋白质相互作用（lncRNA-Protein Interactions, LPI）实现，这对于理解疾病机制和细胞功能至关重要。尽管已有用于预测 LPI 的计算方法，但它们存在特征整合欠佳、泛化性有限和网络建模不足的问题。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 MAKGLPIN（Multi-Architecture, Multi-Kernel Graph-based LPI Network），一种新颖的深度学习框架，整合 lncRNA 和蛋白质的序列特征、结构信息以及物理化学性质。MAKGLPIN 采用多层图卷积网络（Graph Convolutional Network, GCN），并增强以自注意力机制以捕获复杂相互作用模式，同时使用图注意力网络（Graph Attention Network, GAT）来优先处理关键相互作用，同时保留长距离依赖关系。大量评估表明，MAKGLPIN 在基准数据集上的稳健性、泛化性和预测精度方面优于现有方法。我们的模型提供了一种计算高效且具有生物学可解释性的解决方案，推动了 LPI 研究及其在疾病研究中的应用。

title: From Clinical Risk Prediction to Operational Decisions: An Uncertainty-Aware Framework for ICU Staffing
zh_title: ICU排班的不确定性感知决策框架
summary: 预印本提出不确定性感知的前瞻性排班框架，把短期患者风险概率转化为排班决策，且不修改上游预测模型。
key_points: 聚焦风险预测到运营决策的转化缺口
显式建模预测不确定性，替代固定安全缓冲
考虑排班刚性与招聘延迟等现实约束
reason: 方法有新意但为预印本、无外部验证与临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: Advances in electronic health records (EHR) and large-scale critical care databases have enabled the development of machine learning models for the early detection of patient deterioration. While these models often achieve strong predictive performance for outcomes such as sepsis and mortality, most studies evaluate them purely on discrimination metrics. This leaves a critical gap: how to systematically translate probabilistic clinical risk estimates into downstream operational decisions under real-world constraints, such as shift rigidity and hiring delays. This study proposes an uncertainty-aware anticipatory staffing framework that bridges short-term patient risk prediction and staff planning without altering the upstream predictive model. Instead of relying on naive deterministic aggregation or fixed safety buffers, the framework explicitly models dynamic predictive uncertainty and evaluates extreme shortage exposure using Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR). These aggregated, risk-calibrated demand signals are then embedded into an hourly rolling-horizon scheduling policy to generate delay-constrained staffing decisions. Evaluated on realistic trajectories from the MIMIC-IV database, the proposed framework demonstrates a favorable cost-shortage trade-off compared to deterministic and purely reactive baselines. Pareto frontier analysis illustrates how uncertainty-aware demand construction changes resource allocation under varying safety preferences, while stress testing confirms the framework's operational robustness even when subjected to systematic predictive bias in the form of calibration drift. By formalizing this translation layer, this work provides a principled, transparent pathway for safely integrating probabilistic AI outputs into high-stakes healthcare operational systems.
zh_abstract: 电子健康记录（electronic health records, EHR）和大规模重症监护数据库的进展，使机器学习模型得以开发用于早期检测患者病情恶化。尽管这些模型通常对脓毒症和死亡率等结局取得较强的预测性能，但大多数研究仅基于区分度指标对其进行评估。这留下了一个关键空白：如何在排班刚性和招聘延迟等现实约束下，将概率性临床风险估计系统地转化为下游运营决策。本研究提出一种不确定性感知的前瞻性人员配置框架，在不改变上游预测模型的情况下，衔接短期患者风险预测与人员规划。该框架不依赖简单的确定性聚合或固定安全缓冲，而是显式建模动态预测不确定性，并使用条件风险价值（Conditional Value-at-Risk, CVaR）评估极端短缺暴露。这些聚合的、经风险校准的需求信号随后被嵌入逐小时滚动时域排班策略，以生成受延迟约束的人员配置决策。在来自 MIMIC-IV 数据库的真实轨迹上评估时，所提出的框架与确定性基线和纯反应性基线相比，表现出有利的成本-短缺权衡。帕累托前沿分析（Pareto frontier analysis）说明了不确定性感知的需求构建如何在不同的安全偏好下改变资源分配，而压力测试证实了该框架即使在遭受校准漂移形式的系统性预测偏差时也具有运营稳健性。通过形式化这一转化层，本工作为将概率性人工智能（AI）输出安全整合到高风险医疗保健运营系统中提供了一条有原则、透明的路径。

title: CODA: Cohort- and Drift-aware Foundation Model for Multimodal Clinical Reasoning
zh_title: CODA：队列与漂移感知的多模态临床推理基础模型
summary: arXiv预印本提出CODA，将人群队列分层与个体漂移适配融入多模态临床推理基础模型。
key_points: 显式建模人群队列结构
漂移感知的个体自适应
面向多模态临床推理任务
reason: 新方法预印本，证据有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Recent advances in multimodal foundation models have demonstrated strong performance across diverse clinical tasks. However, existing approaches predominantly operate at the individual sample level and fail to model the interplay between population-level cohort patterns and patient-specific variation that underlie real-world clinical reasoning. In practice, clinicians routinely reason through patient cohorts sharing similar demographic, physiological, or pathological characteristics, while accounting for patient-specific deviations from the group prototype. Motivated by this gap, we propose CODA, a cohort- and drift-aware foundation model for multimodal clinical reasoning. CODA explicitly integrates cohort structure into the modeling pipeline through two complementary mechanisms: cohort-aware population stratification and drift-aware individual adaptation. In particular, we leverage reinforcement learning to discover clinically meaningful patient cohorts, and further model each patient's deviation from cohort prototypes as a structured drift signal encoding fine-grained individual heterogeneity. These cohort- and drift-aware representations are incorporated into the foundation model to enable reasoning that is simultaneously informed by population-level patterns and sensitive to individual-level variation. Extensive experiments on real-world electronic health record (EHR) benchmarks demonstrate that CODA achieves consistent effectiveness and strong generalizability across diverse clinical tasks, including closed-QA, open-QA, and report generation.
zh_abstract: 近期多模态基础模型的进展已在多种临床任务中展现出强大性能。然而，现有方法主要在单个样本层面运作，未能建模群体水平队列模式与患者特异性变异之间的相互作用，而这种相互作用是真实世界临床推理的基础。在实践中，临床医生常规会通过具有相似人口学、生理学或病理学特征的患者队列进行推理，同时考虑患者相对于群体原型的个体特异性偏离。受这一空白启发，我们提出 CODA，一种用于多模态临床推理的队列与漂移感知基础模型（cohort- and drift-aware foundation model）。CODA 通过两种互补机制将队列结构明确整合到建模流程中：队列感知的群体分层（cohort-aware population stratification）和漂移感知的个体适应（drift-aware individual adaptation）。特别是，我们利用强化学习发现具有临床意义的患者队列，并进一步将每位患者相对于队列原型的偏离建模为编码细粒度个体异质性的结构化漂移信号。这些队列与漂移感知表征被纳入基础模型，使推理既受群体水平模式启发，又对个体水平变异敏感。在真实世界电子健康记录（EHR）基准上的大量实验表明，CODA 在包括封闭式问答（closed-QA）、开放式问答（open-QA）和报告生成（report generation）在内的多种临床任务中均实现了一致的有效性和强泛化性。

title: TRACE: Tracking Multimodal Clinical Trajectories for Inpatient Risk Prediction
zh_title: TRACE：多模态临床轨迹用于住院风险预测
summary: 提出按日组织EHR、胸片、影像报告与出院小结的轨迹建模框架，用于住院风险预测。
key_points: 按日尺度对齐多模态临床事件轨迹
分离日不变全局上下文与当日局部事件
可处理模态缺失，覆盖死亡、住院时长、再入院
reason: 预印本新方法，摘要未体现外部验证或公开数据权重，属值得一看档。
abstract: Accurate inpatient risk prediction requires modeling heterogeneous clinical evidence that accumulates irregularly over time. This challenge spans in-hospital mortality, prolonged length of stay, and readmission, each with task-specific observation windows. Existing multimodal approaches combine structured health record data, chest x-rays, and clinical text, but primarily focus on modality fusion or missing-modality compensation, with limited attention to temporal trajectories over an admission. We propose TRACE (TRAjectory modeling of multimodal Clinical Events), a daily-scale framework organizing clinical events into day-level trajectories, separating day-invariant global context from day-specific local events drawn from EHR data, chest x-rays, radiology reports, and discharge summaries. The trajectory is encoded using temporal attention, allowing unavailable modalities to emit no tokens. A phenotype-guided contrastive objective further organizes admissions under heterogeneous disease distributions. Across cohorts from MIMIC-IV, eICU, and MIMIC-III comprising nearly 180,000 total stays, we evaluate TRACE on mortality, length of stay, and readmission prediction. TRACE achieves the highest AUROC across all nine dataset-task settings and the highest ACC in eight, outperforming baselines. Ablation studies validate our attention masks and contrastive learning, while trajectory-level attribution localizes risk-associated hospital days and modalities.
zh_abstract: 准确的住院患者风险预测需要对随时间不规则累积的异质性临床证据进行建模。这一挑战涵盖院内死亡、住院时间延长和再入院，每项均有任务特定的观察窗口。现有的多模态方法结合结构化健康记录数据、胸部X线和临床文本，但主要关注模态融合或缺失模态补偿，对一次住院期间的时间轨迹关注有限。我们提出TRACE（TRAjectory modeling of multimodal Clinical Events，多模态临床事件的轨迹建模），一个每日尺度框架，将临床事件组织为日级轨迹，将来自EHR数据、胸部X线、放射学报告和出院小结的日不变全局背景与日特异局部事件分离。该轨迹使用时间注意力进行编码，使不可用模态不产生任何标记（token）。表型引导的对比目标进一步在异质性疾病分布下组织住院样本。在来自MIMIC-IV、eICU和MIMIC-III、总计近180,000次住院的队列中，我们在死亡、住院时间和再入院预测上评估TRACE。TRACE在所有九个数据集-任务设置中取得最高AUROC，并在八个设置中取得最高ACC，优于基线。消融研究验证了我们的注意力掩码和对比学习，而轨迹级归因定位了与风险相关的住院日和模态。

title: Localization Gains from Explanation Regularization Should Not Be Interpreted as Faithfulness Gains.
zh_title: 解释正则化的定位提升不等于忠实性提升
summary: arXiv预印本以脑肿瘤MRI三分类为例，指出解释正则化带来的定位改善不应解读为对分类器的忠实性提升。
key_points: 单通道ResNet-50，五折患者分组交叉验证
CGC使指向游戏指标由27.24%升至36.02%
扰动式忠实性指标变化不一致
reason: 预印本方法学批评，有基线对比但单数据集，属5-6档
abstract: Training-time explanation regularization is often evaluated by whether saliency maps become more concentrated within annotated regions. We argue that this criterion alone is insufficient: transformation consistency, lesion localization, and faithfulness to the classifier are distinct properties and should be evaluated separately, particularly in medical imaging. We examine this distinction through a case study of Contrastive Grad-CAM Consistency (CGC) in three-class brain tumor MRI classification. Using a single-channel ResNet-50 with five-fold patient-grouped cross-validation, we compare a cross-entropy baseline with CGC. CGC changes overall Pointing Game (PG) from $27.24\%$ to $36.02\%$ and Relevance Mass Accuracy (RMA) from $11.17\%$ to $18.01\%$, while classification accuracy changes from $93.63\%$ to $94.87\%$. Perturbation-based faithfulness metrics show inconsistent changes: Insertion Area Under the Curve (IAUC) changes from $0.73$ to $0.78$, whereas Deletion Area Under the Curve (DAUC) favors the baseline ($0.36$ versus $0.41$; lower is better), and overall Iterative Removal Of Features (IROF) is $0.57$ for both models. These results support our position that improved spatial agreement with pathology should not be interpreted as a general improvement in explanation faithfulness. We therefore recommend property-specific evaluation in which the property targeted by the explanation objective, spatial agreement with reference regions, and model reliance are measured and reported separately.
zh_abstract: 训练时解释正则化通常通过显著图是否在标注区域内变得更加集中来评估。我们认为仅凭这一标准并不充分：变换一致性、病灶定位以及对分类器的忠实性是不同的属性，应分别评估，尤其是在医学影像中。我们通过在三分类脑肿瘤 MRI 分类中对对比 Grad-CAM 一致性（Contrastive Grad-CAM Consistency, CGC）的案例研究来考察这一区别。使用单通道 ResNet-50 和五折患者分组交叉验证，我们将交叉熵基线模型与 CGC 进行比较。CGC 将总体 Pointing Game（PG）从 27.24% 变为 36.02%，将 Relevance Mass Accuracy（RMA）从 11.17% 变为 18.01%，而分类准确率从 93.63% 变为 94.87%。基于扰动的忠实性指标显示出不一致的变化：插入曲线下面积（Insertion Area Under the Curve, IAUC）从 0.73 变为 0.78，而删除曲线下面积（Deletion Area Under the Curve, DAUC）更支持基线模型（0.36 对 0.41；越低越好），总体迭代特征移除（Iterative Removal Of Features, IROF）在两个模型中均为 0.57。这些结果支持我们的立场：与病理的空间一致性提高不应被解释为解释忠实性的普遍提高。因此，我们推荐按属性分别评估，即分别测量并报告解释目标所针对的属性、与参考区域的空间一致性以及模型依赖性。

title: XGLASS: X-Ray, Gaze and Language Assisted Slice Sequencing for CT Volumes
zh_title: XGLASS：X光注视与语言辅助CT切片排序
summary: 预印本提出将X光放射科医生注视先验迁移到CT，用于任务相关切片优先级排序。
key_points: 利用语言对齐的X光注视生成疾病重要图
与冠状位CT投影空间对齐融合
目标是用2D视觉语言模型分析3D CT
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，但证据有限，未见外部验证或代码公开。
abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) achieve remarkable performance on 2D medical images, such as X-rays or pathology images, while 3D VLMs that directly process CT/MRI volumes lag behind due to limited 3D training data and the predominance of 2D foundation architectures. To leverage powerful 2D VLMs for analyzing medical volumes, which contain hundreds of slices, it is therefore necessary to focus only on those few slices, which are diagnostically relevant. To enable such a prioritization, we propose XGLASS, a method that transfers medical expertise from 2D X-rays to 3D CT for task-aware slice prioritization. XGLASS uses disease-conditioned importance maps derived from language-aligned radiologist gaze on X-rays and spatially aligns them with coronal CT projections, bringing gaze priors and CT content into a shared 2D representation. The fused gaze-prior/CT projection is then used to predict a disease-specific ordering of axial slices, prioritizing diagnostically relevant slices. XGLASS significantly improves budgeted retrieval over 2D and 3D-native baselines, achieving a top-10 hit rate up to 75.9% for the best-performing disease. In practice, this means that after inspecting only the top 10 slices (4.17% of a 240-slice scan), XGLASS identifies a diagnostically relevant slice in more than 75% of cases. For downstream slice-wise finding classification, an XGLASS-selected 30-slice candidate set reduces model calls by 87.5% while improving F1 by 11.3 percentage points over all-slice inference, 4.2 points over the strongest 2D selector, and remains competitive with 3D-native selectors while requiring up to 130.8 times less time and 10.9 times less GPU memory per finding, supporting its use as a lightweight preselector for volumetric CT analysis. The code and pretrained checkpoint are available on https://github.com/michaelgloeckler/XGLASS.
zh_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在 2D 医学图像（如 X 射线或病理图像）上取得了显著性能，而直接处理 CT/MRI 体积的 3D VLM 因 3D 训练数据有限以及 2D 基础架构占主导而落后。因此，为利用强大的 2D VLM 分析包含数百个切片的医学体积，有必要仅关注其中少数具有诊断相关性的切片。为实现这种优先级排序，我们提出 XGLASS，一种将医学专业知识从 2D X 射线迁移到 3D CT 以进行任务感知切片优先级排序的方法。XGLASS 使用由 X 射线上经语言对齐的放射科医生注视推导出的疾病条件重要性图，并将其与冠状 CT 投影进行空间对齐，从而将注视先验和 CT 内容带入共享的 2D 表示。然后，融合后的注视先验/CT 投影用于预测轴位切片的疾病特异性排序，从而优先考虑诊断相关切片。XGLASS 显著优于 2D 和 3D 原生基线的预算受限检索，在表现最佳的疾病上达到最高 75.9% 的前 10 命中率。在实践中，这意味着在仅检查前 10 个切片（占 240 切片扫描的 4.17%）后，XGLASS 在超过 75% 的病例中识别出诊断相关切片。对于下游的切片级发现分类，由 XGLASS 选择的 30 切片候选集将模型调用减少 87.5%，同时相较于全切片推理将 F1 提高 11.3 个百分点，相较于最强的 2D 选择器提高 4.2 个百分点，并与 3D 原生选择器保持竞争力，同时每项发现所需时间最多少 130.8 倍、GPU 内存最多少 10.9 倍，支持其作为体积 CT 分析的轻量级预选择器使用。代码和预训练检查点可在 https://github.com/michaelgloeckler/XGLASS 获取。

title: REST: Reliability-Guided Spatial Transcriptomics Supervision for Gene Expression Prediction from Histopathological HE-Stained Images
zh_title: REST：可靠性引导的空间转录组监督预测基因表达
summary: 预印本提出REST框架，用空间转录组监督从HE病理图像预测基因表达，并构建生物学程序库。
key_points: 构建生物学程序库作为共享结构
按可靠性加权空间转录组监督
从HE图像预测分子信息

abstract: Histopathology is central to cancer diagnosis, but morphology in Hematoxylin and Eosin (HE)-stained images does not directly reveal the molecular states that characterize disease heterogeneity and inform tumor characterization, prognostic assessment, and biomarker discovery. Spatial Transcriptomics (ST) measures spatially resolved gene expression, providing molecular information within tissue architecture, yet differences in assay coverage and spot informativeness make paired HE--ST observations unequally reliable for representation learning. We propose Reliability-Guided Spatial Transcriptomics (REST) supervision with Biological Program Bank (BPB), a program-structured and reliability-guided ST-supervised training framework for predicting molecular information from H\&E images. REST constructs BPB from curated signature, pathway, and cell-type gene sets to provide a shared structure for ST encoding, reliability estimation, and molecular reconstruction. Guided by BPB, Spot-Reliability Contrastive Alignment (SRCA) measures the reliability of each spot from assay-level program coverage and spot-level activity dispersion, and reweights HE--ST alignment accordingly. Biology-Informed Program Reconstruction (BIPR) further uses learnable program queries to reconstruct member-gene expression from histological morphology. REST's training corpus comprised 209 samples (407,475 spots across 16 organs); evaluation used 70 disjoint samples (230,056 spots across eight organs) for gene-expression, pathway-activity, and cell-signature prediction. REST achieved the highest Macro correlation among state-of-the-art ST-supervised training methods and outperformed existing pathology foundation models. Code is available at https://github.com/lanfz2000/REST.
zh_abstract: 组织病理学是癌症诊断的核心，但苏木精-伊红（H&E）染色图像中的形态学并不能直接揭示表征疾病异质性并指导肿瘤特征描述、预后评估和生物标志物发现的分子状态。空间转录组学（Spatial Transcriptomics, ST）测量空间分辨的基因表达，在组织结构内提供分子信息，然而检测覆盖度和 spot 信息量的差异使配对的 H&E–ST 观察在表征学习中具有不等的可靠性。我们提出带有生物程序库（Biological Program Bank, BPB）的可靠性引导空间转录组学（Reliability-Guided Spatial Transcriptomics, REST）监督，这是一种程序结构化且可靠性引导的 ST 监督训练框架，用于从 H&E 图像预测分子信息。REST 从经过整理的签名、通路和细胞类型基因集构建 BPB，为 ST 编码、可靠性估计和分子重建提供共享结构。在 BPB 引导下，spot 可靠性对比对齐（Spot-Reliability Contrastive Alignment, SRCA）从检测水平的程序覆盖度和 spot 水平的活性离散度测量每个 spot 的可靠性，并据此重新加权 H&E–ST 对齐。生物学信息引导的程序重建（Biology-Informed Program Reconstruction, BIPR）进一步使用可学习的程序查询，从组织学形态重建成员基因表达。REST 的训练语料包含 209 个样本（覆盖 16 个器官的 407,475 个 spot）；评估使用 70 个不相交样本（覆盖 8 个器官的 230,056 个 spot）进行基因表达、通路活性和细胞签名预测。在最先进的 ST 监督训练方法中，REST 取得了最高的宏平均相关性，并优于现有的病理基础模型。代码可在 https://github.com/lanfz2000/REST 获取。

title: HGASurv: Hierarchical Granularity-Aware Integration for Multimodal Survival Prediction
zh_title: HGASurv：面向多模态生存预测的分层粒度感知整合
summary: 预印本提出分层WSI编码与临床引导图传播模块，整合病理、基因组与临床变量做生存风险分层。
key_points: 按原始坐标将WSI patch映射到空间网格
并行卷积构建patch、邻域、区域多尺度表征
基因组特征经跨模态共注意力查询WSI表征
reason: 预印本新方法有基线对比，但摘录未见外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Objective: Multimodal survival prediction jointly analyzes histopathological whole-slide images (WSIs), genomic profiles, and clinical variables to stratify patients by risk. However, existing approaches often inadequately account for granularity differences across modalities, particularly in spatial organization and feature dimensionality. To address these challenges, we propose HGASurv, which introduces a hierarchical WSI encoding module and a clinical-guided graph propagation module for granularity-aware multimodal integration. Methods: The hierarchical WSI encoding module maps WSI patch features onto a spatial grid using their original coordinates and applies parallel convolutions to construct representations at patch, local-neighborhood, and regional scales. Genomic signature embeddings then query these scale-specific WSI representations through cross-modal co-attention, producing signature-conditioned morphological features. The clinical-guided graph propagation module uses clinical variables to define patient-similarity edges and propagates fused image-genomic node embeddings with graph attention, integrating clinical information through topology rather than feature concatenation. Results: Across three TCGA cohorts, HGASurv achieved the strongest overall C-index performance, with ablation studies supporting the complementary contributions of the hierarchical WSI encoding and clinical-guided graph propagation modules. Conclusion and Significance: By introducing hierarchical WSI encoding and clinical-guided graph propagation, HGASurv unifies multi-scale pathology representation with topology-based clinical integration in a hierarchical granularity-aware framework. This design shows that matching representation and integration mechanisms to modality-specific granularity improves multimodal survival prediction.
zh_abstract: 【目的】多模态生存预测联合分析组织病理学全切片图像（WSI）、基因组谱和临床变量，以对患者进行风险分层。然而，现有方法往往未能充分考虑到不同模态之间的粒度差异，尤其是在空间组织和特征维度方面。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 HGASurv，它引入分层 WSI 编码模块和临床引导图传播模块，以实现粒度感知的多模态整合。【方法】分层 WSI 编码模块利用 WSI 图块的原始坐标将其特征映射到空间网格上，并应用并行卷积构建图块、局部邻域和区域尺度上的表示。随后，基因组特征嵌入通过跨模态协同注意力查询这些尺度特异的 WSI 表示，生成以特征签名为条件的形态学特征。临床引导图传播模块使用临床变量定义患者相似性边，并通过图注意力传播融合的图像-基因组节点嵌入，从而通过拓扑结构而非特征拼接来整合临床信息。【结果】在三个 TCGA 队列中，HGASurv 取得了最强的总体 C-index 表现，消融研究支持分层 WSI 编码和临床引导图传播模块的互补贡献。【结论与意义】通过引入分层 WSI 编码和临床引导图传播，HGASurv 在分层粒度感知框架中将多尺度病理表示与基于拓扑的临床整合统一起来。该设计表明，使表示和整合机制与模态特异的粒度相匹配，能够改善多模态生存预测。

title: TIM: Temporal Decoupling with Iterative Mutual-Refinement Model for Longitudinal Radiology Report Generation
zh_title: TIM：纵向影像报告生成的时序解耦与迭代互精炼模型
summary: 预印本提出两阶段框架，将空间病理与时间进展解耦，并迭代互精炼以生成纵向影像报告。
key_points: 阶段一学习时序解耦表征，分离时间演变模式
针对多次检查的纵向报告生成任务
声称缓解历史图像混在同一表征空间的问题
reason: 预印本新任务设定与方法有对比，但缺乏外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Automatic radiology report generation (RRG) aims to translate medical images into diagnostic text, reducing radiologists' workload and standardizing clinical documentation. Nonetheless, existing approaches mainly focus on single-timepoint analysis and fail to capture temporal disease evolution across longitudinal examinations. While recent longitudinal RRG (LRRG) approaches incorporate historical data, they often combine images from different time points within a single representation space, leading to blurred semantics and inconsistent temporal reasoning. In this work, we propose a Temporal Decoupling with Iterative Mutual-Refinement Model (TIM), a two-stage framework that explicitly decouples spatial pathology from temporal progression and iteratively refines reports through mutual feedback. Stage I performs temporal-decoupled representation learning, separating temporal evolution patterns from disease-specific features and generating radiology reports for both prior and current studies. Stage II introduces a mutual report refinement mechanism that identifies diagnostic inconsistencies within prior reports and iteratively rectifies both prior and current reports through error-sensitive feedback. Experiments on the Longitudinal-MIMIC dataset demonstrate that TIM surpasses existing single-image and longitudinal baselines, achieving new state-of-the-art performance across both language and clinical metrics. Code is available at https://github.com/yihengd/TIM.
zh_abstract: 自动放射学报告生成（automatic radiology report generation, RRG）旨在将医学图像转化为诊断文本，从而减轻放射科医师的工作负担并规范临床文档。然而，现有方法主要集中于单时间点分析，未能捕捉纵向检查中的疾病时间演变。尽管近期的纵向RRG（longitudinal RRG, LRRG）方法纳入了历史数据，但它们通常将不同时间点的图像组合在单一表示空间中，导致语义模糊和时间推理不一致。在本工作中，我们提出时序解耦与迭代相互精炼模型（Temporal Decoupling with Iterative Mutual-Refinement Model, TIM），这是一个两阶段框架，明确地将空间病理与时间进展解耦，并通过相互反馈迭代精炼报告。第一阶段执行时间解耦表示学习，将时间演变模式与疾病特异性特征分离，并为既往和当前研究生成放射学报告。第二阶段引入相互报告精炼机制，识别既往报告中的诊断不一致，并通过错误敏感反馈迭代校正既往和当前报告。在Longitudinal-MIMIC数据集上的实验表明，TIM优于现有的单图像和纵向基线，在语言和临床指标上均达到新的最先进性能。代码见 https://github.com/yihengd/TIM。

title: 3D Diffusion Models for Medical Imaging
zh_title: 医学影像中的三维扩散模型
summary: 综述三维扩散模型在CT、MRI、PET等医学影像中的图像合成、重建、补全、数据增强与伪影校正应用及挑战。
key_points: 覆盖CT、MRI、PET等影像模态
应用含重建、补全与伪影校正
总结三维体数据带来的特定挑战
reason: 预印本综述，覆盖面广但无新实验，属值得一看档
abstract: Generative deep learning methods such as Variational Autoencoders, Generative Adversarial Networks or Diffusion Models have achieved remarkable results in image synthesis. In particular, Diffusion Models have demonstrated superior image fidelity and sample diversity compared to other approaches on standard benchmarks, while also offering more flexible training dynamics as evidenced both in natural image domains and in medical applications. In medical imaging including Computed Tomography, Magnetic Resonance Imaging or Positron Emission Tomography, such models have various important use-cases including data augmentation, domain transfer, image reconstruction, inpainting, image augmentation and artifact correction. Further, generated images can be conditioned on patient characteristics, medical reports, segmentation masks or other images. Specific challenges arise due to the 3D volumetric nature of medical images, which translate to substantial demands in terms of memory, compute, and training data. This article provides a comparative overview of 3D Diffusion Models which have been developed for medical images, with a focus on current performance, limitations, and an outlook for future work.
zh_abstract: 生成式深度学习方法，如变分自编码器（Variational Autoencoders）、生成对抗网络（Generative Adversarial Networks）或扩散模型（Diffusion Models），在图像合成中已取得显著成果。特别是，扩散模型在标准基准上相较于其他方法展现出更优的图像保真度和样本多样性，同时提供更灵活的训练动态，这一点在自然图像领域和医学应用中均已得到证明。在包括计算机断层扫描（Computed Tomography）、磁共振成像（Magnetic Resonance Imaging）或正电子发射断层扫描（Positron Emission Tomography）的医学成像中，此类模型具有多种重要应用场景，包括数据增强、域迁移、图像重建、图像修补、图像增强和伪影校正。此外，生成的图像可以以患者特征、医学报告、分割掩膜或其他图像为条件。由于医学图像的三维体数据性质，出现了特定挑战，这在内存、计算和训练数据方面转化为巨大需求。本文对为医学图像开发的 3D 扩散模型进行了比较性综述，重点关注当前性能、局限性以及对未来工作的展望。

title: PCXR-Copilot: Device-aware pediatric chest radiographic analysis with segmentation, suppression, and edema-related cues
zh_title: 儿科CICU胸片设备感知分析工具PCXR-Copilot
summary: 提出PCXR-Copilot，用于儿科CICU胸片的分割、设备抑制与水肿相关线索分析，并发布1000张AP胸片的PediaDeviceSeg-1K数据集。
key_points: 发布1000张儿科CICU AP胸片标注数据集
对常见ICU设备做细粒度标注并公开
联合分割、设备抑制与水肿线索分析
reason: 首个公开儿科CICU胸片设备标注数据集，方法有新意但预印本证据有限
abstract: Patients admitted to pediatric ICU and cardiac ICU often require intensive perioperative support and frequent chest radiography to monitor support devices, extravascular lung water, and body-wall edema. Radiographic interpretation and analysis is often difficult due to superimposed anatomic and iatrogenic structures that obscure clinically relevant signals. While deep learning can provide decision support, translation to pediatric radiographs is still limited by high device burden and scarcity of pediatric datasets with clinically grounded device annotations. To address this gap, we first introduce PediaDeviceSeg-1K, a curated dataset of 1,000 anterior-posterior radiographs of pediatric CICU patients with clinically grounded, fine-grained annotations of common ICU devices. To our best knowledge, this is the first publicly available pediatric CICU CXR resource with clinically grounded device annotations for device-focused benchmarking. Building on PediaDeviceSeg-1K, we further present PCXR-Copilot, a device-aware pipeline that outputs lung and device masks, optional device-suppressed views, and edema-related visualization maps and scalar indices. The full pipeline has been integrated and runs in real time within the TWIST platform at Boston Children's Hospital, demonstrating feasibility for real-world clinical deployment.
zh_abstract: 入住儿科 ICU 和心脏 ICU 的患者通常需要密集的围手术期支持和频繁的胸部 X 线摄影，以监测支持设备、血管外肺水和体壁水肿。由于重叠的解剖结构和医源性结构掩盖了临床相关信号，放射影像的解读和分析通常很困难。虽然深度学习可以提供决策支持，但向儿科放射影像的转化仍受限于高设备负担以及缺乏带有临床可靠设备标注的儿科数据集。为填补这一空白，我们首先引入 PediaDeviceSeg-1K，这是一个精选数据集，包含 1,000 张儿科 CICU 患者的前后位放射影像，并带有常见 ICU 设备的临床可靠、细粒度标注。据我们所知，这是首个公开可用的、带有临床可靠设备标注的儿科 CICU CXR 资源，用于以设备为中心的基准测试。在 PediaDeviceSeg-1K 的基础上，我们进一步提出 PCXR-Copilot，一个设备感知流程，可输出肺和设备掩膜、可选的设备抑制视图，以及与水肿相关的可视化图和标量指数。完整流程已整合并在波士顿儿童医院的 TWIST 平台内实时运行，展示了真实世界临床部署的可行性。

title: Multimodal-Conditioned Latent Diffusion Models for Spatiotemporal Brain MRI Forecasting
zh_title: 多模态条件潜扩散模型预测脑MRI时空演变
summary: 提出MC-LDM，训练中使用MRI、tau-PET、CDR与APOE4等多模态生物标志物，推理时仅用基线MRI等预测阿尔茨海默病脑结构变化。
key_points: 用LoRA微调潜扩散模型以提升数据效率
训练融合MRI、tau-PET、CDR与APOE4
推理仅依赖基线MRI、APOE4与元数据
reason: 预印本新方法，有明确临床可用性设计，但缺乏外部验证信息
abstract: Spatiotemporal forecasting of 3D anatomical changes is a critical generative vision challenge for modeling Alzheimer's Disease (AD) progression. While brain MRI forecasting from single-modality data has advanced, other key complementary multimodal biomarkers remain underutilized. In this work, we propose the Multimodal-Conditioned Latent Diffusion Model (MC-LDM), a novel framework for patient-specific brain MRI synthesis. MC-LDM leverages multimodal biomarkers---MRI, tau-PET, Clinical Dementia Rating (CDR), and APOE4---during training, but relies only on baseline MRI, APOE4, and patient metadata at inference, reflecting realistic clinical availability. Our contributions are threefold: (1) a Latent Diffusion Model (LDM) fine-tuned via Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) for data-efficient learning; (2) a multimodal conditioning that integrates molecular and clinical signals to model heterogeneous disease trajectories; and (3) auxiliary predictors estimating unobserved multimodal biomarkers from MRI features and patient covariates to condition the diffusion model, removing the need for these assessments at inference. Trained on 1,355 visits from 852 subjects in the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI), MC-LDM reduces average regional volumetric MAE by 18% over the second-best baseline on an independent test set of 664 visits. To our knowledge, MC-LDM represents the first diffusion-based framework to leverage multimodal priors for MRI forecasting. This conceptual advancement enables patient-specific trajectory generation that captures aspects of AD heterogeneity not observable from structural anatomy alone, bridging the gap between rich multimodal supervision and the strict constraints of routine clinical deployment. Code is available at: https://github.com/antonioscardace/MC-LDM.
zh_abstract: 三维解剖变化的时空预测是建模阿尔茨海默病（Alzheimer's Disease, AD）进展的一项关键生成式视觉挑战。虽然基于单模态数据的脑部MRI预测已取得进展，但其他关键互补的多模态生物标志物仍未得到充分利用。在本工作中，我们提出多模态条件潜在扩散模型（Multimodal-Conditioned Latent Diffusion Model, MC-LDM），这是一种用于患者特异性脑部MRI合成的新框架。MC-LDM在训练期间利用多模态生物标志物——MRI、tau-PET、临床痴呆评定量表（Clinical Dementia Rating, CDR）和APOE4——但在推理时仅依赖基线MRI、APOE4和患者元数据，反映了现实临床可获得性。我们的贡献有三方面：（1）通过低秩适应（Low-Rank Adaptation, LoRA）微调的潜在扩散模型（Latent Diffusion Model, LDM），以实现数据高效学习；（2）整合分子和临床信号的多模态条件化，以建模异质性疾病的轨迹；（3）辅助预测器从MRI特征和患者协变量估计未观测到的多模态生物标志物，以对扩散模型进行条件化，从而在推理时无需这些评估。MC-LDM在阿尔茨海默病神经影像学倡议（Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative, ADNI）中852名受试者的1,355次访视上训练，在包含664次访视的独立测试集上，相较于第二佳基线，将平均区域体积MAE降低了18%。据我们所知，MC-LDM是首个利用多模态先验进行MRI预测的基于扩散的框架。这一概念性进展使得能够生成患者特异性轨迹，捕捉仅从结构解剖无法观察到的AD异质性方面，弥合丰富的多模态监督与常规临床部署严格约束之间的差距。代码见：https://github.com/antonioscardace/MC-LDM。

title: How Robust Are Prognostic Radiomic Features? Comparing Selection Techniques on Pooled Glioblastoma Cohorts
zh_title: 胶质母细胞瘤预后影像组学特征稳健性
summary: 在三个公开队列705例IDH野生型胶质母细胞瘤中比较三种特征筛选方法对预后影像组学特征选择的一致性。
key_points: 对数秩检验选99个、Cox选72个特征
三种方法共同选中仅5个特征
含年龄与瘤周T2纹理等特征
reason: 多队列公开数据的方法稳健性分析，但属回顾性、无外部模型验证
abstract: Radiomic survival studies in glioblastoma report heterogeneous prognostic features, but how much of this stems from the methodology itself is rarely examined. We analysed the association of 463 radiomic, anatomical and clinical features from pre-treatment MRI with overall survival in 705 IDH-wildtype glioblastoma patients from three public cohorts, using three techniques: a log-rank test after median split, univariate Cox regression (both Benjamini-Hochberg corrected) and an XGBoost regressor interpreted with SHAP. The log-rank test selected 99 features, Cox regression 72 and SHAP its top 20; five were selected by all three: age, a peritumoural T2 texture feature, the number of connected peritumoural mask components and two image-level intensity maxima. The two survival tests shared 51 features, about half of the SHAP top 20 were also selected by either test, and where selections overlapped, effect directions agreed. Many selections were PyRadiomics diagnostic descriptors that are not restricted to tumour voxels. Analytical pipeline choices, including ranking method, pre-filtering and descriptor handling, can substantially influence which features appear prognostic.
zh_abstract: 胶质母细胞瘤的影像组学生存研究报告了异质性预后特征，但其中有多少源于方法学本身却很少被考察。我们分析了来自治疗前MRI的463个影像组学、解剖学和临床特征与705例IDH野生型胶质母细胞瘤患者总生存的关联，这些患者来自三个公共队列，使用三种技术：中位数分割后的log-rank检验、单变量Cox回归（两者均经Benjamini-Hochberg校正）以及用SHAP解释的XGBoost回归器。log-rank检验选出99个特征，Cox回归选出72个，SHAP选出其前20个；三种方法均选出的有五个：年龄、一个瘤周T2纹理特征、连通瘤周掩膜组件数以及两个图像级强度最大值。两种生存检验共享51个特征，SHAP前20个中约有一半也被任一检验选出，且在选出的特征重叠处，效应方向一致。许多被选特征是不限于肿瘤体素的PyRadiomics诊断描述符。分析流程选择，包括排序方法、预过滤和描述符处理，可显著影响哪些特征表现为预后相关。

title: UtilityBench: Measuring Language Model Utility When Errors Have Different Costs
zh_title: UtilityBench：按错误代价衡量语言模型效用
summary: 提出纳入错误代价差异的效用评估范式，并构建1.5万条可验证答案的基准，含医疗等高风险场景。
key_points: 以最佳-最差标度量化错误严重度
效用值指导模型作答或弃答
基准含15000条可验证实例
reason: 预印本基准构建，思路有新意但医疗场景仅为动机，证据有限
abstract: As language models are increasingly deployed in real-world scenarios with important outcomes, the impact of their mistakes often extends far beyond what correctness can capture. In domains like medicine, a single error can lead to serious consequences and put patient safety at risk. However, mainstream evaluation protocols still treat all errors as equal, overlooking the spectrum of real-world costs. To address this, we propose a utility-based evaluation paradigm that explicitly incorporates the varying consequences of errors. Guided by this principle, we develop UtilityBench, a large-scale benchmark of 15,000 instances with verifiable answers, quantifying error severity using Best-Worst Scaling to elicit meaningful, data-driven cost estimates. These quantified utilities shape when a model should answer or abstain, guiding it to make decisions that align with the true importance of each scenario. As another merit, we introduce UtilityAUC, a metric that measures the area under the utility curve determined by a model's response ordering, thereby enabling utility preference alignment beyond error frequency. Our theoretical analysis demonstrates that UtilityAUC can distinguish between models where standard accuracy and AURC fall short. Empirically, evaluating 20 state-of-the-art models, we find that greater accuracy or more advanced architectures do not reliably translate to higher UtilityAUC, highlighting a gap between problem-solving ability and responsible decision-making in language model evaluation.
zh_abstract: 随着语言模型越来越多地部署在具有重要结果真实世界场景中，其错误的影响往往远超正确性所能刻画的范围。在医学等领域，单个错误可能导致严重后果并使患者安全面临风险。然而，主流评估协议仍将所有错误视为同等重要，忽视了真实世界成本的范围。为解决这一问题，我们提出一种基于效用的评估范式，明确纳入错误的不同后果。在该原则指导下，我们开发了 UtilityBench，这是一个包含 15,000 个具有可验证答案实例的大规模基准，使用 Best-Worst Scaling（最佳-最差缩放）量化错误严重程度，以引出有意义且数据驱动的成本估计。这些量化效用决定模型何时应回答或弃答，引导其做出与每个场景真实重要性一致的决策。另一项优点是，我们引入 UtilityAUC，该指标衡量由模型响应排序确定的效用曲线下面积，从而能够实现超越错误频率的效用偏好对齐。我们的理论分析表明，UtilityAUC 可以区分标准准确率和 AURC 无法区分的模型。在实证方面，评估 20 个最先进模型后，我们发现更高的准确率或更先进的架构并不能可靠地转化为更高的 UtilityAUC，这凸显了语言模型评估中问题解决能力与负责任决策之间的差距。

title: Multi-scale Fusion of Fast Vision Mamba and Foundation Model Features for Patch-Level Gleason Grading in Computational Pathology
zh_title: 多尺度FastVim与基础模型特征融合的Gleason分级
summary: 预印本提出基于状态空间模型的多尺度分类器，融合病理基础模型与FastVim特征做前列腺癌Gleason分级。
key_points: 针对Gleason分级中分级间形态差异细微与类别不平衡问题
冻结的病理基础模型特征与轻量FastVim特征互补融合
目标是在有限数据与算力下实现多尺度块级分类
reason: 预印本方法有新意但仅块级任务，未见外部验证或公开权重，属值得一看档
abstract: Automated Gleason grading of prostate whole slide images (WSIs) enables faster and more consistent cancer risk stratification. However, it remains a challenging task due to the subtle morphological differences between grades, the severe class imbalance arising from rare patterns, and the diagnostic features that span multiple spatial scales. Pathology foundation models (FMs) extract strong patch representations but often operate at a single-scale, which limits spatial context and disproportionately affects classes that depend on broader context. The challenge of fusing multiple scales and complementary models, with minimal data and computational resources, remains unresolved. We propose a multi-scale classifier built on state-space models. Our method combines two complementary feature sources: a frozen foundation model, and a lightweight FastVim, pre-trained on ImageNet and distilled from the foundation model, that reads the raw image crops. At each scale, a Mamba model encodes the features from both sources with linear-time spatial context, and a jointly trained head fuses the encoded representations into one prediction. On the PANDA dataset, our method reaches macro F1 of 0.894 and Gleason 5 F1 of 0.802 under 5-fold cross-validation, a 12% and 21% relative improvement over the best single-scale model. A controlled study over 5 foundation models, 5 base classifiers and 3 scales confirms that the gain holds across encoders, with larger improvements observed at smaller scales.
zh_abstract: 前列腺全切片图像（WSIs）的自动化 Gleason 分级能够实现更快、更一致的癌症风险分层。然而，由于不同分级之间存在细微形态学差异、罕见模式造成严重类别不平衡，以及诊断特征跨越多个空间尺度，这仍是一项具有挑战性的任务。病理基础模型（FMs）可提取强 patch 表示，但通常仅在单一尺度上运行，这限制了空间上下文，并对依赖更广泛上下文的类别产生不成比例的影响。在数据和计算资源极少的情况下融合多个尺度与互补模型仍是一个未解决的难题。我们提出一种基于状态空间模型的多尺度分类器。我们的方法结合两种互补的特征来源：一个冻结的基础模型，以及一个轻量级 FastVim（在 ImageNet 上预训练并从基础模型蒸馏而来）读取原始图像裁剪块。在每个尺度上，Mamba 模型以线性时间空间上下文对来自两个来源的特征进行编码，一个联合训练的分类头将编码表示融合为单一预测。在 PANDA 数据集上，我们的方法在 5 折交叉验证下达到 macro F1 为 0.894、Gleason 5 F1 为 0.802，相对于最佳单尺度模型分别相对提升 12% 和 21%。一项涵盖 5 个基础模型、5 个基础分类器和 3 个尺度的对照研究证实，该增益在不同编码器上均成立，且在较小尺度上观察到更大的提升。

title: Residual-Guided Adaptive Tucker Rank Allocation for Parameter-Efficient MCI Conversion Prediction
zh_title: 残差引导Tucker秩分配的MCI转化预测
summary: 预印本提出残差引导的自适应Tucker秩分配方法，用于3D预训练网络参数高效微调以预测MCI转化。
key_points: 在固定适配器参数预算下联合选择输入输出通道秩
用扰动分析以逐层重建残差界定近似误差
动态规划在预算约束下最小化残差总和
reason: 参数高效微调新方法用于MCI转化预测，证据限于预印本且无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Allocating limited trainable capacity across convolutional layers is a central challenge in parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) of pretrained three-dimensional (3D) networks. We propose Residual-Guided Adaptive Tucker Rank Allocation, which jointly selects input- and output-channel ranks under a fixed adapter-parameter budget while preserving the spatial kernel modes. To guide rank selection, we learn task-specific proxy updates from downstream training data and approximate them using candidate Tucker rank pairs. A perturbation analysis bounds the output discrepancy between the fixed proxy network and its Tucker approximation in terms of layerwise reconstruction residuals, motivating residual-based allocation. We normalize each squared residual by the corresponding proxy-update energy to compare relative approximation errors across layers. Dynamic programming minimizes their sum under a global budget constraint that accounts for both channel factors and the Tucker core. This yields a globally optimal allocation over the specified candidate rank pairs. We evaluate the method on the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) cohort for predicting conversion from mild cognitive impairment to Alzheimer's disease within 36 months, using hippocampal segmentation pretraining. Across five random seeds, the proposed method achieves a mean area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.7706, compared with 0.7239 for fixed-ratio Tucker adaptation and 0.7430 for full fine-tuning. The total number of trainable parameters is limited to approximately 0.618 million, accounting for only 1.45% of the full model. Adaptive Tucker rank allocation thus provides an effective approach to parameter-efficient transfer learning in 3D medical imaging.
zh_abstract: 在预训练三维（3D）网络的参数高效微调（PEFT）中，如何在卷积层之间分配有限的可训练容量是一个核心挑战。我们提出残差引导的自适应 Tucker 秩分配（Residual-Guided Adaptive Tucker Rank Allocation），其在固定适配器参数预算下联合选择输入通道秩和输出通道秩，同时保留空间核模式。为引导秩选择，我们从下游训练数据中学习任务特定的代理更新（proxy updates），并使用候选 Tucker 秩对对其进行近似。一项扰动分析根据逐层重建残差，界定了固定代理网络与其 Tucker 近似之间的输出差异，从而为基于残差的分配提供依据。我们将每个平方残差按相应的代理更新能量归一化，以比较不同层之间的相对近似误差。动态规划在考虑通道因子和 Tucker 核心的全局预算约束下最小化它们的总和。这就在指定的候选秩对上产生了全局最优分配。我们在阿尔茨海默病神经影像学倡议（ADNI）队列上评估该方法，用于预测轻度认知障碍在 36 个月内转化为阿尔茨海默病，并使用海马分割预训练。在五个随机种子上，所提出方法达到平均受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）为 0.7706，而固定比例 Tucker 适配为 0.7239，全量微调为 0.7430。可训练参数总数限制在约 0.618 million（61.8 万），仅占完整模型的 1.45%。因此，自适应 Tucker 秩分配为 3D 医学影像中的参数高效迁移学习提供了一种有效方法。

title: When to Stop Asking: Factor Coverage Bias and LLM Determinability Judgments with Underspecified Information in Medicine
zh_title: 医学信息不足时LLM可判定性判断的覆盖偏差
summary: 预印本构建受控配对基准，考察医学信息不足时大模型是否以信息量而非结论可改变性判断可判定性。
key_points: 提出“因子覆盖偏差”概念：以信息量代替可判定性线索
构建可判定—不可判定配对的受控基准测试
关注过早下结论或过度检查等可信度风险
reason: 提出新的临床相关评测基准但为预印本、单一受控设置，属值得一看档
abstract: Clinical decision-making often begins with underspecified information and requires not only gathering missing information but also knowing when to stop. This calls for judging determinability (whether the available information is sufficient for a decision) by considering whether missing information could change the conclusion, not simply the amount of available decision-relevant information. Reliance on this amount as a cue for determinability, which we term \textit{factor coverage bias}, could undermine the trustworthiness of large language models (LLMs) through premature conclusions or excessive information gathering, such as unnecessary invasive tests. Yet whether LLMs exhibit this bias remains insufficiently studied. To address this gap, we construct a controlled pairwise benchmark in which LLMs identify the determinable case within each determinable--undeterminable pair. We add a decision-relevant factor to either side while keeping each case's determinability unchanged, and similarly add irrelevant text to distinguish this bias from context-length effects. Adding a relevant factor made LLMs more likely to select the augmented case as determinable even when it remained undeterminable, an effect that persisted with increased reasoning effort, while adding irrelevant text made them less likely to select the augmented case, an effect that reasoning substantially reduced. These findings identify factor coverage bias as a failure mode distinct from context-length effects and a potential risk to LLM trustworthiness. Our work provides an evaluation framework for LLM trustworthiness under underspecification.
zh_abstract: 临床决策常常始于信息不充分的情形，并且不仅需要收集缺失信息，还需要知道何时停止。这要求通过考虑缺失信息是否会改变结论，而不仅仅是考虑可用决策相关信息的数量，来判断可判定性（现有信息是否足以作出决策）。将这种信息数量作为可判定性的线索——我们称之为因素覆盖偏差（factor coverage bias）——可能通过过早下结论或过度收集信息（例如不必要的侵入性检查）而削弱大语言模型（LLMs）的可信性。然而，LLMs 是否表现出这种偏差仍未得到充分研究。为填补这一空白，我们构建了一个受控的成对基准，其中 LLMs 在每个可判定—不可判定对中识别可判定病例。我们在任一侧加入一个决策相关因素，同时保持每个病例的可判定性不变，并类似地加入无关文本，以将该偏差与上下文长度效应区分开来。加入相关因素使 LLMs 更可能将增强后的病例选为可判定，即使该病例仍不可判定；这种效应在增加推理投入后仍然存在。而加入无关文本使它们更不可能选择增强后的病例，推理大幅减弱了这种效应。这些发现将因素覆盖偏差识别为一种不同于上下文长度效应的失效模式，并构成对 LLM 可信性的潜在风险。我们的工作为信息不充分情形下的 LLM 可信性提供了一个评估框架。

title: Reliability-Preserving Compression for Deployable Medical Image Segmentation
zh_title: 面向可部署医学图像分割的可靠性保持压缩
summary: 预印本提出SGAV-MP的训练后压缩框架，在MRI/CT分割中同时保持精度与不确定性信号。
key_points: 指出Dice稳定不代表压缩后不确定性信号保持
以收益—风险评分排序量化动作并做整模型可靠性校验
在层精度选择中引入校准集上的可靠性约束
reason: 关注压缩后不确定性的部署安全问题，方法清晰但为预印本、无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Post-training compression of pretrained medical segmentation models commonly uses quantization, pruning, or distillation to reduce model size and computational cost. Existing medical segmentation quantization studies mainly evaluate Dice, model size, memory, and latency, but this is incomplete for safety-critical use because compressed models should also preserve uncertainty signals that indicate unreliable predictions. We study this problem in compressed MRI/CT segmentation and formalize why Dice can remain stable while uncertainty changes. Motivated by this failure mode, we propose score-guided aggregate-validated mixed precision (SGAV-MP), a post-training compression framework that selects layer precisions under reliability constraints. SGAV-MP ranks quantization actions with a compact benefit-risk score and accepts them only after full-model reliability validation on a calibration set. Across five 2D backbones and three 3D benchmarks, SGAV-MP preserves FP32-level Dice and high uncertainty-map agreement, achieving $3.59\times$--$7.8\times$ compression in 2D and $4.73\times$--$7.82\times$ in 3D. We also report backend-supported TensorRT deployment measurements separately to distinguish runtime execution from reliability-preserving storage compression.
zh_abstract: 预训练医学分割模型的后训练压缩通常使用量化、剪枝或蒸馏来减小模型大小和计算成本。现有医学分割量化研究主要评估 Dice、模型大小、内存和延迟，但这对于安全关键用途并不完整，因为压缩模型还应保留指示预测不可靠的不确定性信号。我们在压缩 MRI/CT 分割中研究这一问题，并形式化说明为何 Dice 可以保持稳定而不确定性发生变化。受这一失效模式启发，我们提出分数引导的聚合验证混合精度（score-guided aggregate-validated mixed precision, SGAV-MP），这是一种在可靠性约束下选择层精度的后训练压缩框架。SGAV-MP 用一个紧凑的收益—风险分数对量化操作排序，并且仅在校准集上完成全模型可靠性验证后才接受这些操作。在五个 2D 骨干网络和三个 3D 基准上，SGAV-MP 保持了 FP32 水平的 Dice 和高不确定性图一致性，在 2D 中实现 $3.59\times$--$7.8\times$ 的压缩，在 3D 中实现 $4.73\times$--$7.82\times$ 的压缩。我们还单独报告后端支持的 TensorRT 部署测量结果，以将运行时执行与保持可靠性的存储压缩区分开来。

title: SNO-PI: Label-Scarce SNOMED CT Entity Linking with Pre-trained Encoders and Curated Terminology Knowledge
zh_title: SNO-PI：少标注下的SNOMED CT实体链接
summary: 在SNOMED国际实体链接基准上排名第一，宏平均字符IoU 0.5387，较主办方参考系统相对提升18%。
key_points: 基于272份MIMIC-IV出院小结，覆盖约21.9万概念中的6595个
流程含高召回跨度提议、SapBERT检索与三编码器列表式重排
编码器先在无标注病历、后在SNOMED同义词上继续预训练
reason: 公开基准排名第一但标注样本仅272份，无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: We present SNO-PI, the top-performing submission on SNOMED International's SNOMED CT Entity Linking Benchmark as of 18 October 2026. SNO-PI achieves a macro character IoU of 0.5387, outperforming the organisers' reference system (0.4582; based on the 2024 challenge winner's approach) by 18% relative. Linking clinical mentions to SNOMED CT is a zero- and few-shot problem over a very large label space: the 272 annotated MIMIC-IV discharge summaries cover only 6,595 of the roughly 219,000 eligible concepts, and a third of those occur only once. This motivates a design built on transfer from pre-trained models and human-curated knowledge. SNO-PI combines high-recall span proposal, SapBERT candidate retrieval and listwise ensemble reranking with three BERT-family encoders, each further pre-trained with masked language modelling on unlabelled MIMIC-IV notes and then on SNOMED CT synonyms and hierarchy before task fine-tuning. We find that curated knowledge helps most on concepts never seen in training, yet these concepts remain the main source of error.
zh_abstract: 我们提出 SNO-PI，截至 2026 年 10 月 18 日，它是 SNOMED International 的 SNOMED CT Entity Linking Benchmark（SNOMED CT 实体链接基准）上表现最佳的提交。SNO-PI 达到 0.5387 的宏字符 IoU（macro character IoU），相对优于组织者参考系统（0.4582；基于 2024 年挑战赛获胜者的方法）18%。将临床提及链接到 SNOMED CT 是在非常大的标签空间上的零样本和少样本问题：272 份标注的 MIMIC-IV 出院小结仅覆盖约 219,000 个合格概念中的 6,595 个，其中三分之一仅出现一次。这促使我们采用基于预训练模型迁移和人工整理知识的设计。SNO-PI 结合高召回跨度提议、SapBERT 候选检索以及使用三个 BERT 家族编码器的 listwise 集成重排序；每个编码器先在未标注 MIMIC-IV 记录上进行掩码语言建模进一步预训练，然后在 SNOMED CT 同义词和层级结构上进一步预训练，之后进行任务微调。我们发现，整理好的知识在训练中从未见过的概念上帮助最大，但这些概念仍是主要错误来源。

title: Learning the Dose Manifold: A Latent Diffusion Framework for Volumetric Dose Prediction in Automated Radiotherapy Treatment Planning
zh_title: 潜扩散框架用于放疗体积剂量预测
summary: 提出LaDose潜扩散框架，实现全体积剂量预测并压缩剂量图，用于自动放疗计划。
key_points: 面向自动放疗计划的三维剂量预测
用剂量自编码器压缩剂量图
预印本，尚未见临床验证
reason: 有新意的放疗剂量预测预印本，缺乏外部临床验证
abstract: Automated treatment planning (ATP) aims to reduce the unwarranted inter-planner variability of manual planning, while improving treatment quality and efficiency. Most ATP pipelines rely on the prediction of the achievable three-dimensional dose distribution for a given anatomy and the subsequent optimization of machine parameters to reproduce it. Diffusion-based methods are largely slice-wise due to the high dimensionality of radiotherapy data, and assume a one-to-one mapping between anatomy and optimal dose despite the multi-objective nature of treatment planning. They are evaluated on their ability to match reference doses and rarely on their integration in ATP frameworks. We present LaDose, a latent diffusion framework for fully volumetric dose prediction. An autoencoder learned on dose distributions, trained so that perturbed latents decode to plausible doses, compresses dose maps 128-fold and enables 3D diffusion on a single GPU. Prescription values are represented as exact scalar vectors that bypass the image encoder, avoiding resampling and latent compression. Multiscale classifier-free guidance allows for the modulation of clinical trade-offs at inference, without retraining or additional labeled data. On 900 clinically delivered head-and-neck volumetric modulated arc therapy plans from five centers, LaDose reached a median absolute error of 1.18 Gy (1.4--1.8\% of the prescription) and was the only one of six frameworks free of systematic bias with respect to the reference distribution. Guidance scales acted predictably on target coverage and organ-at-risk sparing. Integrated with direct aperture optimization, the pipeline generated plans in 15.2 minutes; in a blinded review, senior clinicians rated 14 of 15 plans acceptable without editing.
zh_abstract: 自动治疗计划（ATP）旨在减少人工计划中不合理的计划者间变异性，同时提高治疗质量和效率。大多数 ATP 流程依赖于预测给定解剖结构可达到的三维剂量分布，并随后优化机器参数以复现该分布。由于放疗数据的高维性，基于扩散的方法大多按切片处理，并且尽管治疗计划具有多目标性质，却假设解剖结构与最优剂量之间存在一对一映射。它们根据匹配参考剂量的能力进行评估，而很少评估其在 ATP 框架中的集成。我们提出 LaDose，一种用于完全 volumetric 剂量预测的潜在扩散框架。在剂量分布上学习的自编码器经过训练，使扰动后的潜在表示能够解码为合理剂量，其将剂量图压缩 128 倍，并支持在单个 GPU 上进行三维扩散。处方值表示为精确的标量向量，绕过图像编码器，避免重采样和潜在压缩。多尺度无分类器引导允许在推理时调节临床权衡，而无需重新训练或额外标注数据。在来自五个中心的 900 个临床实施的头颈部容积调强弧形治疗计划上，LaDose 达到 1.18 Gy 的中位绝对误差（处方的 1.4–1.8%），并且是六个框架中唯一一个相对于参考分布无系统偏差的框架。引导尺度对靶区覆盖和危及器官保护的作用可预测。与直接孔径优化集成后，该流程在 15.2 分钟内生成计划；在盲法评审中，资深临床医生将 15 个计划中的 14 个评为无需编辑即可接受。

zh_title: ATA Action就生成式AI医疗器械向FDA提交回应
summary: ATA Action就FDA对生成式AI医疗器械的监管议题提交回应，涉及双轴风险、PCCP与厂商责任。

title: CoRe-WM: Conditioned Response-State World Modeling for Longitudinal Treatment-Response Prediction in Breast DCE-MRI
zh_title: CoRe-WM：乳腺DCE-MRI纵向治疗反应预测
summary: 将纵向pCR预测建模为世界模型问题，学习以患者临床特征和给定治疗为条件的潜在状态转移，用于乳腺DCE-MRI治疗反应预测。
key_points: 把纵向pCR预测转化为潜在状态转移建模
以临床画像和治疗方案调制转移函数
因子化响应状态通路解耦治疗反应动态
reason: 预印本方法创新，针对纵向影像预测，但证据限于摘要
abstract: Pathologic complete response (pCR) after neoadjuvant chemotherapy is a key prognostic indicator in aggressive breast cancer, yet existing prediction approaches either rely on pretreatment imaging alone, missing the patient's evolving response, or optimize multi-visit classifiers under direct outcome supervision, coupling representation learning with the clinical endpoint. We formulate longitudinal pCR prediction as a world-modeling problem and propose Conditioned Response-state World Modeling (CoRe-WM), which learns a latent state-transition model that predicts the next imaging state from the observed sequence. The transition function is conditioned on patient clinical profile and assigned therapy through additive shift and feature-wise modulation, enabling patient- and treatment-specific dynamics. A Factorized Response State pathway further decouples treatment-response dynamics from imaging appearance by encoding the structural prior that response manifests primarily in lesion morphology. After pretraining, all parameters are frozen and a linear readout predicts pCR at each clinical decision point. We evaluate CoRe-WM on I-SPY2 under five-fold cross-validation and assess cross-cohort transfer on I-SPY1. CoRe-WM achieves the highest discrimination among all evaluated methods at every prospective decision point, and demonstrates robust cross-cohort transfer. Ablation studies identify patient-profile conditioning and the factorized response pathway as the principal contributors. These results establish world-model-based representation learning as a promising framework for outcome prediction in oncology and beyond.
zh_abstract: 新辅助化疗后的病理完全缓解（pathologic complete response, pCR）是侵袭性乳腺癌的关键预后指标，但现有预测方法要么仅依赖治疗前影像，遗漏患者不断演变的反应，要么在直接结局监督下优化多次访视分类器，将表征学习与临床终点耦合。我们将纵向pCR预测表述为一个世界建模问题，并提出条件化反应状态世界建模（Conditioned Response-state World Modeling, CoRe-WM），其学习一个潜在状态转移模型，从观测序列预测下一影像状态。该转移函数通过加性偏移和特征级调制，以患者临床特征和所分配治疗为条件，从而实现患者和治疗特异性动态。因子化反应状态通路进一步通过编码“反应主要体现在病灶形态学”这一结构性先验，将治疗反应动态与影像外观解耦。预训练后，所有参数被冻结，线性读出器在每个临床决策点预测pCR。我们在I-SPY2上通过五折交叉验证评估CoRe-WM，并在I-SPY1上评估跨队列迁移。CoRe-WM在所有评估方法中于每个前瞻性决策点均取得最高判别性能，并表现出稳健的跨队列迁移。消融研究确定患者特征条件化和因子化反应通路为主要贡献因素。这些结果确立基于世界模型的表征学习作为肿瘤学及其他领域结局预测的一个有前景的框架。

title: AI Analysis of CT Scans to Classify Ovarian Tumours as Benign, Borderline or Malignant Before Surgery
zh_title: AI分析CT区分卵巢肿瘤良恶性试验注册
summary: 荷兰单中心注册1300例观察性研究，评估AI在术前CT中区分卵巢肿瘤良性、交界性与恶性的能力。

abstract: [Computational and structural biotechnology journal] Bladder cancer ranks as the 10th most common malignancy worldwide. Advances in technology are continuously reshaping its diagnosis, treatment selection, and prognosis assessment. In recent years, artificial intelligence (AI) has demonstrated marked potential in transforming bladder cancer care. By integrating and analyzing multi-source data, AI enhances the precision and efficiency of disease management. This review comprehensively examines the current applications of AI across various domains, including radiographic imaging analysis, pathological diagnosis, cystoscopic image processing, molecular subtyping, drug development, organoid research, prognostic modeling, and medical device innovation. This narrative review aims to inform the future development of AI-driven digital health systems, ultimately contributing to the realization of precision medicine and personalized management for bladder cancer patients.
