abstract: [Expert review of gastroenterology & hepatology] Liver transplantation (LT) is a uniquely curative treatment for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), as it removes both the tumor and the underlying cirrhotic liver. However, organ scarcity makes candidate selection a central clinical and ethical issue. Over the past three decades, selection has evolved from simple morphologic thresholds toward increasingly multidimensional models of oncologic risk. This review examines the evolution of selection criteria for LT in HCC, from the Milan criteria and subsequent morphology-based expansions to models incorporating tumor biology, serum biomarkers, treatment response, waiting-list dynamics, and artificial intelligence. The literature discussed includes landmark morphologic criteria, AFP-based models, PIVKA-II and AFP-L3 integration, downstaging strategies, dynamic scores such as TRAIN and NYCA, and machine-learning models including MoRAL-AI, TRIUMPH, and TRAIN-AI. The field is moving from categorical eligibility rules toward individualized, continuous risk estimation. Future selection should not aim merely to expand transplant access, but to identify patients most likely to achieve durable oncologic benefit. Artificial intelligence, radiomics, liquid biopsy, and multi-omic profiling may refine risk prediction, but their clinical adoption will require prospective validation, transparency, calibration, transportability, and integration into allocation systems.

abstract: [Frontiers in molecular medicine] Diagnosis, assessment and monitoring of Huntington's disease (HD) requires measurement of a complex array of motor, cognitive and psychiatric symptoms over sustained periods. However, the prodromal stages often span over a decade with symptoms presenting in a non-linear manner with short term fluctuations. This presents challenges for investigational drug development as treatment effects may become masked. To help address this issue, a number of digital health technology tools are being investigated for use in HD studies with increasing degrees of utility and sophistication. Herein we outline how remote passive monitoring technologies could be integrated into managed care of HD patients, and have the potential to inform algorithms and digital tools which could be used to improve our understanding of disease trajectories and improve early detection rates. Steps to implementation and the potential to derive learnings from adjacent technologies is presented, affording a key opportunity for next- generation approaches to patient monitoring. Measures derived from such technologies will also provide data to capture disease progression and treatment effects with high fidelity and granularity, and complement existing clinical research outcomes (clinROs) and patient reported outcomes (PRO's). Given the ethical, economic, and societal burden presented by neurodegenerative diseases, such developments could have long term impact in managed healthcare.

abstract: [Frontiers in oncology] Glioblastoma represents the most aggressive primary malignant tumor of the central nervous system, characterized by extensive intratumoral heterogeneity, profound immunosuppression, therapeutic resistance, and poor clinical outcomes. Although immunotherapy has revolutionized cancer treatment, its clinical efficacy in GBM remains limited, largely due to the complexity of the tumor ecosystem and the lack of validated predictive biomarkers. Recent advances in single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq), spatial transcriptomics, and artificial intelligence (AI)-based computational approaches have provided unprecedented opportunities to decipher tumor heterogeneity and identify clinically actionable biomarkers. This mini-review integrates studies related to scRNA-seq and its combination technology, further elaborating on the tumor plasticity, immune suppression, and metabolic-epigenetic reprogramming mechanisms of GBM. The article systematically summarizes the complete analysis process of integrating single-cell multi-omics data by AI and highlights the application value of AI in validating biomarkers. The above research ideas are expected to overcome clinical resistance problems, optimize patient stratification schemes, and enhance the efficacy of immunotherapy, providing theoretical support for developing highly stable prognostic biomarkers and achieving individualized precise immunotherapy for glioblastoma.

abstract: [Frontiers in medicine] The current trend involving the use of paper-based medical prescriptions and the exchange of such by the social media is a major problem in automated and accurate text extraction in healthcare processes. This paper suggests a complete smart pipeline to digitize the images of medical prescriptions with lightweight deep learning-based classification, specialized Optical Character Recognition (OCR) engines, and comparative benchmarking of results using a large language model (LLM). The web scraped images of medical prescriptions are initially processed through a GhostNetV2 classifier to differentiate between handwritten and digital medical prescriptions. According to this choice, digital images are sent to PaddleOCR, and handwritten images are considered in Tesseract OCR so that each image could be processed by the best suitable recognition engine. The OCR outputs from both branches are benchmarked against GPT-4o (OpenAI) as an independent baseline to assess competitive performance and provide error-rate context. Experimental analysis shows that the suggested adaptive routing strategy is characterized by the fact that it has a high classification rate and the character and word error rates are significantly lower than those single-OCR techniques. The system is competitive with, though does not exceed, the raw accuracy of a state-of-the-art LLM-based OCR baseline (GPT-4o), while offering practical advantages in cost, transparency, and on-premises deployability that the black-box, per-call LLM baseline does not. The findings verify that the combination of lightweight classifiers and multi-OCR decision routing and multi-LLM-aided comparative benchmarking offers a scalable and robust solution to real-world medical prescriptions digitization, which adds to better automation, accuracy, and safety in healthcare information processing.
zh_abstract: 在医疗流程中，自动且准确地提取文本的一个主要问题，是当前使用纸质医疗处方以及通过社交媒体交换此类处方的趋势。本文提出了一套完整的智能流水线，用于将医疗处方图像数字化，包括轻量级基于深度学习的分类、专用光学字符识别（OCR）引擎，以及使用大语言模型（LLM）对结果进行比较基准测试。网络抓取的医疗处方图像首先通过 GhostNetV2 分类器处理，以区分手写处方和数字处方。根据该选择，数字图像被发送至 PaddleOCR，手写图像则交由 Tesseract OCR 处理，从而使每张图像都能由最合适的识别引擎处理。来自两个分支的 OCR 输出以 GPT-4o（OpenAI）作为独立基线进行基准比较，以评估竞争性能并提供错误率参照。实验分析表明，所建议的自适应路由策略具有高分类率，并且字符错误率和词错误率显著低于单一 OCR 技术。该系统与最先进的基于 LLM 的 OCR 基线（GPT-4o）的原始准确率相比具有竞争力，尽管并未超过该基线，同时在成本、透明度和本地部署能力方面具有实际优势，而黑箱式、按次调用的 LLM 基线不具备这些优势。研究结果证实，轻量级分类器、多 OCR 决策路由以及多 LLM 辅助的比较基准测试相结合，为现实世界的医疗处方数字化提供了一种可扩展且稳健的解决方案，有助于提升医疗信息处理中的自动化、准确性和安全性。

title: Temporal Evidence Allocation For Longitudinal Clinical Retrieval: A Position And Technical Report
zh_title: 纵向临床检索的时间证据分配
summary: 预印本立场与技术报告提出将纵向病历检索视为在时间上分配有限证据预算，并报告小规模初步研究。
key_points: 指出相似度检索存在时间冗余
分证据分配、候选重建、临床验证三步
Study A仅13查询、20份病历
reason: 预印本初步研究，样本极小，属值得一看偏下
abstract: Electronic health records are written to support care, not retrieval. Across years of oncology notes, the primary diagnosis is restated in report after report, while the events that shape a patient's course, such as a recurrence or a change in therapy, may be recorded only once. A retriever that ranks passages by similarity to the query keeps returning the repeated material and can miss these transitions, that is, it exhibits temporal redundancy across historical narratives. We argue that longitudinal clinical retrieval should be treated as allocating a limited evidence budget across time, not just ranking by relevance. We separate the task into three objectives: temporal evidence allocation, candidate reconstruction, and clinical validation. In Study A (13 clinical queries over 20 patient records, with two-stage reconstruction), the Temporal-15 configuration reaches a milestone slot recall of 0.538, compared with 0.388 for the Global-50 baseline. However, it also retrieves far more evidence (496 versus 50 indexed units per query), so the gain cannot be credited to allocation alone. When evidence is held fixed, removing prompted precedence rules raises schema-order reversals from 0.010 to 0.080. A five-patient, single-query pilot with fixed budgets finds that wider temporal coverage does not reliably yield more dated milestones. Together, these results suggest that how much a record says about a period is a poor guide to how useful that period is as evidence. Because no expert reference timelines are available, our measurements describe retrieval behavior rather than clinical accuracy. This position and technical report presents the retrieval analysis behind the Onco-CONSTRUE framework and sets out a research agenda for budget-constrained longitudinal clinical retrieval.
zh_abstract: 电子健康记录是为支持照护而书写的，而不是为检索而书写的。在多年的肿瘤学记录中，主要诊断在一份又一份报告中重复陈述，而塑造患者病程的事件（例如复发或治疗改变）可能只被记录一次。按与查询的相似度对段落排序的检索器会不断返回重复材料，并可能漏掉这些转变，也就是说，它在历史叙述中表现出时间冗余。我们认为，纵向临床检索应被视为在时间上分配有限的证据预算，而不仅仅是按相关性排序。我们将该任务分为三个目标：时间证据分配、候选重建和临床验证。在研究 A 中（13 个临床查询，覆盖 20 份患者记录，采用两阶段重建），Temporal-15 配置达到 0.538 的里程碑槽位召回率，而 Global-50 基线为 0.388。然而，它也检索到远更多的证据（每次查询 496 个索引单元，而基线为 50 个），因此这一增益不能仅归功于分配。当证据保持固定时，移除提示的优先级规则会使模式顺序反转从 0.010 升至 0.080。一项固定预算的五名患者、单一查询试点发现，更宽的时间覆盖并不能可靠地产出更多带日期的里程碑。总之，这些结果表明，一份记录对某一时期说了多少内容，并不能很好地指导该时期作为证据有多大用处。由于没有专家参考时间线，我们的测量描述的是检索行为，而不是临床准确性。这份立场与技术报告呈现了 Onco-CONSTRUE 框架背后的检索分析，并提出了预算受限的纵向临床检索的研究议程。

title: Doubly Robust Learning of Heterogeneous Survival Treatment Effects under Time-Varying Treatments
zh_title: 时变治疗下异质生存效应的双稳健学习
summary: 提出面向时变治疗与依赖病史删失的双稳健学习框架，用于估计异质生存治疗效应。
key_points: 分离干预窗口与生存随访期
同时校正治疗与删失的序列混杂
现有方法多假设单次基线治疗或无删失
reason: 方法学预印本，仅以医疗场景为例，未报告临床数据验证
abstract: Estimating heterogeneous survival treatment effects (HSTEs) from time-to-event data under time-varying treatments is important in fields such as medicine (e.g., to decide which sequence of treatments is better in terms of survival probability). However, this task is challenging because treatment decisions, patient characteristics, and censoring probability often evolve together, requiring sequential adjustment for both treatments and censoring. Existing survival learners mostly consider a single baseline treatment assignment, while longitudinal treatment-effect learners typically assume uncensored outcomes. In this paper, we introduce a novel doubly robust learner for heterogeneous survival treatment effects under time-varying treatments and history-dependent censoring. Our framework separates the intervention window from the survival horizon, with treatment prescribed for a finite period, after which care follows its natural course. We further establish the favorable theoretical properties of Neyman-orthogonality, rate double robustness and quasi-oracle efficiency. The framework accommodates flexible machine learning models for nuisance estimation and treatment-effect regression. We evaluate our learners through several numerical experiments, demonstrating their effectiveness.
zh_abstract: 在医学等领域（例如，决定哪种治疗顺序在生存概率方面更优），从时间变化治疗下的时间至事件数据中估计异质性生存治疗效应（heterogeneous survival treatment effects, HSTEs）非常重要。然而，该任务具有挑战性，因为治疗决策、患者特征和删失概率往往共同演变，需要对治疗和删失两者进行序贯调整。现有的生存学习器大多考虑单一基线治疗分配，而纵向治疗效应学习器通常假设结局未删失。本文提出一种新的双重稳健学习器，用于时间变化治疗和历史依赖删失下的异质性生存治疗效应。我们的框架将干预窗口与生存期分离，治疗在有限时期内给予，之后照护遵循其自然过程。我们进一步建立了Neyman正交性、速率双重稳健性和准oracle效率等有利理论性质。该框架可容纳用于干扰参数估计（nuisance estimation）和治疗效应回归的灵活机器学习模型。我们通过若干数值实验评估我们的学习器，证明其有效性。

title: EEG-Based Classification of Hypnotic Susceptibility Using Two-Dimensional Convolutional Neural Networks
zh_title: 二维CNN用于EEG催眠易感性分类
summary: 对62名受试者256导EEG用二维CNN分类催眠易感性，采用LOSO交叉验证评估跨被试性能。
key_points: 62名男性受试者，256导密集阵列采集
免手工特征，滑动窗口评估多模型
以留一被试交叉验证获取跨被试性能
reason: 单中心小样本、仅分类指标无临床结局，属增量档
abstract: Guided Imagery (GI) is a mind-based relaxation technique widely used in clinical and therapeutic settings. Objectively assessing whether a patient has entered a relaxed state remains a challenge for clinicians. This study investigates electroencephalography (EEG)-based classification of hypnotic susceptibility using two-dimensional Convolutional Neural Networks (2D CNNs) applied to minimally preprocessed signals, without manual feature extraction. Data were collected from 62 male participants (32 Control, 30 Hypno) using a 256-channel dense array amplifier during Guided Imagery or cognitive task conditions. A sliding-window framework evaluated up to 868 independent models across seven anatomically defined brain regions and 124 ten-second time windows. Segment-level random-split screening was followed by Leave-One-Subject-Out (LOSO) cross-validation to obtain subject-independent performance estimates, and an ensemble approach combined predictions across K = 10 windows. The best single-window model achieved accuracy of 0.82 on the random split. Under LOSO, anterior regions generalised better across subjects: the frontal region achieved mean accuracy of 0.646 (AUC: 0.692). An ensemble of K = 10 windows further improved the prefrontal region to mean accuracy of 0.738. The occipital region, dominant in random-split screening, collapsed to near-chance under LOSO, revealing subject-specific EEG fingerprinting rather than genuine group differences. Bandpass filtering and z-score normalisation suffice for competitive EEG classification without manual feature extraction. Anterior cortical regions are identified as the most generalisable neural markers of hypnotic susceptibility.
zh_abstract: 引导性想象（Guided Imagery, GI）是一种广泛用于临床和治疗环境的心智放松技术。客观评估患者是否进入放松状态对临床医生而言仍是一项挑战。本研究探讨基于脑电图（EEG）的催眠易感性分类，使用二维卷积神经网络（2D CNNs）处理最小预处理的信号，无需人工特征提取。数据来自 62 名男性参与者（32 名对照，30 名催眠），使用 256 通道密集阵列放大器在引导性想象或认知任务条件下采集。一个滑动窗口框架在七个解剖学定义的大脑区域和 124 个十秒时间窗上评估了多达 868 个独立模型。先进行片段级随机划分筛选，随后进行留一受试者交叉验证（LOSO）以获得受试者独立的性能估计，并采用集成方法在 K = 10 个窗口上组合预测。最佳单窗口模型在随机划分上达到 0.82 的准确率。在 LOSO 下，前部区域在受试者间泛化更好：额区达到平均准确率 0.646（AUC：0.692）。K = 10 个窗口的集成进一步将前额区提升至平均准确率 0.738。在随机划分筛选中占主导的枕区在 LOSO 下降至接近随机水平，揭示出受试者特异的 EEG 指纹特征，而非真正的组间差异。带通滤波和 z-score 归一化足以实现具有竞争力的 EEG 分类，无需人工特征提取。前部皮层区域被确定为催眠易感性最具泛化性的神经标志物。

title: Timing-Aware and Interpretable Self-Attention for Event-Based Wearable Task Transition Detection
zh_title: 可穿戴事件特征的任务转换检测自注意力方法
summary: 提出融合时间与时长信息的可解释自注意力模型，用于可穿戴数据中的任务转换检测。
key_points: 以离散事件token编码行为与生理模式
自注意力显式引入时序与持续时间信息
面向连续健康监测与情境化干预
reason: 方法性预印本，摘要未给数据规模与对比结果，属增量档
abstract: Task transition detection aims to identify when a person shifts from one task to another, providing a foundation for continuous health monitoring and timely context-aware interventions. While statistical and deep feature representations have demonstrated strong classification performance, they often rely on aggregated or latent features that are difficult to interpret in behavioural terms. Event-based features provide a compact and interpretable alternative by encoding behavioural and physiological patterns as discrete tokens with explicit semantic meaning, making them well suited for behavioural analysis in health informatics. Self-attention offers a mechanism for modelling interactions among such tokens; however, conventional self-attention classifiers primarily rely on token order and do not explicitly incorporate timing or duration information. As a result, informative temporal cues in event representations may not be fully exploited for task transition detection. This study proposes an event-based time-aware self-attention framework that represents behavioural signals as sequences of discrete events augmented with onset timestamps and durations. Event timing is encoded using a parameter-efficient kernel-based representation, while a novel type-aware duration embedding modulates information propagation according to event persistence. Experiments on a semi-naturalistic wearable dataset show that the proposed model outperforms existing event-based approaches, achieves performance beyond or comparable with statistical and deep-learning models with a more compact input representation, and provides improved interpretability through integrated-gradient-based analysis. These results indicate that explicit modelling of event timing and duration enhances both classification performance and interpretability, supporting reliable deployment in biomedical and health informatics applications.
zh_abstract: 任务转换检测旨在识别一个人何时从一项任务切换到另一项任务，为持续健康监测和及时的情境感知干预提供基础。尽管统计特征表示和深度特征表示已展现出很强的分类性能，但它们往往依赖难以用行为学术语解释的聚合特征或潜在特征。基于事件的特征通过将行为与生理模式编码为具有明确语义的离散 token，提供了一种紧凑且可解释的替代方案，使其非常适合健康信息学中的行为分析。自注意力提供了一种对此类 token 间交互进行建模的机制；然而，传统自注意力分类器主要依赖 token 顺序，并未显式纳入时间或持续时间信息。因此，事件表示中具有信息量的时间线索可能未被充分用于任务转换检测。本研究提出一个基于事件的、时间感知的自注意力框架，将行为信号表示为离散事件序列，并附加起始时间戳和持续时间。事件时间使用参数高效的基于核的表示进行编码，而一种新颖的类型感知持续时间嵌入根据事件持续性调节信息传播。在半自然可穿戴数据集上的实验表明，所提出模型优于现有的基于事件的方法，以更紧凑的输入表示取得超过或与统计模型和深度学习模型相当的性能，并通过基于积分梯度的分析提供更好的可解释性。这些结果表明，显式建模事件时间和持续时间可提升分类性能和可解释性，支持在生物医学和健康信息学应用中可靠部署。

title: Fairness or Fallacy? Mapping the Landscape of AI Bias in Disease Detection
zh_title: AI 疾病检测中的偏见全景综述
summary: arXiv 综述梳理疾病检测中 AI 偏见识别与缓解的研究现状。
key_points: 聚焦疾病检测中的 AI 偏见
按模型类型、数据类型与人群分析
属综述，未提供新实验
reason: 综述类预印本，无新方法或验证，属增量档
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) has several transformative effects on healthcare, like to facilitate clinicians in disease detection and to manage patient care with enhanced precision. Due to the increasing complexity of medical data and the growing volume of diagnostic images, the substantial computational power needed to process such information creates both opportunities and challenges. To accomplish this objective, numerous methodologies have been proposed to integrate AI into disease detection systems. All these methodologies consider different aspects of clinical diagnosis, considering key parameters such as the type of AI model employed, the nature of input data, and the population demographics being analysed. In this paper, we review different state-of-the-art techniques which have been proposed for various areas of disease detection, specifically focusing on bias identification and mitigation. The proposed solutions are distinguished based on the type of input data they utilize, the architecture of model, and type of bias (algorithmic bias, demographic bias, model bias, and deployment bias). The time frame chosen to filter out relevant studies is between 2015 and 2026. Eventually, we review 23 related articles out of 64,389 analyzed from seven different digital libraries. The obtained results guide us to reach a conclusion with respect to state-of-the-art selected studies. Furthermore, these results reveal significant research gaps that can assist researchers in addressing AI-related bias in medical diagnosis. By prioritizing explainability, data diversity, and fairness in algorithmic design, as well as equitable access for affected patient populations, they can utilize available healthcare resources more effectively.
zh_abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) 对医疗保健具有若干变革性影响，例如帮助临床医生进行疾病检测，并以更高精度管理患者照护。由于医疗数据日益复杂以及诊断图像数量不断增长，处理此类信息所需的大量计算能力既带来机遇也带来挑战。为实现这一目标，已提出许多方法将 AI 整合到疾病检测系统中。所有这些方法都考虑临床诊断的不同方面，并考虑关键参数，例如所采用的 AI 模型类型、输入数据的性质以及所分析的人群人口学特征。在本文中，我们综述了针对疾病检测各个领域提出的不同最先进技术，特别关注偏倚识别与缓解。所提出的解决方案根据其使用的输入数据类型、模型架构以及偏倚类型（算法偏倚、人口学偏倚、模型偏倚和部署偏倚）加以区分。用于筛选相关研究的时间范围为2015年至2026年。最终，我们从七个不同数字图书馆分析的64,389篇文章中综述了23篇相关文章。所得结果引导我们就所选的最先进研究得出结论。此外，这些结果揭示了显著的研究空白，可帮助研究人员解决医学诊断中与 AI 相关的偏倚。通过优先考虑可解释性、数据多样性、算法设计中的公平性以及对受影响患者人群的公平可及性，他们可以更有效地利用现有医疗资源。

title: MCDA: Multi-View Graph Contrastive Learning with Dynamic Topology Augmentation for Functional MRI Analysis
zh_title: MCDA：多视图图对比学习用于fMRI分析
summary: 提出拓扑引导的多视图图对比学习框架，用动态拓扑增强分析静息态功能磁共振数据。
key_points: 动态增强更新模块迭代精炼增广后的脑功能连接拓扑
结合样本自身与跨样本增强，兼顾个体特征与群体异质性
面向脑疾病诊断与病理机制研究，摘要未给出具体数据与结果
reason: 方法类预印本，摘要无数据集规模与对照结果，属增量档
abstract: Resting-state fMRI (rs-fMRI) is a vital non-invasive tool for diagnosing brain disorders and uncovering pathological mechanisms. However, existing graph contrastive learning (GCL) methods often underexploit augmentation histories across training epochs and the relationships among different augmented views. In this paper, we introduce a topology-guided Multi-view graph Contrastive learning framework with Dynamic graph topology Augmentation (MCDA) for fMRI analysis. Unlike traditional GCL that uses fixed noise or edge-dropping, MCDA employs a Dynamic Augmentation Update (DAU) module that iteratively refines the augmented topology. Specifically, we incorporate self-aware and cross-sample augmentation strategies to simultaneously capture individual-specific functional signatures and inter-subject heterogeneity. We then design a topology-guided multi-view graph contrastive learning scheme that explores interrelationships not only between the original network and its augmented views, but also across different augmented views to maximize structural information preservation. We characterize the score-level optimization directions and establish a lower bound for the contrastive objective. The framework combines classification and contrastive losses for brain disorder diagnosis and examines discriminative functional connectivity patterns as potential biomarkers. Experiments on two public rs-fMRI datasets comprising 1,236 subjects demonstrate that MCDA outperforms the state-of-the-art methods. The code has been made publicly available at: \url{https://github.com/goodcodingagoodboy/MCDA}.
zh_abstract: 静息态 fMRI（rs-fMRI）是诊断脑部疾病和揭示病理机制的重要非侵入性工具。然而，现有图对比学习（GCL）方法往往未充分利用跨训练轮次的增强历史以及不同增强视图之间的关系。本文中，我们引入一种用于 fMRI 分析的、带有动态图拓扑增强的拓扑引导多视图图对比学习框架（MCDA）。与使用固定噪声或边丢弃的传统 GCL 不同，MCDA 采用动态增强更新（DAU）模块，迭代细化增强后的拓扑。具体而言，我们结合自感知和跨样本增强策略，以同时捕捉个体特异性功能特征和受试者间异质性。然后，我们设计一种拓扑引导的多视图图对比学习方案，不仅探索原始网络与其增强视图之间的相互关系，还探索不同增强视图之间的相互关系，以最大化结构信息保留。我们刻画分数级优化方向，并为对比目标建立下界。该框架结合分类损失和对比损失用于脑部疾病诊断，并检查判别性功能连接模式作为潜在生物标志物。在包含 1,236 名受试者的两个公开 rs-fMRI 数据集上的实验表明，MCDA 优于最先进方法。代码已公开于：\url{https://github.com/goodcodingagoodboy/MCDA}。

title: PFedQFT: Personalized Federated Quantum-Inspired Fine-Tuning for Medical Large Language Models
zh_title: PFedQFT：医疗大模型个性化联邦微调
summary: 提出量子启发式个性化联邦微调框架，用紧凑共享适配器降低通信与参数开销。
key_points: 基于截断矩阵指数近似与QR正交化构造可复用正交适配基
全局共享核心保留各机构适配灵活性，应对数据异质
目标是隐私约束下多机构协同适配医疗大语言模型
reason: 纯方法类预印本，摘要未给出实验规模与效果，属增量档
abstract: Medical data remain fragmented across institutional silos because of privacy, governance, and ownership constraints. Federated learning enables medical institutions to adapt large language models (LLMs) collaboratively without transferring raw records. However, independently parameterized low-rank adapters incur repeated parameter and communication costs across Transformer projections, while uniform aggregation may limit adaptation to heterogeneous institutional data. We propose PFedQFT, a quantum-inspired framework for personalized federated fine-tuning with a compact shared adapter. Specifically, PFedQFT constructs reusable orthonormal adaptation bases from compact skew-symmetric generators using a truncated matrix-exponential approximation followed by QR orthonormalization. Compatible projections reuse these bases, while a globally shared full core preserves the flexibility of each projection. Each client further maintains a lightweight private residual operator, whose directions are learned globally and whose coefficients remain local. Experiments on seven public medical tasks and multiple LLM backbones show substantial reductions in trainable parameters and per-round adapter upload volume, with competitive predictive performance on most tasks.
zh_abstract: 由于隐私、治理和所有权限制，医疗数据仍分散在机构孤岛中。联邦学习使医疗机构能够协作适配大语言模型（LLM），而无需传输原始记录。然而，独立参数化的低秩适配器在 Transformer 投影中产生重复的参数和通信成本，而统一聚合可能限制对异构机构数据的适应。我们提出 PFedQFT，一种受量子启发的框架，用于使用紧凑共享适配器进行个性化联邦微调。具体而言，PFedQFT 使用截断矩阵指数近似并随后进行 QR 正交归一化，从紧凑斜对称生成器构造可复用的正交归一适配基。兼容的投影复用这些基，而全局共享的完整核心保留每个投影的灵活性。每个客户端进一步维护一个轻量级私有残差算子，其方向全局学习，而其系数保持本地。在七个公开医疗任务和多个 LLM 主干上的实验表明，可训练参数和每轮适配器上传量显著减少，同时在大多数任务上具有有竞争力的预测性能。

abstract: Structural MRI-based classification of major depressive disorder (MDD) remains challenging due to subtle, heterogeneous anatomical changes. We propose uncertainty-gated SHAP-Dirichlet refinement, a post-hoc reliability layer that improves predictions without retraining the classifier. The method retrieves similar labeled SHAP explanations, constructs Dirichlet class evidence, and selectively refines uncertain predictions through probabilistic fusion, while allowing unreliable cases to be deferred for expert review. We evaluate five classifiers on 504 SRPBS subjects (252 controls and 252 MDD patients) using 159 anatomical features and repeated nested cross-validation. Refinement improved accuracy across all 8 repetitions for TabM and ResNet, yielding mean gains of 1.04 and 0.45 percentage points (sign test p=0.008), while modifying at most 8.3% of predictions. Gains were concentrated among low-confidence cases, with significant improvements in calibration. The method also benefited an RBF support vector machine but not logistic regression or random forests. Ablations confirmed the importance of uncertainty gating and soft fusion. Dirichlet evidence identified baseline errors (AUROC 0.62), while deferring 50% of cases increased retained-case accuracy to approximately 75%. These findings support selective explanation-guided refinement as a practical approach to improving prediction reliability and facilitating expert triage in MDD classification.
zh_abstract: 基于结构 MRI 的重度抑郁症（MDD）分类仍然具有挑战性，因为解剖变化细微且异质。我们提出不确定性门控的 SHAP-Dirichlet 细化，这是一种事后可靠性层，可在不重新训练分类器的情况下改进预测。该方法检索相似的带标签 SHAP 解释，构建 Dirichlet 类别证据，并通过概率融合选择性细化不确定预测，同时允许不可靠病例被推迟以供专家审查。我们使用 159 个解剖特征和重复嵌套交叉验证，在 504 名 SRPBS 受试者（252 名对照和 252 名 MDD 患者）上评估五个分类器。细化在 TabM 和 ResNet 的所有 8 次重复中均提高了准确率，平均增益分别为 1.04 和 0.45 个百分点（符号检验 p=0.008），同时最多修改 8.3% 的预测。增益集中在低置信度病例中，校准方面有显著改善。该方法也使 RBF 支持向量机受益，但未使逻辑回归或随机森林受益。消融实验证实了不确定性门控和软融合的重要性。Dirichlet 证据识别了基线错误（AUROC 0.62），而推迟 50% 的病例使保留病例准确率提高到约 75%。这些发现支持选择性解释引导的细化作为一种实用方法，可提高预测可靠性并促进 MDD 分类中的专家分诊。

title: ACorD: Adaptive Correspondence Discovery for Medical Image Registration
zh_title: ACorD：医学图像配准的自适应对应发现
summary: 提出注意力引导的自适应对应发现框架，减少跨尺度配准中的误差传播。

abstract: Medical image registration is a fundamental task for aligning anatomical structures across images. Exhaustively searching for point-wise correspondences is prohibitively expensive in both computation and memory, particularly for high-resolution 3D medical images. Most recent learning-based methods directly predict correspondences in a coarse-to-fine manner, but often propagate intermediate estimates across scales without explicitly weighting correspondence evidence, which can allow coarse-scale errors to persist during refinement. To address these challenges, we propose ACorD, an adaptive correspondence discovery framework designed to mitigate error propagation with an attention-guided process. ACorD first predicts multiple potential correspondence candidates through Correlation-guided Cross-scale Offset Prediction (CCOP), which combines correlation maps as spatial matching priors with cross-scale features as global deformation context. Then, Multi-Head Deformable Aggregation (MHDA) aggregates these candidate correspondences using attention, producing a learned, non-uniform weighting over competing matches rather than treating them equally. The multi-head design further captures complementary deformation patterns, ensuring both global alignment and local precision. By integrating adaptive offset prediction with selective, attention-based aggregation of correspondence evidence, ACorD enables accurate deformation refinement. Extensive experiments on four public medical registration benchmarks demonstrate that adaptive correspondence discovery within a multi-scale refinement framework improves registration robustness across diverse anatomical structures.
zh_abstract: 医学图像配准是跨图像对齐解剖结构的基础任务。穷举搜索逐点对应关系在计算和内存方面代价过高，尤其是对于高分辨率三维医学图像。大多数近期基于学习的方法以由粗到细的方式直接预测对应关系，但通常在各尺度间传播中间估计而未显式加权对应证据，这可能使粗尺度误差在细化过程中持续存在。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 ACorD，一种自适应对应发现框架，旨在通过注意力引导过程减轻误差传播。ACorD 首先通过相关引导的跨尺度偏移预测（CCOP）预测多个潜在对应候选，该方法将相关图作为空间匹配先验与作为全局变形上下文的跨尺度特征相结合。然后，多头可变形聚合（MHDA）使用注意力聚合这些候选对应关系，对相互竞争的匹配产生学习到的非均匀加权，而不是同等对待它们。多头设计进一步捕捉互补的变形模式，确保全局对齐和局部精度。通过将自适应偏移预测与基于注意力的选择性对应证据聚合相结合，ACorD 能够实现准确的变形细化。在四个公开医学配准基准上的大量实验表明，在多尺度细化框架内进行自适应对应发现可提高跨多种解剖结构的配准鲁棒性。

abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) can improve reasoning in large language models, but specialized non-English domains expose a data mismatch. Raw English domain text is often available, while target-language RLVR tasks with verifiable rewards are scarce. We introduce code-switched task synthesis for cross-lingual RLVR, a data-centric approach that derives target-language and code-switched RLVR task variants from otherwise unverifiable English domain text. Using fill-in-the-middle multiple-choice QA as a seed task format, we synthesize automatically verifiable tasks from domain passages and reshape them into cross-lingual variants. These variants preserve the same evidence-answer relation but change how English and target-language evidence are presented during RLVR. On Korean medical benchmarks and cybersecurity benchmarks across four target languages, code-switched training outperforms matched monolingual and bilingual-mixture baselines on average target-language performance while maintaining comparable English performance. Additional analyses provide evidence of better target-language input understanding and stronger cross-lingual alignment in both model outputs and internal representations. These results suggest that code-switched training helps target-language inputs access domain reasoning learned more strongly in English.
zh_abstract: 具备可验证奖励的强化学习（Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards, RLVR）能够提升大语言模型的推理能力，但专门的非英语领域暴露出数据不匹配问题。原始英语领域文本通常可获得，而具有可验证奖励的目标语言 RLVR 任务却稀缺。我们提出面向跨语言 RLVR 的语码转换任务合成（code-switched task synthesis），这是一种以数据为中心的方法，可从原本不可验证的英语领域文本中衍生出目标语言和语码转换的 RLVR 任务变体。使用填空式多项选择问答作为种子任务格式，我们从领域段落中合成可自动验证的任务，并将其重塑为跨语言变体。这些变体保持相同的证据—答案关系，但改变在 RLVR 期间呈现英语和目标语言证据的方式。在韩语医学基准以及覆盖四种目标语言的网络安全基准上，语码转换训练在平均目标语言性能上优于匹配的单语和双语混合基线，同时保持可比的英语性能。额外的分析提供了证据，表明模型输出和内部表示中都具有更好的目标语言输入理解以及更强的跨语言对齐。这些结果表明，语码转换训练有助于目标语言输入获取更多在英语中学习到的领域推理能力。

abstract: This paper presents an original mathematical and computational framework for modeling the efficacy of methylphenidate as an optimal control policy acting on the nonlinear dynamics of attention deficit hyperactivity disorder. Neural processes in ADHD are conceptualized as stochastic processes with trajectories that inherently converge towards stable, yet dysfunctional patterns associated with clinical symptoms. The pharmacological intervention is mathematically formalized as an external control signal that reassesses the system's drift and redirects these trajectories towards neurotypical regimes. To bridge these theoretical stochastic models with empirical clinical data, latent representations are inferred using a novel deterministic hybrid deep learning architecture, combining a one-dimensional convolutional neural network and a Vision Transformer, trained on preprocessed functional magnetic resonance imaging data.
zh_abstract: 本文提出一个原创的数学与计算框架，用于将哌甲酯建模为作用于注意缺陷多动障碍非线性动力学的最优控制策略。ADHD 中的神经过程被概念化为随机过程，其轨迹本质上会收敛到与临床症状相关的稳定但功能失调的模式。该药物干预被数学形式化为一个外部控制信号，它重新评估系统的漂移，并将这些轨迹重定向到神经典型状态。为将这些理论随机模型与经验临床数据连接起来，使用一种新颖的确定性混合深度学习架构推断潜在表示，该架构结合了一维卷积神经网络和 Vision Transformer，并在预处理后的功能性磁共振成像数据上训练。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Tan Tock Seng Hospital; conditions: Diabetes Mellitus; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 48; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] AI-CARE is an artificial intelligence-enabled clinical decision support mobile application designed to support prandial insulin dosing in individuals receiving MDI, incorporating a "human-in-the-loop" approach to ensure user verification of recommended doses. The application integrates AI-driven image-based carbohydrate estimation tailored to Asian dietary contexts, individualized patient-specific insulin parameters, and real-time CGM data to generate personalized insulin dose recommendations. The primary objective of this study is to evaluate the feasibility, safety, and preliminary effectiveness of the AI-CARE mobile application among adults with diabetes receiving MDI. Feasibility will be assessed in terms of recruitment, retention, participant adherence, and application usability. Safety will be evaluated by monitoring the incidence of hypoglycaemia, hyperglycaemia, and other adverse events throughout the intervention period. The study will also examine the preliminary effectiveness of AI-CARE on glycaemic and patient-reported outcomes compared with usual care. In addition, a qualitative process evaluation will be conducted to explore participants' experiences and perceptions of using AI-CARE, including perceived ease of use, usefulness, acceptability, and barriers and facilitators to real-world implementation. Findings from this phase will inform further refinement and optimization of the AI-CARE system and guide the design of a future large- scale randomized controlled trial.

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Centre for Addiction and Mental Health; conditions: Mild Cognitive Impairment (MCI), Alzheimer Disease (AD); type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 60; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] Memory and thinking problems in older adults, including mild cognitive impairment (MCI) and Alzheimer's disease (AD), can be difficult to assess promptly because evaluation often depends on in-person specialist visits. MonitorCog-AI is a computer-based platform designed to provide a more accessible way to assess and monitor cognitive changes using standard computers or tablets. Artificial intelligence (AI) will be used to analyze the digital information collected by the platform and examine whether combining several types of measures improves assessment of cognitive impairment. The study will include 60 adults aged 50 years and older: 20 healthy adults, 20 adults with MCI, and 20 adults with AD. Participants will be assessed at baseline, 6 months, and 12 months. At each timepoint, participants will complete one clinical assessment and one digital assessment. The clinical assessment will include standard measures of memory and thinking, an assessment of daily functioning, and a brief recording of brain electrical activity. The digital assessment will take approximately 60-80 minutes and will assess five areas: cognition, eye movements measured using a webcam, language, speech, and fine-motor performance measured using a mouse. At baseline, the digital assessment will be completed in the clinic; at 6 and 12 months, it will usually be completed remotely at home. The study has three main goals. First, it will determine whether MonitorCog-AI is feasible, acceptable, easy to use, and not overly burdensome for repeated assessment. Second, it will examine how well AI-based analysis of the digital measures distinguishes healthy adults, adults with MCI, and adults with AD, and whether combining several types of digital information performs better than any single type alone. Third, it will examine how digital measures change over 12 months and whether these changes are related to changes in clinical measures of cognition and daily functioning.
